job.title: KSL NewsRadio Talk/News Host (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL NewsRadio, KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

Position Overview

Perform/create informative and engaging news show content either live or on a pre-recorded basis for KSL NewsRadio. Management will assign responsibilities on a regular and/or rotating basis depending upon need and proven capabilities and the need to provide expertise for the future.

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an on-site role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Salt Lake City site.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Select and develop story ideas for on-air presentation
  • Collaborate with a show producer to create performance ideas and audio opportunities
  • Capture the attention of an audience with a unique and informed perspective
  • Develop an on-air presence and a professional demeanor that exudes confidence
  • Discuss current events in a conversational manner
  • Demonstrate spontaneity and flair while simultaneously showing depth, good judgment and sensitivity
  • Enunciate clearly, speak confidently, and interpret and read written copy fluently
  • Execute format philosophy and work with a team of other professionals while creating a distinctive sound
  • Ability to operate studio, recording and editing equipment as needed
  • Desire to innovate show segments and develop creative new performance ideas
  • Accept direction and critique and incorporate feedback into future programs
  • Work in a fast and concise manner under pressure
  • Present live, unscripted and breaking information with continuity, meaning and clarity
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience working in a newsroom environment.  Minimum of 2 years on-air show experience preferred. 
  • News judgement.
  • News writing experience
  • Passion for news and current affairs.
  • Experience in radio news hosting.
  • Aggressive attitude with a strong desire to advance in the broadcasting media.
  • Ability to use humor.
  • Spends time researching topics.
  • Ability to be respected by newsmakers during interviews.
  • Strong desire to work at the state’s largest and most respected radio station. 
  • Multi-tasking pro.  Ability to be organized with the capability to concentrate on more than one event at a time, able to follow written and verbal instructions under moderate supervision.
  • Proven ability to work under pressure to meet daily/weekly deadlines. 
  • Willing to be active in the community, on video and on social media.
  • Self-starter with the ability to assure accuracy in on-air product.  Errors may incur financial time loss.
  • Monitor news on a daily basis. 
  • Computer skills.

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 35 pounds on occasion

Compensation

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement
  • Paid time off for vacation and sick leave in addition to paid company holidays
  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: Associate, HR Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities. 
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

 

Salary $27—$27 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

  • Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.
  • Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.
  • Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.
  • Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
  • Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

WHO YOU ARE:

Talent Attributes:   What we expect for our employees:

  • Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude 
  • Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement
  • Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence
  • Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition
  • Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

job.title: Senior Counsel, Intellectual Property
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Working Conditions:

  • Stamford based role

  • Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm

About the Role

WWE is seeking a skilled and proactive Corporate Counsel to join our Business & Legal Affairs team and report into the WWE - Senior Vice President, Deputy General Counsel and TKO - Head of Intellectual Property and Licensing. The ideal candidate will have approximately 6-8 years of legal experience, focused on intellectual property clearance, prosecution, enforcement and protection as well as drafting and negotiating corporate agreements. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of law, business strategy, and entertainment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive clearance searches and provide risk assessments for new brands, products, character names, corporate logos, and apparel slogans.

  • Monitor and enforce the company’s intellectual property portfolio (trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets), including drafting and sending cease-and-desist letters, managing takedowns, filing UDRP actions, managing third party enforcement vendors and supporting litigation if necessary.

  • Develop and institute best practices for IP enforcement and protection for infringements, counterfeit and video piracy strategies.

  • Advise on copyright, domain name and related brand protection issues.

  • Support IP enforcement, including monitoring, cease and desist letters, opposition and related disputes. 

  • Collaborate with external counsel and IP offices globally on enforcement.  Work closely with internal business units on a wide variety of intellectual property related matters.

  • Stay current on relevant legal developments, including changes in IP law and technology affecting brand owners’ ability to monitor and enforce proactively.

  • Draft a broad range of contracts relating to sports and entertainment, including intellectual property settlement and coexistence agreements, license agreements, product placement agreements, independent contractor agreements and NDAs.

  • Work closely, collaboratively and enthusiastically with other members of the Business & Legal Affairs team of WWE, WWE affiliates, as well as corresponding business clients.

  • Provide comprehensive legal advice and counsel to internal business units.

  • Provide real-time analysis and advice on business and legal issues, including questions of contract interpretation and enforcement.

  • Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to at least one U.S. state bar, and the ability to register as Connecticut authorized in-house counsel.

  • Strong background in trademark clearance, prosecution and enforcement.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating corporate contracts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Knowledge or willingness to watch current and historical WWE programming.

Required Skills

  • Working and recent knowledge and experience with clearance search work as well as U.S. trademark prosecution (including all filings with the U.S. Trademark Office).

  • Familiarity with domestic and international IP enforcement strategies.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure

  • Equity/stock options (if applicable)

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role within one of Connecticut’s most advanced and high-profile corporate facilities environments, leveraging cutting-edge building technology, smart systems, and world-class operations infrastructure.

This is not a traditional facilities role. The position sits at the intersection of facilities operations, smart building technology, maintenance planning, asset management, and systems administration. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary subject matter expert for the CMMS/IWMS platform, helping ensure efficient operation, reporting, planning, and continuous improvement of our facilities maintenance programs.

Working closely with maintenance leadership, engineers, technicians, vendors, and technology partners, this role will play a key part in supporting one of the most advanced and high-profile facilities environments in the region.

Key Responsibilities

CMMS / Systems Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for the CMMS/IWMS platform
  • Manage system configuration, workflows, asset data integrity, and user support
  • Ensure integrations with Smart Building and related operational systems function properly
  • Troubleshoot CMMS issues and coordinate escalation with internal technology teams or external vendors when needed
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to maintenance systems and operational efficiency

Work Order & Maintenance Management

  • Oversee work order lifecycle management including creation, assignment, tracking, updates, and closure
  • Maintain and optimize preventative maintenance schedules and programs
  • Support maintenance planning and coordination activities across the facility
  • Assist with vendor scheduling and contractor coordination

Asset & Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate asset records and equipment data within the CMMS
  • Assist with spare parts inventory management and tracking
  • Support asset lifecycle documentation and reporting initiatives

Reporting & Operational Analytics

  • Generate CMMS reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking metrics
  • Assist facilities leadership with maintenance performance reporting and operational insights
  • Identify trends and opportunities for process improvement

Training & Collaboration

  • Train and support internal users on CMMS best practices and workflows
  • Partner cross-functionally with facilities, engineering, operations, and vendors to improve system adoption and operational execution

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, Facilities Management, or related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience working with CMMS, IWMS, EAM, or related maintenance management systems
    • Systems like IBM Maximo, ServiceNow Facilities, Archibus, Corrigo, FM:Systems and similar
  • Experience supporting facilities operations, maintenance planning, asset management, or building systems environments
  • Familiarity with preventative maintenance programs and work order management
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace

Job Title

Director, Executive Compensation

Job Description

The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.  Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company.

The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

Equity Program Administration

  • Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures.

  • Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports.

  • Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. 

  • Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets.

  • Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.

  • Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups.

  • Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity.

  • Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

  • Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal.

Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance

  • Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings.

  • Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure.

  • Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings.

General Compensation & Projects

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to HR and  Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year.

  • Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy.

  • Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets.

  • Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion.

  • Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives.

  • Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: A forward-thinking mindset with a willingness to explore AI tools, automated workflows, and emerging technologies to streamline compensation processes and maximize efficiency.

job.description:
Job Description :

About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce.


The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed.


This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network.


What You’ll Do:
● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output.
● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance.
● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice.
● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages
(Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership.
● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue.
● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards.
● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage.

How We Measure Success:
● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs.
● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene.

● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces.
● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets.

What You’ll Bring:
● Professional experience commensurate with an associate-level role in features, news or commerce writing, backed by a portfolio of strong clips and early experience (or a demonstrated aptitude) for editing.
● Obsession with the commerce landscape, reader value and producing service-oriented content with a commercial focus.
● Command of the iconic NY Post voice and a proven track record of writing crisp, authoritative headlines.
● Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO, plus social media best practices.
● Comfort reading dashboards (Search Console, GA4, Looker or similar) and using data to pivot quickly to trends or live news without losing accuracy.
● CMS fluency and sharp attention to detail, including mastery of AP style and
FTC-compliant disclosures.
● A collaborative, growth-oriented mindset – highly organized, adaptable and ready to take on coaching responsibilities.

Nice to Have
● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools.
● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value.
● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews.
● Newsletter experience.

job.title: Associate Director, Audience Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director of Audience Development to join our New York-based Marketing Strategy & Audience Development team. This role will lead the day-to-day strategy and hands-on execution of first-party fan data acquisition campaigns (email & SMS), with a particular focus on building high-intent email and SMS audiences that can be converted into e-commerce merchandise buyers & beyond.

Reporting to the Vice President, Audience Development, this role combines strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution and data-driven performance optimization. You’ll leverage proprietary technology, paid and organic marketing channels, live events and third-party audience tools to deliver measurable growth for artists and label partners across multiple genres and career stages.

Please note: This is a hands-on role that will occasionally require evening or weekend work to support priority releases & live events.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

First-Party Data Acquisition Strategy

  • Partnering closely with our Marketing Strategists, you’ll lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS.
  • Use data to identify the right value exchange for each audience, including exclusive content, early merchandise access, contests, ticket presales, live-event activations and other fan experiences.
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to ensure newly acquired fans enter CRM lifecycle journeys and receive a cohesive experience from initial sign-up through conversion and retention.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Support our Marketing Strategists by owning the end-to-end execution of fan acquisition campaigns, including campaign planning, audience strategy, platform setup, landing pages, sign-up flows, testing, launch and performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy & Global Paid Media teams to develop and optimize impactful paid lead-generation campaigns across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish testing frameworks and best practices across landing pages, forms, incentives, messaging and acquisition channels to improve both the volume and quality of acquired fans.

E-Commerce & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with D2C, CRM and Marketing Strategy teams to connect your acquisition campaigns to downstream product discovery, sales conversion and repeat-purchase opportunities.
  • Use transactional and behavioral data to identify the channels, campaigns and fan segments most likely to generate merchandise revenue.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to build clear handoff strategies that move newly acquired fans into personalized welcome, nurture and conversion journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM and Global Paid Media to evaluate acquisition performance beyond initial sign-up volume, using metrics such as cost per acquired fan, subscriber quality, engagement, first-purchase conversion, revenue per acquired fan and return on investment.

Audience Insights, Measurement & Reporting

  • Develop reporting frameworks that connect fan acquisition activity to downstream engagement, streaming, ticketing and e-commerce outcomes.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Analyze fan behavior to identify high-value audience segments, acquisition sources and conversion patterns.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for internal teams, artists and label partners.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.

Tools, Technology & Innovation

  • Oversee the strategic use of proprietary and third-party audience acquisition tools, landing-page platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fan sign-up experiences, progressive data collection, audience segmentation, consent management and data enrichment.
  • Partner with Product, Design & Engineering teams to help guide the development of tools and features that improve first-party data acquisition and measurement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Relationship Management, Fan Engagement & CRM, Privacy and Product, Design & Engineering teams to ensure acquisition campaigns comply with global privacy and consent requirements.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in evaluating and testing new fan acquisition technologies, platforms and partners.
  • Monitor emerging audience-development trends within music and across industries such as gaming, sports, television, film and retail.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Education

  • Partner with Relationship Management, Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy, Brand Marketing, Fan Engagement & CRM, D2C e-commerce and Marketing Strategy teams to integrate first-party data acquisition into artist campaigns.
  • Serve as an audience-development thought leader internally and as a trusted advisor to artist and label partners, providing best-practice guidance and data-driven recommendations.
  • Educate internal teams and clients on the role first-party fan data can play in driving long-term audience ownership and commercial growth.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in educating marketers across global markets on acquisition strategies appropriate to their local audiences, platforms, cultures and privacy requirements.
  • Help establish repeatable processes that make audience acquisition a consistent component of priority artist and release campaigns.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience within music, entertainment or another consumer-focused industry, including e-commerce experience.

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time. Today, we work in more than 60 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

The Global Finance Shared Service Center supports the core business with finance related matters, covering a wide scope of activities across the globe. We ensure suppliers and artists are paid on time for the amazing work they create.  We work closely with the local finance teams around the world which means we have an excellent understanding of how the company operates and are kept up to date with key developments in this exciting and fast paced industry. Our teams play a key role in ensuring Sony Music achieve their annual goals each year.

Order-to-Cash Senior Digital Analyst will be responsible for supporting the Revenue Order to Cash Associate Director within the Sales Reporting department with sales reporting & processing, data quality analysis, Financial Postings & Accruals, and overseeing cash application for various different income streams, as well as other special projects as directed by management.

What You'll Do:

Management

  • Supervision of day-to-day activities of BPO agents including:
    • Training, setting goals, monitoring progress and leading all aspects of completion of assigned projects/tasks

Sales File Processing and Data Quality

  • Review and processing of digital sales files to ensure they are compliant with the deal terms while also taking appropriate actions for non-compliant reporting.
  • Business Process Improvements
    • Specifically focusing on identifying and addressing “root cause” of issues

Partner & Deal Management

  • Establish and manage relationships with digital service providers to ensure robust communication is in place so reporting is delivered timely and according to the reporting rules set for processing.
  • Set up and maintenance of customer/deals, within internal SME systems as well as in coordination with the Deal Partner, Business & Legal Affairs, and deal administrators

Communication & Coordination

  • Ongoing interaction & communication of issues with management and sales partners regarding Sales reporting concerns
  • Liaise & coordinate with various teams on joint work items (including IS&T and off-shore partners)

Who You Are:

  • Minimum of 4 years work experience; music industry or other entertainment field preferred
  • Detail oriented individual with strong organizational and leadership skills
  • Ability to balance  multiple tasks simultaneously and manage time productively
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Ability to analyze and review information from several different sources (corporate systems)
  • Prior experience with SAP, Royalty Systems, and/or Sales Systems would be strongly preferred
  • Capable of working independently, while also integrating into a team environment
  • Solid understanding of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Corporate Communications & Publicity - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The Orchard is seeking an experienced and clever communicator to join our global Corporate Communications team. The Senior Coordinator, Corporate Communications and Publicity will lead strategies that enhance The Orchard’s public profile and key messaging via an informed, amplified voice in media including press coverage, industry events, speaking engagements, as well as internal communications and client-focused initiatives. The role is essential to enhancing the communications department goals and coordinating with other departments to ensure overall brand visibility. The Senior Coordinator, Corporate Communications is a full-time, in-office position based in New York City at The Orchard’s headquarters and reports to the VP Global Corporate Communications.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.
  • Aid in the planning and execution of communications initiatives that support The Orchard’s internal and external strategic priorities
  • Assist in drafting press materials, including releases, bios, talking points, decks as necessary
  • Collaborate with departments company-wide, assuring clear, consistent, and compelling messaging 
  • Maintain close relationship with umbrella corporate communications department; uphold and enforce guidelines
  • Perform department admin duties such as invoices, press tracking, face sheets, guest lists, and more

  • Collaborate with the Director of Media & Artist Relations to support publicity campaigns and media outreach for select artists across The Orchard's roster

  • Collaborate with external media partners

  • Identify and evaluate music industry-related data including trends, current events, hot topics, etc.

  • 2+ years of music industry corporate communications or publicity experience, preferably at a label or independent PR firm
  • Strong understanding of the music media and PR landscape; understanding of digital distribution preferred
  • Some established relationships with reporters, editors, social media influencers, photographers, and cultural tastemakers
  • Experience executing press campaigns
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills; business writing experience preferred
  • Proven effective relationship builder and collaborator
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to effectively prioritize, multitask, meet tight deadlines and stay focused under pressure
  • Solid project management capabilities
  • Highly proficient ability to think both analytically and creatively

job.title: VP, D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy (Fan Engagement)
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing artists, songwriters, producers, and creators. Across our business, we are building the next generation of music commerce, fan engagement, and direct-to-consumer experiences globally.

The Role

Sony Music is seeking a VP, D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy team within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C creative, product and campaign activity across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six, organised around three pillars: creative, covering design systems, production and D2C visual standards; product, covering D2C product management, pricing and lifecycle; and campaign, covering CRM, fan acquisition and marketing operations. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What You’ll Do

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Campaign, CRM & Marketing Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C creative, product and campaign partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What We Give You

  • An opportunity to shape the future of global music commerce and fan engagement at scale.
  • Collaboration with industry-leading artists, labels and entertainment executives.
  • A dynamic and entrepreneurial culture within one of the world’s leading entertainment companies.
  • Investment in professional growth and long-term career development.
  • Competitive compensation package including salary, bonus eligibility, comprehensive benefits and additional Sony Music perks.

job.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Planning and Analysis
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in merchandise & D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers merch and D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business across channels, including strategy, creative, merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Famehouse is looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Planning & Analysis to help us build stronger revenue projections, planning, and business visibility across our D2C and merchandise services for artists & labels.

This role will sit within the Insights team and work closely with account teams, channel leads, finance, merchandise planning, operations, and label partners. The right person will help us better understand where revenue is coming from, where the opportunities are, and how we can make smarter, more proactive decisions across D2C, touring, and retail merchandise.

We’re looking for someone who is highly analytical, strategically oriented, and comfortable turning messy inputs into clear, useful planning tools and recommendations. Ideal candidates bring a strong existing understanding of the nuances of the music industry, and have an ability to balance both art and science in their work.

How You’ll CREATE:

  • Drive revenue planning and analysis across D2C, touring, and retail merchandise channels

  • Partner with account managers, channel and commercial teams to build, pressure-test, and refine artist and campaign projections across the roster

  • Develop practical forecasting models, planning frameworks, and projection methodologies that can scale across the business

  • Work closely with merchandise planning, finance, operations, and label commercial teams to align on assumptions, timelines, reporting, and planning processes

  • Lead recurring executive reporting, compiling business reviews, and performance analysis

  • Identify risks, opportunities, and trends across artists, product categories, campaigns, and sales channels

  • Help shape the roadmap for stronger forecasting tools, reporting infrastructure, and planning workflows

  • Build clear analytical frameworks and reporting solutions that improve forecasting accuracy and commercial visibility

  • Help establish shared best practices for revenue forecasting, commercial planning, and business reviews across teams

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5–8 years of experience in forecasting, commercial analytics, retail planning, ecommerce strategy, business insights, or a similar analytical role

  • Experience in a major music company is strongly preferred

  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to work across multiple teams and business functions

  • Experience building forecasting methodologies, planning processes, dashboards, and/or executive reporting

  • Familiarity with ecommerce, merchandise planning, retail analytics, touring, consumer products, or artist/label businesses

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and simply

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with finance, merchandising, operations, commercial, and account teams

  • Ability to operate in an evolving, fast-moving business where the answer is not always obvious

  • Experience leading business performance reviews, with a strong understanding of P&L drivers and the ability to translate sales performance into strategic recommendations

  • Bonus points for experience building forecasting models and analytical tools, including leveraging modern data and AI capabilities to improve planning, forecasting, and decision-making

  • Familiarity with SQL, BigQuery, LookML, or similar analytical technologies, with the ability to prototype datasets, reporting layers, or forecasting solutions in partnership with technical teams

  • A proactive, curious, and solutions-oriented mindset

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

job.description:

How we LEAD:

We are currently seeking an Application Security Engineer to join UMG's global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the Manager, Security Engineering and Vulnerability, this role is responsible for improving the security of internally developed applications and cloud services by partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Application Security Engineer will serve as a trusted technical advisor, performing application security assessments, supporting secure software development practices, and helping engineering teams identify and address security risks early in the development process. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with collaboration across development and security teams to strengthen UMG's application security posture while enabling innovation.

The ideal candidate has experience in application security, secure software development, cloud-native technologies, and developer enablement, along with strong communication skills and a passion for building secure software.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Perform application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure design reviews for internally developed and third-party applications.

  • Conduct application security testing using static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), API security testing, and manual validation techniques.

  • Review source code and provide secure coding guidance based on OWASP best practices and secure development principles.

  • Partner with software engineering teams to identify security risks and recommend practical remediation strategies throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate application security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows.

  • Provide security architecture guidance for new applications, APIs, cloud-native services, and technology integrations.

  • Support implementation of modern authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and other identity standards.

  • Evaluate, implement, and maintain application security tools and help improve security testing coverage across the development lifecycle.

  • Develop automation and scripting to improve application security testing, reporting, and engineering workflows.

  • Participate in security reviews for new technologies, cloud services, and third-party applications.

  • Support investigation and remediation of application-layer security incidents and vulnerabilities when required.

  • Create reusable security guidance, reference architectures, and technical documentation to improve secure development practices across engineering teams.

  • Deliver secure coding guidance and developer education to promote security-by-design principles.

  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and identity teams to continuously improve enterprise application security capabilities.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Application Security, Security Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a security focus.

  • Experience performing application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure architecture reviews.

  • Strong understanding of secure coding principles and common application vulnerabilities, including the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.

  • Experience with application security testing technologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing methodologies.

  • Experience working with modern application architectures, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.

  • Experience working within AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.

  • Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization technologies including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and JWT.

  • Understanding of security frameworks and standards including OWASP, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and ISO 27001.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices within Agile development environments.

  • Experience with application security platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Checkmarx, Veracode, Burp Suite, Semgrep, or similar tools.

  • Experience with container security, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code security.

  • Experience developing automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.

  • Experience performing security assessments of cloud-native applications and APIs.

  • Professional certifications such as CSSLP, GIAC GWEB, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Security+, CISSP, or equivalent.

  • Experience working within large global enterprise environments.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or similarly distributed global organizations.

job.title: Director, Commercial Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Capitol Christian Music Group is seeking a strategic, commercially minded music business professional to drive catalog growth and deepen relationships with artists, managers, and distribution partners. Sitting at the intersection of Commercial and Marketing, this role will be responsible for maximizing the value of CCMG’s catalog assets while serving as a trusted partner to artists and external stakeholders.

 

This role combines catalog expertise, marketing strategy, project management, and business development. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of music catalog monetization, a strong professional presence, and the ability to articulate why CCMG is uniquely positioned to steward, market, and grow an artist’s catalog better than anyone else in the industry.

 

Working across Commercial, Distribution Partners, Marketing, A&R, Audience Development, and Creative teams, this role will develop catalog growth strategies that drive streaming, consumption, fan engagement, and long-term revenue. Ensuring CCMG's catalog remains culturally relevant, commercially impactful, and positioned for sustained growth.

 

 

How you’ll CREATE:

Catalog Growth & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop and execute catalog growth strategies designed to maximize consumption, engagement, and revenue across CCMG’s catalog.

  • Identify high-potential catalog opportunities and create plans to unlock incremental value through marketing, partnerships, content, product development, and commercial initiatives.

  • Monitor catalog performance, market trends, and consumer behavior to identify growth opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to align catalog priorities with broader business objectives.

 

Project Management

  • Serve as the lead project manager for key catalog initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and flawless execution.

  • Build and oversee integrated marketing plans for priority catalog campaigns, anniversaries, milestones, reissues, and artist-focused initiatives.

  • Coordinate efforts across audience development, creative, media, commercial partnerships, and artist teams.

  • Establish clear objectives, timelines, KPIs, and post-campaign performance analyses.

 

Artist & Distribution Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with artists, managers, distribution partners, and other external stakeholders.

  • Support artist, management, and partner conversations by providing strategic catalog insights, performance updates, and growth opportunities.

  • Develop data-driven presentations and growth plans that communicate catalog performance, opportunities, and strategic recommendations.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for strategic catalog-related opportunities and partner discussions.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Commercial, Revenue, Sync, Audience Development, and Creative teams to ensure alignment around catalog priorities.

  • Advocate for catalog initiatives internally and externally, driving organizational focus and investment where appropriate.

  • Lead cross-functional working groups to advance key catalog projects and long-term growth strategies.

 

Analytics & Business Insights

  • Analyze streaming, sales, social, and audience data to evaluate performance and guide decision-making.

  • Develop recommendations based on consumption trends, audience behavior, and revenue opportunities.

  • Create high-level reporting and presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders.

 

Bring your VIBE:

 

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in music, entertainment, catalog management, marketing, commercial strategy, or related fields.

  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through catalog marketing, commercial initiatives, or artist development strategies.

  • Strong understanding of music catalog economics, streaming platforms, consumption trends, rights management, and revenue drivers.

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects from strategy through execution.

  • Proven track record managing external relationships with artists, managers, or business partners.

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong professional presence with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts and analytical capabilities.

  • Highly organized project manager who can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Relationship builder with the ability to establish credibility across both internal and external constituencies.

  • Collaborative work style with a bias toward action and results.

  • Deep understanding of streaming platforms, playlist ecosystems, audience development strategies, and digital consumption behaviors.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within recorded music, artist management, music publishing, or catalog-focused businesses.

  • Familiarity with Christian and Gospel music audiences, artists, and marketplace dynamics.

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. Job Summary 

We are currently seeking an Identity & Access Management Engineer with specialization in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) to join UMG’s global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the VP, Tech Security & Identity, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise IGA capabilities across a complex, global environment. 

This engineer will play a critical role in governing digital identities, access entitlements, and lifecycle processes for employees, contractors, and non-employee populations. The role emphasizes strong engineering execution, automation, and operational discipline, partnering closely with security, HR, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure access is provisioned appropriately, reviewed regularly, and removed in a timely manner. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with modern IGA platforms, strong understanding of access governance controls, and the ability to operate at scale in a regulated enterprise. 

Job Functions 

Design, engineer, deploy, and operate Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the enterprise. 

Implement and manage identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows for employees and non-employee identities. 

Engineer and maintain access request, approval, and provisioning workflows integrated with HR systems, directories, and enterprise applications. 

Design and operate access governance controls including role models, entitlement catalogs, access certifications, and periodic access reviews. 

Partner with application owners and platform teams to onboard applications into IGA and remediate access governance gaps. 

Develop and maintain automation and integrations for IGA workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., PowerShell, Python). 

Support segregation of duties (SoD) controls, access policy enforcement, and audit readiness activities. 

Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity lifecycle, provisioning, and access-related issues across integrated systems. 

Collaborate with Security, HR, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure identity governance controls align with security policies and regulatory requirements. 

Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks to support scalable and repeatable IGA operations. 

Continuously identify opportunities to improve access governance maturity, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation and platform enhancements. 

Job Requirements 

Essential Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering roles, with a strong focus on Identity Governance & Administration. 

Demonstrated experience implementing and operating enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent). 

Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and entitlement governance. 

Hands-on experience designing and supporting access certification campaigns and remediation processes. 

Experience integrating IGA solutions with HR systems, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise applications. 

Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. 

Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) with IAM integrations. 

Ability to independently own complex technical deliverables while collaborating effectively within a global organization. 

Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. 

Desirable Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Experience with advanced IGA capabilities such as role mining, access analytics, or policy-based provisioning. 

Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, or similar. 

Professional certifications such as Saviynt Certified Professional, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, Security+, or CISSP. 

Experience operating IAM or identity governance platforms within a large, global, or highly regulated enterprise environment.

We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Globe 

Who we are  

Globe is the award-winning creative and partnerships division of Universal Music Group in the UK. We work together with our artists and labels, operating at the intersection of music, film, television, brands and creative partners. 

We specialise in placing music to picture across film, TV, advertising, gaming and streaming alongside crafting standout brand partnerships and original content. Our work sits at the heart of an artist’s marketing strategy, driving cultural relevance, audience reach and long-term impact. 

Our team  

Globe is made up of passionate and knowledgeable experts who thrive on collaboration and creativity. We work closely with artists from the moment they sign, helping shape their journey across all stages of their career. Our team approaches every campaign with pace and precision, moving fast like an F1 pit crew, but with the deep creative care of the engineers behind the scenes. 

We’re building a new sync presence on the ground in the USA, and we’re looking for dynamic self-starters who can identify and unlock opportunities others might miss. We believe in the power of teamwork, cultural fluency, and mutual respect and we’re united by our love of music. 

Our impact  

Globe plays a key role in the long-term success of our artists. We secure impactful placements that elevate an artist’s profile and fanbase, whether it’s a global film franchise, a soundtrack moment in a streaming hit, or a culture-shaping ad campaign. Each sync is a chance to deepen engagement, build brand value, and create timeless connections between music and audience. 

Our work helps shape perception and drive discovery. We create opportunities that align with artist narratives and bring a new level of visibility to Universal Music Group’s UK world-class repertoire. 

The Role  

A day in the life of  

As Sync Agent, Globe USA (Advertising – East Coast), you’ll lead Globe’s advertising-focused sync strategy from New York. Your remit will centre on identifying, developing and executing licensing opportunities that maximise the commercial and creative impact of Universal Music UK’s frontline and catalogue repertoire. 

You’ll work with advertising agencies, music supervisors, brands and creative partners to build long-lasting relationships and drive new and repeat business. Working closely with our UK labels and A&R teams, you’ll curate and deliver music responses that cut through creatively and deliver commercially.
