job.title: Video Editor, PageSix.com (Virtual Reali-Tea)
job.description:
Job Description :

Page Six provides readers with the best in Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 25 million unique viewers a month. For the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Page Six video team is seeking an in-office Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about reality TV: the shows, the personalities, the characters. Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. You should possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, feuds, scandals and hookups. You should live and breathe reality TV lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse.


This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You will assist on dozens of videos throughout the day, taking lead from the producers and studio technical director.


Responsibilities:

  • Edit high quality, engaging short form videos focused on celebrity news, reality television, entertainment, and pop culture for digital and social media platforms.

  • Transform original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content into compelling, shareable video content.

  • Collaborate closely with producers and the Studio Technical Director to execute a high volume of daily video productions while consistently meeting tight deadlines.

  • Maintain exceptional speed and accuracy in video editing without compromising creativity or editorial quality.

  • Create visually dynamic content using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Adobe Motion Graphics templates.

  • Generate and pitch fresh video concepts daily that align with trending celebrity news, reality TV, and audience interests.

  • Participate in editorial meetings and brainstorming sessions to develop innovative multimedia storytelling ideas.

  • Monitor celebrity news, entertainment, reality television, fashion, social media, and digital trends to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ensure all content aligns with Page Six's editorial voice, brand standards, and quality expectations.

  • Stay current on emerging digital video formats, platform best practices, and audience engagement trends to continuously improve content performance.

  • Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously while remaining highly organized in a fast paced newsroom environment.

  • Collaborate with cross functional editorial and production teams to deliver timely, accurate, and engaging video content.

  • Contribute to production goals by supporting the efficient execution of daily publishing schedules across digital platforms.

  • Exercise strong editorial judgment when selecting footage, pacing stories, and crafting narratives that resonate with digital audiences.

  • Help evolve existing video franchises while identifying opportunities to develop new recurring series and formats.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience editing high volume, digital first video content in a fast paced newsroom, entertainment, or media environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects and Photoshop strongly preferred.

  • Experience editing with a combination of original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content.

  • Ability to create engaging horizontal and vertical videos optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other digital platforms.

  • Strong understanding of platform specific video formats, audience behaviors, and emerging digital video trends.

  • Deep knowledge of celebrity news, reality television, pop culture, entertainment, and social media, with the ability to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ability to edit quickly and efficiently while maintaining exceptional editorial judgment, creativity, and attention to detail under tight deadlines.

  • Experience with multicamera editing, color correction, audio mixing, and pacing content for maximum audience engagement.

  • Motion graphics, basic animation, and experience using Adobe Motion Graphics templates are a plus.

  • Strong instinct for selecting music and sound design that enhances storytelling and complements the tone of each video.

  • Ability to generate, pitch, and develop fresh video concepts daily while contributing meaningfully to editorial brainstorming sessions.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with Executive Producers, Producers, Studio Technical Directors, social teams, and cross functional newsroom partners.

  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing competing deadlines, planning for contingencies, and adapting quickly in a rapidly changing news environment.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and self motivated, with the ability to work independently while thriving as part of a collaborative team.

  • Positive, solutions oriented attitude with a passion for creative storytelling and a belief that news can be engaging, entertaining, and shareable.

  • Ability to make sound editorial decisions and maintain accuracy while working under pressure.

  • Flexibility to work a nontraditional schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and major news or entertainment events as needed.

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a News Producer who is creative, curious, and highly organized, and can build fast-paced, accurate, and memorable newscasts for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

 

This role is ideal for a strong storyteller who thrives in a live newsroom, makes sound editorial decisions under pressure, and brings urgency, context, and clarity to every story. job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking a detail-oriented, service-minded HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist to join the People Solutions team. Reporting to the SVP of People Solutions, this role partners with HR, Legal, managers, employees, and external vendors to deliver compliant, well-documented, and employee-centered outcomes across Television, Radio, and Corporate functions.

 

This role strengthens CMG’s employment compliance foundation by managing critical programs with accuracy, discretion, and disciplined follow-through. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will help ensure workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, policy governance, immigration administration, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training are executed consistently, documented appropriately, and aligned with legal, regulatory, and business expectations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Workers’ Compensation & Return-to-Work:

  • Own workers’ compensation claim administration from intake through resolution, including documentation, tracking, stakeholder communication, and coordination with managers, HR, carriers, administrators, and providers.
  • Advise employees and managers on claim requirements, timelines, documentation, return-to-work expectations, and related employment practices.

 

Policy Governance & Employment Practices:

  • Lead updates to employment policies, procedures, templates, and job aids in partnership with HR leadership and Legal.
  • Drive policy governance by tracking changes, maintaining version control, preparing stakeholder updates, and reinforcing consistent policy application.

 

Immigration Administration:

  • Manage immigration administration by coordinating documentation, tracking cases, partnering with vendors and attorneys, communicating with employees, monitoring renewals, and ensuring compliance follow-up.

 

Workplace Accommodations:

  • Coordinate with ASKHR to support workplace accommodation case management, including intake, documentation, employee and manager communication, and timely follow-through.
  • Gather and review job descriptions, essential job functions, and other role-specific information to support the interactive process.
  • Partner with Prudential to manage required documentation, case updates, and vendor coordination while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
  • When an accommodation is approved, coordinate with the HRBP and manager to support implementation, communication, and ongoing follow-up as needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Compliance Training & Regulatory Reporting:

  • Execute the annual compliance training cycle, including assignments, launch communications, completion tracking, overdue escalations, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Deliver FCC/EEO reporting support by gathering and validating data, maintaining documentation, coordinating stakeholders, and submitting reports on time.

 

Reporting, Records & Risk Management:

  • Develop metrics and reports to surface trends, risks, gaps, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Flag emerging compliance risks using trackers, metrics, reporting, and program data.
  • Track critical deadlines for FCC/EEO reporting, immigration renewals, workers’ compensation follow-up, and compliance training completion.
  • Maintain accurate records and data integrity while safeguarding sensitive employee information.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk matters and help drive practical, compliance-minded resolution.

Year One Critical Success Factors

Program Execution & Service Delivery:

Delivers accurate, timely, and employee-centered administration of workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, immigration, policy governance, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training.

 

Partnership & Compliance Credibility:

Builds trusted partnerships with HR, Legal, managers, and external vendors while providing practical guidance and escalating risk appropriately.

 

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement:

Maintains accurate records, strengthens reporting discipline, closes compliance gaps, and improves processes that support accountability and consistency.

 

Career Growth Opportunities:

This role provides meaningful exposure to enterprise HR compliance, employment practices, regulatory reporting, and cross-functional problem-solving. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will deepen expertise in risk management, policy governance, program administration, data reporting, and stakeholder partnership while gaining visibility across HR, Legal, business leaders, and external partners. Over time, this experience can support growth in broader HR compliance, employee relations, HR operations, or people program leadership roles.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, preferred.
  • 5+ years of HR, employment practices, compliance, benefits, or related experience, including exposure to workers’ compensation, policy administration, immigration, FCC/EEO reporting, compliance training, or regulatory program support.
  • Experience managing sensitive, deadline-driven processes with HR partners, Legal, business leaders, vendors, carriers, administrators, or immigration counsel.
  • Strong understanding of HR compliance, employment documentation, policy governance, case or program management, and multi-state employment environments.
  • Skilled in using HRIS, learning management systems, case management tools, vendor portals, Excel, and reporting tools to track activity, maintain records, and identify risks or trends.
  • Strong communication, judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through; able to work independently and escalate risk appropriately.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HR certification (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP).

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.

  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings. 
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred 
  • Large market experience preferred

  • Project Management skills required with proven ability to take a concept from ideation to development to implementation

  • Superior interpersonal skills and demonstrated command in large group settings
  • Strong command in front of large groups or video audiences. The gravitas to be a credible and dynamic sales leader in the digital space
  • Outstanding customer service skills with a keen ability to proactively anticipate and provide solutions for customer needs
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office products (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)

job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law.

Position Overview

WSOC‑TV Charlotte is seeking a Broadcast Engineer to join a talented, inventive, and dedicated Engineering team supporting live news production and broadcast operations. This role is open to entry‑level through senior engineers, with compensation dependent on experience, technical breadth, and demonstrated capability.

 

The Broadcast Engineer plays a critical hands‑on role in maintaining, supporting, and improving studio, control room, and transmission systems in a fast‑paced, live broadcast environment. This position provides daily technical support for news production and master control operations during the week and participates in an on‑call rotation for weekends.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

Here you’ll get to:

• Partner closely with Technology and Affiliate Finance teams to gather requirements, design, and deploy a robust financial forecasting and planning tool that supports WMG's long-term modeling.
• Spearhead AI and automation initiatives to eliminate manual bottlenecks and streamline workflows across Strategic Finance.
• Enforce data integrity within Strategic Finance by collaborating with data management teams to architect datasets and automate rigorous quality controls.
• Work directly with senior finance collaborators to clarify complex problems and build the right analytical or technology-based approaches using large, dynamic datasets.
• Act as the trusted liaison between Strategic Finance, Technology, and data platform collaborators to ensure all technical solutions perfectly align with business priorities.

About you:

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of hands-on, practical experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), Python-based automation, internal app frameworks (Streamlit), BI/reporting tools, workflow automation platforms (Airtable), and AI-assisted development tools.
• Experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and implement data science projects with minimal supervision.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and model development.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical tools.
• Strong understanding of SQL and working with large datasets.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical collaborators.
• Strong problem-solving abilities, with a bias towards action and a proactive approach to finding opportunities and challenges.

We’d love it if you also had:

• Familiarity with the streaming music landscape or other digital media
• Experience in finance transformation and EPM implementation
• Knowledge of accounting concepts and revenue recognition principles


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Recommendations (Experience)
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Recommendations Experience team, focusing on building ML-powered features that directly improve personalization, engagement, and satisfaction for our users. While this is an MLE role, you’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals and work across the full stack and end-to-end systems, from data pipelines to APIs to real-time serving, and everything in between. The Recommendations team ships ML-powered features that connect 200M+ users with music they'll love. 

You'll own features end-to-end: from understanding user needs with Product and Design, to architecting data pipelines processing billions of events, to building and shipping production ML systems that balance performance, cost, and user experience. This means working across BigQuery (trillion-row datasets), Airflow orchestration, real-time serving infrastructure (BigTable), APIs, and constant collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, and Platform teams.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop, test, and productionize ML and LLM-based systems serving real users
  • Design and build end-to-end ML pipelines, including data, features, training, and serving
  • Make technical decisions considering cost, latency, complexity, and maintainability 
  • Navigate distributed systems (BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, DynamoDB) to build reliable, scalable solutions
  • Set up monitoring, A/B testing, and metrics frameworks to measure real user impact
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines, ML models, and distributed systems
  • Contribute to technical strategy and team best practices
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • 1-2+ years building ML systems in production - you understand the difference between a model that works in Jupyter and one that serves millions of users
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience - you write production code, not just notebooks
  • Strong Python and Scala (or Java/JVM) skills, with experience writing scalable, production code
  • Experience building and deploying ML models end-to-end (data, training, serving, monitoring)
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based features in production
  • Familiarity with integrating LLMs into ML systems (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, model serving)
  • Understanding of shared ML architecture across domains (e.g. search and recommendations)
  • Strong focus on data quality and correctness, and how upstream data impacts downstream models and user experience
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (BigQuery, Spark)
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS/GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with distributed data processing and ETL pipelines (Airflow, Spark)
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Universal Music Group’s Content Protection team has an exciting opportunity available for a Content Protection Representative, unlike any other, that offers a chance to play a pivotal role in combating IP (Intellectual Property) theft at the world's largest music company.

The Content Protection department provides support to all UMG (Universal Music Group) labels and business units worldwide, across multiple time zones. The environment is often fast-paced and allows for opportunities to work on a diverse array of projects related to the management of audio and video content, as well as many other areas of our digital and physical workstreams. This role will suit a dynamic individual with a keen eye for detail and a passion for recorded music and technology.

As a Content Protection Representative, you will primarily be responsible for reviewing and assessing UMG content using a variety of internal and external technologies. You will also be trained in the physical, digital, and technical operations of the music business.


Bring your VIBE:

  • 0-1+ years' work experience in either Music industry or Digital Media, Entertainment, Technology, or related fields.
  • Familiarity with anti-piracy, copyright, or trademarks preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
     

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Highly organized with demonstrated attention to detail.
  • Self-starter with an ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Significant understanding of digital technologies, especially music platforms and mobile apps.
  • Strong organizational skills including follow-through and execution.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Passion for music and digital music platforms.

Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Fluency in Spanish or another language is a bonus.
  • Advanced knowledge of Office 365 including Excel.
  • Experienced in working with large datasets and / or databases including SQL language.
  • Excellent presentation skills (e.g., PowerPoint) along with a willingness to speak publicly amongst peers and senior managers.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Assess & review online uses of UMG digital and physical assets (including publishing), to detect infringement of our rights.
  • Handling inquiries from our internal business units and labels (including Spanish-speaking labels).
  • Work with our international trade groups to enforce our rights.
  • Staying abreast of digital trends related to the recording industry.

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

A little bit about our team:

The department consists of five specific areas of responsibility, all ultimately focused on the production and distribution of WMG products. Research and Development helps define new product specifications and processes for production; Product Data Management is responsible for defining product data standards and keying data into systems; Studio and Archive Operations delivers production masters for physical and digital manufacturing and archives the company master assets; Digital Production provides day-to-day production support for WMG labels’ digital releases and oversees production of digital assets and Digital and Mobile Operations manages the distribution of digital products to retail partners globally.

Your role:

In this role, you will work with one of the largest tape libraries in the world ensuring the protection, preservation, and production of tapes that source some of the most iconic albums and unheard rarities in all of music history. You’ll work with both librarians and engineers, directly handle and distribute master tapes and other audio sources to archive vendors, and ensure the accuracy of production and preservation through research, document creation, and spreadsheet & database maintenance. 

 

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will ensure that the proper tapes are being archived for a given release.
  • You will locate final product and verify that all metadata is correct in relation to tapes pulled.
  • You will create Archive Packing Lists detailing correct Artist, Title, Label, Sel #, Track Titles, Source File #, and any other pertinent information needed for each release, providing these to the archive vendors for reference and inclusion in the archives.
  • You will update the Transfer Tracker document for archives needed for current production requests, including the date sent for archive, where it was sent and when it is needed by.
  • You will schedule pick-ups of archive supplies and tapes and address sourcing issues with vendors as they arise (finding alt sources if tapes are problematic, etc.)
  • You will correct errors in our Master Library System (MLS) database based on research, tape box information or additional information provided by archive vendors working with the tapes.
  • You will assist non-archive librarians as needed.

 

About you:

  • You are detail-oriented
  • You enjoy problem solving and have initiative
  • You have composure and interpersonal savvy
  • You preferably have a college degree or equivalent work experience
  • You maintain a service orientation and costumer focus

 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Familiarity with Excel and navigating databases
  • Knowledge of music industry processes past and present: Tracking/Mixing/Mastering/Duplication
  • Familiarity with audio recording media format

This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

  • Manage multiple accounts, requests and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and proactively communicating priorities, concerns or potential delays
  • Identify and escalate performance, tracking, policy, billing or fulfillment concerns before they negatively affect a campaign or client
  • Stay current with evolving advertising platforms, SEM products and internal processes, applying new team guidance and Audacy SEM best practices as directed
  • Collaborate with sales teams, internal partners and external vendors to support accurate campaign execution and a positive client experience

  • BS/BA degree or relevant experience
  • Paid search or digital media advertising experience preferred

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Dallas, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

Reporting to: Regional Promotions Director

Overview:

 

Audacy Richmond seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for Virginia-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.

  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.

  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events.   • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).
  • Radio or audio industry background a bonus.

Audacy Rochester seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Techs for outside field work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

 

 

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace? At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition.   • Outwork the Competition: Stay ahead of market trends, identify emerging opportunities, and bring fresh ideas to every client conversation.

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.

Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.

  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.

  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.

  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.

  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.

  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling

  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities

  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred

  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment

  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems

  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills

  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.

Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

job.title: Finance Manager, Digital, Record to Report
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Record to Report (Digital) to support the Digital Finance organization. This role is responsible for overseeing key accounting activities related to the monthly close process, general ledger management, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for the Digital business. The position partners closely with Digital Finance leadership to ensure accurate and timely financial results while driving process improvements, maintaining strong internal controls, and leading a team of accounting professionals. The position reports to the Vice President, Record to Report.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a collaborative and detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at managing competing priorities, solving complex problems, and partnering with leaders across the organization to deliver accurate financial results, strengthen internal controls, and drive continuous process improvements. You are an effective communicator and team player who can build strong relationships and lead accounting professionals to achieve shared goals.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and approve journal entries, ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and close calendar deadlines.
  • Review account reconciliations and ensure they are prepared, reviewed, and certified in accordance with company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Prepare and review quarterly flux analysis packages, providing meaningful explanations of financial results and variances.
  • Partner with the Digital CFO and Finance team to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements.

Accounting and General Ledger Management

  • Manage day-to-day general ledger activities for the Digital business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee accounting for specialized contractual arrangements and obligations.
  • Review accounting treatment related to digital content licensing, produced content, programming rights, obligations, and related cash flow schedules.
  • Interpret and analyze contracts to determine appropriate accounting treatment and financial impact.
  • Lead Oracle ERP Record-to-Report processes, including financial consolidations, allocations, data interfaces, journal posting, period open/close activities, foreign currency exchange rate maintenance, revaluation and translation processes, cash management, subledger-to-ledger reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and governance of cross-validation rules to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Lead, develop, and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance and service levels, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant issues, disputes, and risks to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and enhance accounting procedures, process documentation, and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and implement process and system improvements.

Audit and Compliance

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely delivery of required documentation and analysis.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with SOX and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Projects and Initiatives

  • Support system implementations, integrations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in special projects and ad hoc analyses as requested by Finance leadership.
  • Drive automation and standardization efforts to improve the efficiency of Record-to-Report processes.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 5+ yrs. accounting experience
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Ability to speak/write/understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as there will be work weeks that require more than 40 hours to ensure the Company’s reporting requirements are met.

New Jersey Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000.Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. job.title: VP, People eXperience, The Orchard
job.description:

Strategic Business Partnership

clear PX strategic plan across the employee journey.

integration, workforce planning, and staffing models, in partnership with the wider Americas PX team and the COEs.

eXperience initiatives, programs, and processes, balancing strategic counsel with hands on support.

owning the leadership-facing dimension of sensitive issues.

market, up to the global business.

change.

team and PX Operations and Total Rewards.

Operational Delivery & Leadership

team on process and delivery.

priorities that drive and enable the business strategic plan for the year ahead.

● Operational Delivery. Collaborate, influence and partner with COEs and local PX business partners on operational aspects that impact the full employee cycle from hiring 
to exits, including intern and early career experience and fixed-term contractors. 
● Oversee the onboarding experience of all new hires and ensure PXBPs are guiding the experience in partnership with direct People Leader
● Lead the annual employee engagement survey process from planning through action, including communications, analysis of results, and partnering with senior leaders 
to develop and execute meaningful action plans.

Culture, Change and Continuous Impact
● Champion the culture. Lead, role model and develop a strong culture through our Global People Promise and Values, one that fuels inclusion, innovation, and 
collaboration.
● Think like a business leader. Build deep commercial and industry acumen and adapt PX practices and approach to reflect and enable our creator first approach.
● Lead Change. Drive organizational change and transformation. Guide leaders and employees through the change curve and build teams and individuals that are resilient, 
adaptable, and steady under pressure.
● Raise engagement. Own employee engagement initiatives that lift performance and satisfaction, and act on what the culture survey and listening data tell you.
● Advance inclusion. In partnership with The Orchard’s D&I team and The Orchard’s leadership team, develop and deliver strategies for diversity, accessibility and inclusion 
at every level.
● Build learning capability. Champion The Learning Collective and a culture of continuous learning and growth for leaders and employees, including your own, and lift 
adaptability to new technologies, systems, and ways of working, as well as the continued development of The Orchard Academy.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
● Lead your team. Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of PX professionals across the US and the UK/Europe. Set clear goals, grow their capability, and hold a high 
bar.
● Partner with Sony Music’s centers of excellence (C.O.E’s). Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Relations, Compensation, Benefits, The 
Learning Collective, Organization Success, Diversity and Inclusion, Communication teams to design consistent, high-impact experiences for The Orchard global business.
● Connect to the enterprise. Contribute to a highly collaborative USBP, Americas and Global People Experience team on cross-functional and global projects and initiatives. 
● Deliver for the offices. Ensure close partnership with Finance, Operations, Comms, Diversity & Inclusion, Philanthropy, Social Impact and Environment, Facilities and 
Business & Legal Affairs teams, to develop and deliver an optimal employee experience across all The Orchard offices.
