job.title: Director, Marketing Operations
job.description:
Job Summary

The Director, Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational strategy, execution, reliability, and advancement of the platforms and processes that power Hearst Newspapers' digital subscription marketing strategy. This role leads day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, subscription rates and offers, data integrations, and platform quality assurance, ensuring the marketing technology stack operates reliably while continually improving how Marketing uses technology, data, AI, and automation. This is a centralized role supporting nine markets, with responsibility for building consistent, scalable processes and capabilities across the portfolio.

 

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent marketing operations leader who combines deep hands-on marketing technology experience, strong data and systems thinking, and disciplined operational leadership. This person will manage a distributed team of four and serve as a key bridge between Marketing and Product, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, Customer Service, and technology vendors - translating marketing needs into clear requirements, identifying new capabilities and opportunities, and driving adoption across marketing and newsrooms.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team, managing workload, performance, priorities, and professional development while establishing clear ownership, service levels, operating rhythms, and accountability.

  • Own the Marketing Operations intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, allocating team capacity, managing tradeoffs, and keeping stakeholders aligned on timing, scope, and dependencies.

  • Own day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, and any other future platforms, including platform administration, workflows, audience segmentation, campaign activation, personalization, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and scalable execution across markets, with particular responsibility for supporting Marketing and newsroom teams in their use of Sailthru.

  • Ensure operational reliability across recurring marketing processes, integrations, audience and data flows, rates and offers, tracking, and platform capabilities; proactively monitor for issues, diagnose root causes across systems, and partner with BI, Product, and vendors on resolution and safeguards.

  • Oversee email operations across newsletters, lead generation, acquisition, retention, and other lifecycle communications, including audience selection, campaign/template setup, scheduling, suppression logic, deployment, and operational readiness. Partner closely with marketing and newsroom teams to strengthen newsletter capabilities, workflows, and best practices.

  • Manage the operational setup and governance of checkout and cancellation flows, subscription rates, pricing configurations, and promotional offers, partnering with Finance, Marketing, Product, and Customer Service to ensure accurate implementation across customer experiences.

  • Serve as Marketing's close partner to the Product Director and as the primary Marketing-to-technology translator: turn loosely defined business problems and ideas into clear functional, data, and operational requirements; support prioritization, ideation, implementation, testing, and rollout; and translate technical capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs into practical marketing implications and opportunities.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand Marketing's capabilities through existing or new technology, data, AI, automation, and self-service. Assess business value and operational feasibility, reduce manual work and handoffs, enable appropriate self-service, and move the strongest opportunities from concept to implementation while maintaining governance and human oversight.

  • Manage marketing technology vendors, including relationships, contracts, renewals, platform performance, issue resolution, roadmap alignment, and service levels. In partnership with Product and technical stakeholders, represent Marketing in evaluating prospective technology and assessing capabilities, gaps, integration needs, and tradeoffs against business requirements.

  • Lead capability rollout and adoption across Marketing and newsrooms by translating new functionality into usable workflows, documentation, training, governance, and operating practices; establish rigorous QA and change-management standards to ensure capabilities are implemented accurately and sustainably.

 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Significant experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or digital subscription operations, including experience leading teams and managing complex cross-functional workflows.

  • Strong hands-on experience directly configuring and troubleshooting marketing technology platforms, including customer data platforms, email/CRM platforms, audience segmentation, automation, personalization, business rules, and campaign activation; BlueConic and Sailthru experience are strongly preferred.

  • Strong technical fluency across marketing technology ecosystems, including data integrations, APIs and data feeds, audience schemas, identity and profile data, tracking, campaign logic, platform dependencies, and data flows between marketing platforms and enterprise data environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose marketing technology and data issues, trace problems across systems and data flows, identify likely root causes, and partner effectively with BI, Product, Engineering, and vendors on resolution.

  • Strong data and systems literacy, including the ability to interpret data schemas, understand field-level logic and transformations, validate outputs, translate business needs into precise technical and data requirements, and assess upstream and downstream dependencies; familiarity with SQL or similar data-querying concepts is strongly preferred.

  • Strong experience with email and newsletter operations, including supporting both Marketing and newsroom use cases, segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, automation, deployment workflows, deliverability considerations, and identifying and implementing new platform capabilities and best practice.

  • Experience managing checkout or monetization platforms, subscription pricing, rates, promotional offers, or comparable configuration-driven customer subscription programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, partner effectively with Product and technical teams, evaluate technology capabilities and tradeoffs, and drive adoption of new tools and functionality across non-technical users.

  • Proven people-management experience, ideally leading remote or distributed teams, with strong coaching, prioritization, stakeholder management, communication, and accountability skills.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, and self-service approaches to improve operational workflows, QA, speed, and team capacity while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving and operational judgment, and the ability to balance business urgency with platform integrity, data quality, scalability, and sustainable processes in a fast-moving environment.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

job.title: Senior Social Producer, Sports
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.
 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact: 

The Senior Social Producer, Sports will drive the day-to-day execution of SiriusXM Sports’ social strategy and bring programming, talent, and major sports moments to life across social platforms. This role will identify the stories and moments that matter and translate them into compelling, social-first content across priority sports properties. Working across major tentpole coverage, real-time publishing, and internal teams, this role will support the continued growth, reach, and relevance of SiriusXM Sports.

What you’ll do:

  • Own day-to-day social strategy execution for SiriusXM Sports and its programming across NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, wrestling/Busted Open, and other priority sports properties.

  • Develop and execute social content plans around major sports moments, live events, interviews, programming launches, and tentpoles.

  • Identify the strongest content, conversations, and storylines from SiriusXM sports programming and determine how to best package and distribute them for social audiences.

  • Manage publishing and content distribution across SiriusXM Sports social platforms, adapting content, copy, creative, and formats based on the platform and audience.

  • Produce and publish compelling social-first content, including short-form video, clips, graphics, and real-time posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and emerging platforms.

  • Make timely editorial decisions around breaking news, games, trades, viral moments, and broader sports conversations to ensure SiriusXM Sports is participating in the moments that matter.

  • Partner closely with Programming, Video, PR, Marketing, and other internal teams to align on priorities, develop content opportunities, and maximize key moments.

  • Lead social coverage for live events and onsite activations, including developing coverage plans, coordinating content capture, publishing in real time, and identifying opportunities with talent.

  • Work directly with hosts, producers, and programming teams to identify social-first opportunities that extend SiriusXM programming and talent beyond the audio experience.

  • Develop new social concepts, recurring franchises, and creative formats around SiriusXM talent, programming, and major sports moments.

  • Track social performance and audience behavior, using insights to inform content decisions, platform strategy, and future coverage.

  • Maintain a consistent SiriusXM Sports voice and social presence while balancing the needs and audiences of individual leagues, shows, hosts, and properties.

  • Stay deeply connected to sports culture, fan conversations, platform trends, creators, emerging formats, and changes in how audiences consume sports content.

  • Support the continued growth and evolution of SiriusXM’s sports social strategy by identifying new formats, franchises, partnerships, and audience opportunities.

  • Serve as a trusted social partner to internal stakeholders, bringing strong recommendations and social expertise to programming and content conversations.

What you’ll need:

  • 4+ years of experience in social media, digital content, sports media, entertainment, editorial, or a related field.

  • Deep knowledge of sports and sports culture, with strong familiarity across major leagues and properties including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, and professional wrestling.

  • Excellent editorial judgment and the ability to quickly identify the quote, storyline, interview moment, or cultural conversation most likely to resonate with sports audiences.

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing social channels and executing content strategies for a brand, publisher, league, team, media company, or similar organization.

  • Strong knowledge of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and emerging social platforms, including platform-specific formats and best practices.

  • Experience producing and editing short-form social video using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools.

  • Excellent social copywriting skills and the ability to adapt voice, tone, and storytelling by platform and audience.

  • Experience leading social coverage around live events, breaking news, or other fast-moving editorial environments.

  • Strong understanding of social analytics and the ability to translate performance data into actionable content recommendations.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sports, shows, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with programming, talent, video, marketing, PR, and other teams.

  • Ability to operate independently, make sound editorial decisions, and take ownership of projects from planning through execution and reporting.

  • Flexibility to support major games, events, and breaking sports moments outside of traditional business hours when needed.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the annual salary for this this position to be between $67,000 and $85,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

This role will operate across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s portfolio and the Executive Leadership Team, connecting Product, Technology, Media Technology and Operations, Product and Information, Advertising Product, and other corporate and business stakeholders.

The Chief of Staff will create the operating mechanisms that keep priorities visible, decisions moving, risks surfaced, and leaders accountable for follow-through, while leading cross-functional initiatives that span organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.

Success will be measured by the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s ability to focus on the highest-value enterprise priorities; the clarity and effectiveness of the organization’s operating cadence; the speed and quality of cross-functional decisions; and the consistent execution of strategic initiatives across the Product & Technology portfolio.

What you’ll do:

Executive Strategy and Decision Support

  • Determine and introduce leading-edge business, operating, and decision-making approaches that improve how the Product & Technology portfolio sets direction and executes against strategic objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, providing objective analysis, recommendations, and a proactive view of risks, opportunities, and organizational dynamics.
  • Help define, prioritize, and communicate the Product & Technology portfolio’s most important enterprise priorities and strategic outcomes.
  • Prepare executive briefings, decision memos, talking points, presentations, and other materials for ELT meetings, leadership reviews, board-related moments, and critical internal communications.
  • Distill complex business, product, technology, operational, and financial information into clear choices, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
  • Anticipate information and decisions the Chief Product & Technology Officer will need and coordinate the right people, data, and analysis to support timely resolution.
  • Operate with discretion and sound judgment, managing sensitive matters, stakeholder dynamics, and critical escalations professionally.

  • Design and manage the operating cadence for the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s organization, including leadership staff meetings, operating reviews, strategic planning, portfolio reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.
  • Establish clear governance practices for cross-functional decisions, escalations, dependencies, and risk management across the Product & Technology portfolio
  • Maintain a single source of truth for enterprise priorities, milestones, decisions, dependencies, risks, and accountability.
  • Aggregate and synthesize performance updates, operating metrics, and strategic progress for the Chief Product & Technology Officer and the ELT.
  • Identify gaps in reporting, metrics, or operating mechanisms and implement improvements that increase transparency, speed, and accountability.
  • Track decisions and commitments through completion, escalating risks early with options and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead the most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise initiatives on behalf of the Chief Product & Technology Officer from problem definition through implementation and measurable results.
  • Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Technology Operations, Media Technology and Operations, Advertising Product, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, Security, and other stakeholders as needed.

  • Facilitate resolution of issues that span multiple functions, organizations, or executive stakeholders.
  • Drive organizational transformation, process improvement, and new ways of working that strengthen execution at scale.

Executive Communications and Alignment

  • Develop clear narratives and communications that connect the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities to company strategy, business outcomes, team member impact, and customer value.
  • Support ELT, Product & Technology leadership, all-hands, offsite, and other executive forums with agendas, content, preparation, and follow-through.
  • Ensure decisions and priorities are communicated consistently across leadership teams and translated into actionable direction.
  • Serve as a connective point across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s direct leadership team and key enterprise partners, while maintaining appropriate ownership with the accountable leaders.

  • Consolidate, refine, or craft high-quality materials for executive, board, internal, investor, and other external interactions – e.g., presentations, memos, speeches. Also coordinate and assist with meeting prep or speaking rehearsals as needed.

Organizational Effectiveness and Confidential Support

  • Partner with the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership alignment, team dynamics, and decision quality.
  • Handle confidential business, personnel, financial, product, technology, and organizational information with a high degree of discretion and integrity.

job.title: Audience Editor, Climate and Science
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

We are looking for an audience editor to join the newsroom Audience team and partner with our Climate and Science desks to help them continue to reach more readers and deepen our engagement with those readers.

This editor will work with the desk to inform coverage, both day-to-day and long-term, suggesting timely stories as well as evergreen topics, with an eye toward framing. They will help maximize distribution through search strategies and social programming, and by pitching internally to the homepage, newsletters and other alerts. And they will track data for the desk, using analytical skills to provide context and recommendations to the editors.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Audience strategy & growth:

    • Partner with senior editors to inform coverage decisions, suggesting timely stories, evergreen topics, and longer-term franchises that resonate with reader interest and important news moments, with a keen eye toward framing and formats.

job.title: Backend Engineer - Media Streaming
job.description:

  • Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages

  • Familiarity with audio/video codecs, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH), and transport container technologies
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

job.title: Multi-Skilled Meteorologist (per diem)
job.description:
CBS Atlanta - Multiskilled Meteorologist

This is a per diem position

The brand-new CBS Atlanta is looking to build a dynamic team of meteorologists to drive weather storytelling in a full AR/VR environment. Never worked in that space before? It’s okay, we’ll train you. An ideal candidate must have superior forecasting and severe weather skills.  Ability to produce easy to understand and informational visuals, maps, and graphics to communicate the weather story to customers every day on air, streaming, online and on social media platforms.

Other duties include producing weather content, working with a team of meteorologists, and implementing station strategy. Writing / preparing forecasts; producing graphics to tell the weather story across multiple platforms, strong social media presence. The candidate will also be required to periodically write and report weather-related content for newscasts. We want good communicators who are team focused. Our meteorologists need to be leaders at this startup news operation.


SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE SHOULD HAVE:

  • On-air weather casting experience within a TV Station.
  • A degree in meteorology or related science.
  • Strong writing skills for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Ideal candidate needs to have strong social media skills.
  • Ability to use augmented reality in weather segments is a bonus.
  • Ability to provide continuous live severe weather coverage across all programs.
  • Write daily weather blog and post weather content on social media platforms.
  • Passionate about being a brand ambassador for CBS Atlanta.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • B.S. Degree or equivalent experience in Meteorology or Earth Sciences preferred.
  • Proficient in weather graphics production.
  • Extensive knowledge of Atlanta and surrounding communities.
  • Ability to live field report and write packages.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record in order to operate a company vehicle.
  • At least 5 years of experience on-air in weather casting and weather producing preferred.
  • Ability to shoot and edit video preferred.
  • WSI weather system knowledge and ability to employ all functions on multiple platforms preferred.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Job Description:

Semafor is seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Accounting & Finance team and take ownership of core general ledger and month-end close activities as we build out our in-house accounting function. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented accounting professional with a solid foundation in month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations, who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment. This role will work closely with the Controller to strengthen processes, internal controls, and documentation, and will partner with FP&A on cost analysis and reporting. The successful candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, working independently and as part of a team, and adapting to shifting priorities within a rapidly growing media company. Prior experience in the media industry is a plus. This position offers meaningful growth potential as the accounting & finance team continues to scale.

What You’ll Do:

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close process, ensuring all close deliverables are completed accurately and on a timely basis.
  • Prepare and post journal entries in accordance with GAAP, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and supported.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly account reconciliations for assigned balance sheet and income statement accounts, researching and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across entities, ensuring balances tie out and are properly eliminated in consolidation 
  • Review the general ledger for accurate coding across all financial dimensions (department, project, entity, etc.), proactively identifying and correcting miscoded transactions.
  • Assist with accounts payable tasks as needed, including invoice coding, vendor inquiries, and payment support.
  • Partner with FP&A on analysis and reporting, including cost analysis, variance analysis, and ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Assist the Controller in further developing accounting processes, internal controls, and documentation.
  • Support the Controller with audits, special projects, and ad hoc analyses as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and month-end close efficiency, and assist in implementing process improvements.
  • Comfortable wearing many hats and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment.

What You Offer

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field from an accredited university or college; CPA or CPA candidate a plus.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and general ledger accounting principles.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills with a strong emphasis on Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling).
  • Experience with a general ledger/ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks) required; Bill.com or similar AP platform experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with proven organizational and time management skills and a strong sense of ownership and accuracy.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance role, with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines.
  • Experience in the media, publishing, or entertainment industry is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Compensation:
The base salary for this position at the time of posting will range from $110,000 - $145,000 in addition to an annual bonus incentive. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications. 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. This strategic sales leadership role requires significant digital advertising expertise, disciplined revenue management, and the ability to build accountable sales teams that deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients. Candidates without a strong foundation in digital advertising strategy, products, analytics, and sales leadership will not be successful in this role.

 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with extensive knowledge of digital marketing solutions, including search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display advertising, audience targeting, and campaign analytics. The GSM will be responsible for coaching and developing the sales team to confidently identify client challenges, recommend integrated solutions, and communicate measurable business outcomes across both traditional and digital platforms.

 

This leader owns total market sales performance, including local and digital revenue, new business development, forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and account growth. The General Manager, Sales, will serve as the market’s primary sales leader on integrated marketing strategy, helping sellers connect client objectives with effective multi-platform solutions while ensuring campaigns are measured, analyzed, and optimized to deliver results.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams, growing digital revenue, building integrated marketing strategies, holding teams accountable to performance standards, and developing high-performing sales professionals in a digitally focused media environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers consistent growth across total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business revenue, and account expansion.
  • Builds a sales culture defined by accountability, proactive prospecting, strong coaching, forecast discipline, and high client-service standards.
  • Increases seller confidence and adoption of integrated broadcast and digital solutions, supported by clear needs assessments, strong client strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains healthy pipeline visibility, accurate forecasting, and timely use of CRM and reporting tools to guide decisions and performance conversations.
  • Improves client retention and growth by using campaign performance data, market insights, and optimization recommendations to demonstrate value.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and inspire the sales organization to achieve and surpass total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business, and account-growth goals.
  • Establish and execute a market revenue strategy that maximizes radio, digital, event, promotional, and other available assets.
  • Drive new-business development and maintain accountability for prospecting, discovery, pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, and closing activity.
  • Develop the sales team’s ability to lead effective client needs assessments and create insight-driven, integrated advertising recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on leadership in digital sales strategy, helping sellers connect products and tactics to client objectives, audiences, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of priority digital advertising solutions and ensure sellers understand how to position them within integrated client strategies.
  • Guide customized campaigns across multiple platforms and use reporting, analytics, key performance indicators, and client feedback to evaluate results and recommend optimization.
  • Coach sellers to communicate campaign performance clearly, set realistic expectations, and strengthen client retention and growth.
  • Lead sales meetings, one-on-one coaching, account strategy sessions, client presentations, and market sales initiatives.
  • Collaborate with digital strategy, account management, operations, programming, and other internal partners to support accurate execution and a positive client experience.
  • Develop advertising events, promotions, seminars, and B2B marketing strategies that support revenue and community relationships.
  • Use consumer insights, market research, competitive information, and performance data to strengthen sales strategy and client recommendations.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain talented sales professionals while setting clear performance expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipeline visibility, and sales activity through company-approved CRM and reporting processes.

 Responsible for all aspects of daily treasury operations to meet the financial obligations of the organization. Overseas cash reporting and forecasting, credit administration and administration of business insurance programs.

Seven years of corporate accounting and financial reporting experience with a concentration in treasury.

Four year team management experience.

Strategic Thinking and Innovation: Anticipates long term business needs and pro-actively searches for innovative investment solutions.

job.title: Producer, Newsgathering
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a Producer with well-developed organizational skills and editorial instincts to work with the CBS Newsgathering team in Los Angeles. This role will create dynamic, visual content across multiple platforms, including network broadcasts, digital, streaming, and social. The ideal candidate will have a clear understanding of what it takes to produce live and taped segments, possess well-developed broadcast writing skills, plus understand the logistics of scheduling live shots with crews that are balancing newsgathering. You should have the editorial instincts to recognize developing news stories to ensure we are in the right places at the right times, ahead of the story.   A successful candidate is someone who’s worked in a highly functioning, quick-paced newsroom, is highly organized, and calm during breaking news. This person is a pro at multitasking, a passionate journalist, and a consummate team player. You must also be excellent at developing and nurturing relationships with other producers, reporters, photographers, managers, technicians, and other staff members inside and beyond the newsroom. Applicants must be willing to work a Wednesday through Sunday schedule,  along with some holidays.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Pitch original story ideas
  • Develop enterprise stories
  • Produce stories from concept to air
  • Work with correspondents and reporters
  • Participate in editorial meetings
  • Support breaking news coverage
  • Field produce when needed
  • Gather content/shoot basic video when necessary

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of local and/or network TV or cable news field producing experience
  • Strong editorial judgement with experience writing for broadcast 
  • Ability to shoot and knowledge of basic editing
  • Understanding of TV newsgathering and transmission technology
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, without restriction
  • Must possess a valid U.S. driver’s license with the ability and willingness to drive

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Candidate should have a keen editorial eye for compelling stories of national interest and skill at developing pitches 
  • Successful candidate needs to operate under tight deadlines as well as being fast-moving and flexible
  • Ability to thrive in all environments and be comfortable with breaking news coverage, including natural disasters, tragedies, high-profile interviews, and investigative stories

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.title: Director of Finance
job.description:
Director of Finance

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Finance to help lead financial operations for one of Hearst Newspapers' most important local media businesses. This role is ideal for a finance leader who combines strong technical accounting judgment with business curiosity, operational discipline, and the ability to translate financial results into clear recommendations and strategy.

Reporting to the VP of Finance, the Director of Finance will oversee key close processes, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, advertising accounting and analysis, and cost control activities while partnering closely with department leaders, centralized accounting teams, and senior leadership. The position requires a leader who can manage the details, improve processes, develop people, and support decision making across a fast-moving and transforming digital and print media operation.

What You Will Do
  • Own the monthly close process, including accruals, variance analysis, review of financial results, and timely completion of close deliverables.
  • Lead weekly P&L reporting, monthly financial reporting, forecasting, and business review support for the VP of Finance, Houston Chronicle leadership, and Hearst Newspapers finance teams.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial reporting, with clear communication of revenue, expense, margin, headcount, and payroll trends.
  • Manage and develop the finance/accounting team, including advertising-focused accounting support and related operating analysis.
  • Oversee advertising accounting activities, including revenue recognition, digital advertising margins, commission processing, goaling, and coordination with advertising operations.
  • Lead advertising analytics and KPI reporting, including trends and insights to support the VP of Finance, VP of Advertising and Publisher.
  • Develop and monitor financial KPIs that help leaders understand performance, optimize product P&Ls and advertising margins, improve budget adherence, and identify cost savings opportunities.
  • Partner with department heads to project, budget, and monitor expenses, improve business processes, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes.
  • Serve as a liaison with centralized accounting teams for accounting functions such as balance sheet reconciliations
  • Assist internal and external audit support in partnership with centralized accounting, including maintenance of internal controls and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Provide technical accounting guidance and support system improvements, reporting enhancements, process automation, and AI-enabled efficiency opportunities.
  • Optimize AI opportunities to automate daily and monthly reporting and improve process workflows. 
  • Prepare ad hoc analysis, special projects, and executive-ready reporting for senior leadership, the VP of Finance, and the Publisher.
Key Relationships
  • Vice President of Finance
  • President and Publisher, Houston Chronicle
  • Senior Vice President of Advertising
  • Executive Editor and senior leadership across functions
  • Hearst Newspapers finance and centralized accounting teams
  • Department heads and operating leaders across the organization
What You Bring
  • 8-10+ years of progressive finance or accounting experience, preferably in a complex operating environment.
  • Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
  • Prior experience as a Director of Finance, Finance Manager, Assistant Controller, or comparable financial leadership role required.
  • Strong technical accounting foundation with experience in monthly close, financial reporting, accruals, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and audit support.
  • Experience with advertising accounting and revenue recognition, digital margins, commission processing, or media revenue operations preferred.
  • Experience in media, publishing, digital media, marketing services, or a related industry preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP, planning, and reporting systems; Oracle ERP, Oracle Cloud, Hyperion Planning, business intelligence tools, advanced Excel experience, and AI products preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop finance or accounting team members, including team members who support multiple business partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain financial results and business implications to non-finance leaders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong process improvement mindset, including interest in automation, AI-enabled tools, and scalable ways to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach to working with internal and external partners.

 

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

Go deeper: In this role, you’ll:

  • Produce video from ideation through scripting, shooting, post-production, publishing, and promotion.
  • Shape ideas into pitches, treatments, scripts, shot lists, run-of-show documents, and other production materials.
  • Partner with editorial and video leaders to develop creative concepts and deliver engaging, accurate video aligned with Axios’ voice and standards.
  • Lead or support field, studio, and remote-based productions.
  • Work effectively with journalists, executives, guests, and other on-camera talent.
  • Coordinate work across internal teams, freelancers, contractors, vendors, and production partners.
  • Create video optimized for YouTube and other digital platforms, including packaging, audience retention, and distribution.
  • Use platform trends and performance insights to inform creative decisions and help grow Axios’ video audience.
  • Manage multiple projects, deadlines, production schedules, and review processes in a fast-moving environment.

The details: You have:

  • 5–7+ years of relevant video production, journalism, digital media, broadcast, documentary, branded-content, or comparable editorial experience; additional experience may be considered at the Senior Producer level.
  • Demonstrated experience producing, shooting, and editing professional video content, supported by a strong portfolio or reel.
  • Strong editorial judgment, visual storytelling skills, and the ability to turn ideas into compelling finished video.
  • Experience producing for YouTube and an understanding of audience development, search/discovery, retention, and platform-native storytelling.
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience working with on-camera talent, alongside strong writing, communication, and project-management skills.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial, solutions-oriented approach and comfort working across distributed teams and changing priorities.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $90,000 - $140,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

job.title: Sr. Producer
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Senior Producer to join Translation!

 

What You'll Do

  • Produce great work.
  • Manage and lead large scale, multi-faceted campaigns from concept vetting through job wrap with limited oversight.
  • Problem solve with internal and external teams to get to the best work possible. 
  • Develop and manage production calendars and direct the logistical flow of all phases of production to ensure all assets are delivered on time.
  • Accurately evaluate the feasibility of concepts, ideas, and scripts against client parameters.
  • Control the budget through all phases of production, working closely with business affairs during the production process through the closing of jobs, including presenting estimates and overages to clients for approval.
  • Manage junior producers working on your project and delegate assignments based on the job needs.
  • Research, evaluate and negotiate with industry partners to bring the best talent available to our projects, on time and on budget.
  • Manage shoots and post sessions to ensure the creative output is at its highest quality.
  • Follow financial and job wrap policies of the production department, client and agency.
  • Seek opportunities for underrepresented creators both in the agency and within the industry.
  • Support the creative team and their ideas/ representing, owning, championing and finding creative solutions to bring the idea to life in accordance with the brief, concept and budget
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Have an outstanding creative sensibility with a proven track record of producing industry leading work.
  • A track record of gaining the trust and respect of clients, internal teams and industry partners. 
  • The ability to work under pressure with flexibility, agility, and a good sense of humor.
  • Well versed in managing budgets and deadlines of all types with accuracy and diplomacy.
  • Superb problem solving, organizational, and communications skills.
  • You are a flexible multi-tasker that can handle a multitude of different responsibilities at one time.
  • Existing relationships with best in class industry talent.
  • Demonstrate, evangelize and live the core values of the agency.
  • Incorporate the passion, excitement and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of the company.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of production experience at a creative driven company.
  • A portfolio of work showing large budget productions.
  • After hours work and overnight travel to shoots and post sessions required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with celebrities, athletes, musicians, influencers, etc. 
  • Experience with union and non-union crew productions, including both SAG and non-SAG talent. 
  • Passion and knowledge of latest industry trends (music, media, distribution, directors, film, tech, etc).

 

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others. Over the last year, UnitedMasters artists have used our platform to land sync deals with major brands including the NBA, ESPN, Overtime Elite, Bose, Warner Brother Studios and in the NBA video game 2k. These deals give them additional money for their work and increase their exposure.

 

Salary Hiring Range: $115k-135k

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario, Posición Temporal por 2 meses
job.description:
Nombre de la Posición: Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario

Ubicación: Ciudad de México (Protele)

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual en la industria, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de streaming, televisión tradicional y radio, creando experiencias que conectan con millones de personas.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, unidos por la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y la innovación. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un entorno inclusivo, dinámico y lleno de oportunidades para crecer personal y profesionalmente, ¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo creativo!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un(a) Analista de Cumplimiento Publicitario para integrarse al Departamento de Cumplimiento Publicitario.

El Departamento de Cumplimiento Publicitario es responsable de revisar y aprobar contenido publicitario para televisión, radio y plataformas digitales, garantizando el cumplimiento de las leyes, regulaciones, políticas corporativas y estándares de la industria. El equipo trabaja en estrecha colaboración con áreas comerciales, legales, producción y operaciones para identificar riesgos regulatorios, de propiedad intelectual, derechos de terceros y reclamaciones publicitarias, contribuyendo a la protección de la empresa y sus audiencias.

Sobre ti 

Eres una persona proactiva, organizada y con un alto sentido de responsabilidad y urgencia frente al cumplimiento de plazos regulatorios y legales, capaz de priorizar tareas críticas en entornos de trabajo dinámicos y de alta demanda.

Tu día a día

  • Revisar anuncios políticos para televisión, radio y plataformas digitales, verificando el cumplimiento de requisitos regulatorios, divulgaciones obligatorias y políticas internas antes de su transmisión.
  • Documentar las labores de revisión, una vez que se ha identificando posibles riesgos legales, regulatorios o de cumplimiento que puedan requerir correcciones o validaciones adicionales para solicitar correcciones a agencias y dar seguimiento a los contenidos.
  • Dar seguimiento oportuno a campañas políticas en revisión, asegurando que los materiales sean procesados dentro de plazos regulatorios y operativos estrictos.
  • Mantener comunicación constante con tu jefe, equipos internos, agencias, representantes políticos y áreas de soporte, proporcionando orientación sobre requisitos de cumplimiento y estatus de revisiones.
  • Monitorear prioridades y resolver solicitudes de alto volumen en un entorno dinámico, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta establecidos durante la temporada electoral.

Tu deberías de tener

  • Licenciatura concluida en Ciencias de la Comunicación o Mercadotecnia o Periodismo o áreas afines.
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado con capacidad para revisar y comprender documentación profesional en ambos idiomas.
  • Conocimiento en paquetería de Microsoft (Word, Excel y Adobe Acrobat Reader)
  • Dominio de Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Capacidad para analizar, revisar y evaluar contenido audiovisual y publicitario en televisión, radio y medios digitales, identificando detalles relevantes y asegurando el cumplimiento de lineamientos establecidos.
  • Excelente atención al detalle y habilidad para detectar inconsistencias, omisiones o elementos que requieran seguimiento.
  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente en entornos de alto volumen y bajo plazos estrictos.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita para interactuar eficazmente con equipos multidisciplinarios y partes interesadas.
  • Pensamiento analítico y criterio profesional para investigar, documentar y escalar hallazgos de manera clara y oportuna.
  • Posición Temporal por 2 meses

Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Promovemos un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional, ofreciendo beneficios de ley y superiores que impulsan la productividad, la creatividad y el desarrollo personal y profesional.

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad u otra característica protegida por la ley.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Account Manager (Leave Cover)
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.  

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).   

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as 10 Streaming and on SVOD with Paramount+. 

 

 

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager to join our industry-recognised team in SYDNEY on a leave cover contract.   

 

What you’ll do as an Account Manager- Ad Sales:   

As an Account Manager you will work within Paramount’s high performing Ad Sales team representing and selling advertising across the Paramount ecosystem including Network Ten. You will be a champion of TV/Streaming and display a firm understanding of the role it plays in delivering effective outcomes for your portfolio of clients. You will act as the face of the Paramount brand in market, representing with passion, maximising revenue opportunities, creating best-in-class strategic solutions, and building meaningful relationships with your partners. 

 

Some of the key responsibilities include:  

  • Leading a dynamic portfolio of Agency/Direct clients with accountability for achieving revenue, increasing market share and yield targets across the wider Paramount playground (TV, BVOD, SVOD).  
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key clients, understanding their business objectives and providing tailored solutions. 
  • Proactively engage with media agencies via regular in person meetings and presentations to pitch creative opportunities and integrated cross-platform solutions. 
  • Mentoring and guiding Account Executives, fostering a positive team culture by providing training and support to enhance the skills and performance of the overall team. 
  • Educating yourself on the evolving media landscape by staying informed on industry trends, competitors and market conditions to identify any potential risks or opportunities for growth.  
  • Collaborating with all internal stakeholders within the business ie: Digital, Regional, Commercial Data & Innovation, Paramount Brand Studio, Sport, Revenue etc to provide seamless sales strategies for your clients and content led partnership opportunities.  
  • Driving new business growth by proactively prospecting and qualifying new clients 
  • Champion internal process improvements, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and enhance productivity in campaign delivery and client service. 

 

What are the benefits?  

  • Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands and content  
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who work hard and celebrate success regularly.  
  • Free subscription to Paramount + amongst other benefits 

  

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important?    

  • Account management experience in advertising and/or media sectors  
  • Demonstrated experience in a sales-focused role and pitching solutions to clients  
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills  
  • First-rate presentation skills   
  • A passion for content, streaming, advertising innovation and audience behaviour 
  • Understanding of the broader media landscape  
  • Strong agency/buyer relationships highly regarded 
  • Bachelor’s degree in media, Communications, Business, Marketing or related field highly regarded but not essential. 

 

 

Paramount ANZ is proud to be recognised by Diversity Council Australia as a 2024-2025 Inclusive Employer.

These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.   

 

Paramount acknowledges and respects Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the first peoples of the lands where we live, learn and work, and honours their continuing connection and care for Country and storytelling.

job.title: Account Coordinator - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talent—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

 

As an Account Coordinator, you will support the execution of artist commerce initiatives across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, licensing, events, and pop-up activations. Working closely with Account Managers and cross-functional teams, you will help coordinate merchandising projects from concept through fulfillment by tracking deliverables, facilitating communication, and ensuring projects remain organized and on schedule. You will assist with product development, client requests, and day-to-day project execution while collaborating with creative, production, operations, finance, and fulfillment teams to deliver a seamless experience for artists and their teams. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to supporting multiple projects simultaneously.

What you'll do:

Support Client Relationships & Day-to-Day Account Management

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to deliver exceptional service to artists, management, and internal teams. Support Account Managers through proactive communication, meeting coordination, follow-up, and execution across touring, e-commerce, retail, VIP, and licensing initiatives.

Coordinate Merchandise & Commerce Execution

  • Support the planning and execution of merchandising and commerce initiatives by tracking deliverables, coordinating product launches, and ensuring projects move efficiently from concept through completion while contributing ideas that enhance the fan experience.

Support Project Coordination & Product Development

  • Coordinate the day-to-day workflow of merchandise projects, including product setup, approvals, artwork routing, placing orders, sample tracking, inventory coordination, and launch readiness. Maintain accurate documentation and ensure all project details are organized and executed on schedule.

Coordinate Cross-Functional Communication & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a key point of coordination between creative, production, finance, touring, e-commerce, retail, and external partners. Ensure information is communicated clearly, action items are tracked, new clients onboarded, and processes are followed to keep projects moving efficiently and accurately.

Who you are:

  • 1+ years of experience in merchandising, e-commerce, retail, marketing, project coordination, entertainment, or a related field, with an interest in artist commerce.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with teammates and cross-functional partners and is comfortable following up, asking questions, and keeping projects on track.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn, with a solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to work in ambiguity while being adaptable to ever changing shifts, changes and seasonal ebbs and flows of the business
  • Passionate about music, merchandising, and fan experiences, with a collaborative attitude and a desire to contribute to outstanding client service and the successful execution of artist commerce initiatives.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
Level: Lead / Senior Lead (IC4–IC5)

 

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Lead ML Platform Engineer to architect and own the technical direction for our Training and Inference infrastructure. This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production. You will be responsible for the "engine room" of the AMLG, ensuring that our MLEs can train massive models efficiently and serve them with sub-millisecond reliability. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems and hardware acceleration. You will lead the adoption and optimization of AnyScale (Ray) for distributed training and manage a high-performance Kubernetes-based inference environment. You aren't just managing clusters; you are building a seamless, scalable platform that abstracts the complexity of GPUs and distributed compute for the entire organization.

Why This Role Matters

The ML Platform Lead is the force-multiplier for every other ML pod. In this role, you will directly shape:

The Training Foundation: Establishing AnyScale/Ray as the standard for distributed compute, enabling MLEs to train models on petabytes of data without managing infrastructure.
Inference at Scale: Architecting the serving layer that handles billions of requests per day, optimizing for both p99 latency and GPU utilization.
Operational Excellence: Setting the organizational standards for how ML models are deployed, monitored, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own the long-term architectural direction for the Training and Inference domains, ensuring the platform scales 10x over a 1–3 year horizon.
Distributed Training Leadership: Lead the implementation and optimization of Ray/AnyScale, providing a unified compute layer for batch processing, model training, and reinforcement learning.
High-Performance Inference: Design and maintain K8s-based inference servers (e.g., Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM) optimized for GPU memory management and high throughput.
Hardware & Cost Optimization: Navigate the trade-offs between different GPU instances (A100s, H100s, T4s), optimizing for cost, availability, and performance.
Cross-Team Standardization: Solve high-leverage problems that affect multiple pods (e.g., Entry, Session, Presentation), establishing reusable patterns for CI/CD, model versioning, and canary deployments.
Reliability Engineering: Define and enforce SLIs/SLOs for the platform, ensuring that infrastructure failures never interrupt the user-facing personalization experience.
Mentorship & Coaching: Act as a technical mentor to senior engineers across the ML Platform and Applied ML pods, raising the bar for system design and operational rigor.

Basic Qualifications

6-8+ years of experience in ML Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or high-scale Backend Engineering.
Orchestration & Serving: Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and serving frameworks for large-scale ML models.
Hardware Proficiency: Strong knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and optimizing ML workloads for hardware acceleration.
Leadership (IC4/5): Proven track record of owning the technical direction for a major domain anddriving impact across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infra-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) and building automated MLOps pipelines.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise with Ray (AnyScale) or similar distributed compute frameworks.
Familiarity with ML observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Weights & Biases, or MLFlow).
Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud ML environments.
Deep knowledge of Python and C++ for performance-critical systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

Unify the Compute Layer: Successfully transition the majority of AMLG training workloads to a governed AnyScale/Ray environment.
Optimize Inference ROI: Measurably improve GPU utilization and reduce inference costs through better auto-scaling and server optimization.
Establish Durable Standards: Author the "Gold Standard" for ML deployments that is adopted by at least three other pods in the organization.
Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures.
