job.title: Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports

Requirements

• Experience with managed network switches and IP-based systems. 

• Working knowledge of servers, workstations, and network infrastructure. 

• Understanding of TCP/IP networking, VPNs, and LAN environments. 

• Experience with Windows desktop and server operating systems. 

• Familiarity with broadcast equipment, production environments, RF systems, video and audio routing, automation, or digital transmission.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Master Control Operator
Location: Des Moines, IA
Power the moments that matter. Be at the center of live broadcasting.

At Sinclair, we’re not just airing content — we’re creating real-time connections between communities and the stories that impact them most. Our content technology is at the core of everything we do, and we’re pushing boundaries with cloud-first solutions, AI-driven workflows, and a culture built on innovation.

As we grow our network across broadcast, cable, and digital platforms, we’re looking for bold thinkers and sharp operators who thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments. If you’re passionate about precision, technology, and making sure every second of content looks flawless — we want you on our team.

We're hiring a Master Control Operator in Des Moines, IA to be a key player in our 24/7 operations hub. In this role, you’ll help drive the success of live news, sports, and special event broadcasts across multiple channels. It’s high energy, high impact — and no two days are the same.

What You’ll Do:

  • Operate the multi-channel Master Control room, managing live events, playlists, graphics, and automation systems.
  • Maintain seamless broadcasts by preparing, monitoring, and adjusting playlists in real time.
  • Execute precision switching for live news and sporting events.
  • Monitor on-air feeds to ensure content matches programming schedules and meets technical standards.
  • Ingest, record, and prepare content for broadcast with a strong focus on accuracy and timing.
  • Ensure proper routing of video sources and troubleshoot equipment issues as needed.
  • Keep detailed logs and documentation on air discrepancies, timing, and run times.
  • Communicate clearly and consistently with team members and management to support smooth shift transitions.
  • Stay sharp and adaptable in a mission-critical, fast-moving environment.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in Master Control operations or broadcast environments (1+ year preferred).
  • Familiarity with live event production, news switching, and local station workflows is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to juggle multiple feeds and priorities.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology including automation systems, switchers, servers, and signal monitoring tools.
  • Knowledge of industry standards related to audio, video, closed captioning, and loudness compliance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm under pressure.
  • Willingness to work any shift in a 24/7 operation, including weekends and holidays.
  • Experience with Amagi CLOUDPORT or similar cloud-based playout systems is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general computer applications.

Why Join Sinclair?

We believe the future of media lies at the intersection of great content, cutting-edge technology, and passionate people. At Sinclair, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in talent, and leads the way in local broadcasting. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, contribute to live moments that matter, and help shape the way millions of viewers experience news and entertainment.

If you're ready to take the reins in a fast-moving broadcast environment where accuracy, timing, and teamwork are everything — apply today and bring your talent to Sinclair.

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair:

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? We are looking for a storyteller to join our Pluto TV team in Mexico. The Marketing Coordinator will execute the brand strategy for Pluto TV across Mexico and the Spanish-speaking LATAM markets, supporting campaigns that build brand visibility and drive user engagement.

The Marketing Coordinator will support the strategic positioning and growth of the Pluto TV brand by helping execute innovative marketing initiatives. This role involves supporting the development of brand strategy and collaborating with content teams to align programming with brand identity. The Coordinator will help execute marketing campaigns that increase brand visibility and user engagement across paid, owned, and earned channels, while tracking performance metrics to inform ongoing optimization. Strong analytical, creative, communication, and project management skills are essential to successfully promote Pluto TV in a competitive landscape.

 

Responsibilities

  • Brand Strategy Support: Help execute a comprehensive brand strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Market Research & Analysis: Conduct market research to understand audience preferences and the competitive landscape.
  • Content Strategy: Collaborate with content teams to ensure programming aligns with brand positioning.
  • Campaign Execution: Help design and execute marketing campaigns that promote Pluto TV across social, paid marketing, and owned and operated channels, working closely with PR.
  • Social Strategy: Oversee all social strategy and actions for Pluto TV Mexico and Spanish-speaking LATAM.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor the performance of branding initiatives and use analytics to inform future strategies.

Skills

  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and market trends to support strategic decisions.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative skills to help develop engaging campaigns and brand messaging.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for internal collaboration and external marketing.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage projects from conception to execution and help evaluate outcomes.
  • Digital Marketing Proficiency: Knowledge of digital marketing tools and platforms relevant to streaming services.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree and/or relevant experience.
  • 3+ years working in marketing in the LATAM market.
  • Experience analyzing and interpreting data, and using insights to inform marketing efforts.
  • Experience supporting or reporting on metrics and KPIs for business goals, process improvement projects, and campaign management.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams.
  • Fluency in English.

job.title: WGA Producer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a WGA Planning Producer to help direct and manage our streaming network’s daily coverage line-up. From scheduling correspondents and camera positions to coordinating live interviews and future-event logistics, and jumping in during breaking news, this role is a key part of our live programming team and reports to the Editorial Director. This is a New York-based position that is covered under the Collective Bargaining Agreement with the WGA-E.   The ideal candidate has a demonstrated ability to coordinate with editorial leaders and live-show producers, as well as newsgathering stakeholders, field producers and correspondents, to ideate, plan and bring to air same-day and future coverage. The planning producer will collaborate with production and publishing units across streaming, network news and digital, and will also be a point of contact working with partners as well as Paramount Global properties.   As a hardworking journalist, the producer is equally interested in domestic and international news, and thrives on organization and attention to detail. You enjoy working in a fast-paced news environment, pitching original ideas daily, researching segments and pre-producing special coverage, and rising to the occasion during breaking news events.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate with assignment desk, booking team, show producers, domestic and international bureau editors on the planning of day-to-day programming and major news events
  • Identify and pitch stories with high potential for compelling and comprehensive live video storytelling, including day-of-air, special and feature segments
  • Identify key events for future coverage planning
  • Collaborate with digital reporters to develop original segments based on their reporting
  • Gather and flag elements during breaking news as needed
  • Contribute to the streaming network’s news event and coverage calendar
  • Communicate coverage plans to streaming-network and broadcast stakeholders
  • Work closely with the Editorial Director and Senior leadership team to plan coverage for live events & specials

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years work experience in either a broadcast or streaming television newsroom, ideally at the national level with some segment producing experience
  • Hands on newsroom experience scheduling correspondents, booking studios, and gathering elements during breaking news
  • Fluent and knowledge of current events, politics and pop culture
  • Availability to work all shifts, including early morning, nights, weekends and holidays, on short notice and as coverage needs require, as this is a 24-hour news operation

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Basic understanding of control room operations
  • Ability to communicate with anchors, correspondents and producers in the field
  • Familiarity and working knowledge of digital video production-related techniques and online content management
  • Knowledge about social media and the competitive digital news environment
  • Familiarity with ENPS & iNews

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We are looking for a Product Manager who combines strong product management skills with deep expertise in Display advertising, programmatic ecosystems, and paid ads. You will lead strategic initiatives across our display and paid ads portfolio, helping thousands of Enterprise and SMB advertisers improve performance through programmatic optimization, automation, and platform innovation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who can identify opportunities, define strategy, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to build scalable solutions that improve advertiser outcomes, optimize inventory monetization, and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

• Own and execute a significant portion of the Display and Paid Ads product roadmap.

• Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and platform changes that should inform roadmap investments across the programmatic landscape.

• Define product strategy for programmatic bidding, O&O display inventory monetization, automation, measurement, and advertiser-facing capabilities.

• Evaluate emerging trends in programmatic display, AI, and digital advertising to identify opportunities for product innovation and inventory packaging.

Product Execution & Delivery

• Lead initiatives from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.

• Translate business challenges and customer needs into clear product requirements, user flows, success metrics, and rollout plans.

• Partner directly with Engineering and Data Science to deliver scalable product solutions.

• Balance customer value, business impact, and technical complexity when making prioritization decisions.

• Own key business metrics including revenue growth, advertiser retention, campaign performance, inventory utilization, platform adoption, and profitability across assigned products.

AI, Optimization & Measurement

• Drive innovation across programmatic bidding strategies, yield optimization, automation, and display asset recommendations.

• Translate emerging AdTech, SSP/DSP capabilities, and industry innovations into differentiated product experiences.

• Define measurement frameworks and success metrics to evaluate product effectiveness and campaign viewability.

• Use data and experimentation to inform product investments and improve advertiser performance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to ensure successful activation and adoption of new display capabilities.

• Build alignment across stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.

• Present product strategy, recommendations, tradeoffs, and outcomes to leadership teams.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of product management experience delivering customer-facing, platform, SaaS, or technology products.

• 3+ years of experience in digital advertising with a specific focus on Display and Programmatic advertising. Experience with programmatic exchanges, SSPs/DSPs, campaign optimization, and automation is strongly preferred.

• Deep understanding of the programmatic landscape, including bidding strategies, yield optimization, viewability, attribution, conversion tracking, and AI-driven campaign management.

• Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to deliver products from concept through launch.

• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product strategies and execution plans.

• Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams.

• Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with ad serving platforms (e.g., Google Ad Manager, Equativ, Xandr) and inventory packaging strategies.

• Experience optimizing Owned & Operated (O&O) inventory and working with creative display formats.

• Experience building AI-powered, automation, optimization, recommendation, or workflow-based products.

• Experience working with Data Science teams, experimentation frameworks, or machine learning concepts.

• Familiarity with SQL, analytics platforms, or data-driven product development.

• Experience serving SMB advertisers at scale.

• Experience working in agency technology, advertising technology, marketing technology, or Google Partner environments.

job.title: Deputy Photo Editor
job.description:
Deputy Director of Visuals, San Antonio Express-News

 The deputy director of visuals helped to lead daily operations of the department to ensure an audience-driven focus on informative and engaging photography and videos, with a mission to increase engagement and enhance the visual quality of our digital and print news reports. The position reports to the regional director of visuals, Michel Fortier.

Major daily responsibilities: 

  • Edit visual content for quality, accuracy and relevance across platforms.
  • Coordinate scheduling and logistics for daily assignments and breaking news.
  • Collaborate across departments to seek out visual opportunities.
  • Help manage and coach visual journalists.
  • Coordination with the audience team on initiatives to build audience. 
  • Daily presentation of visuals in the afternoon budget meeting
  • Editing of video projects as needed


Attributes needed for success: 

  • Audience-first mentality, willingness to experiment with new story forms to promote digital audience engagement with print as a secondary element.
  • Understanding of social media as a tool to increase our reach, emphasizing work which puts audience growth first
  • Editing ability for both daily, short and long-term projects for digital and print.  
  • Sense of urgency and the ambition to win the 24/7 news cycle on digital platforms
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure.
  • Adherence to journalistic ethics.
  • Knowledge of communications law as it applies to photography.
  • Working knowledge of photo software programs such as Photoshop, Premiere Pro and Photo Mechanic.
  • A passion for journalism that elevates and motives others. 


Requirements: 

  • Hybrid, 40 hours a week, with four-day-per-week in-office requirement.
  • Some weekend, evening and holiday work will be required.
  • A minimum of 3 years of visuals experience within a news organization. 
  • Previous supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, photography, video or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted.
  • Ability to edit video on deadline when needed.

 

About the San Antonio Express-News

The Express-News is the third-largest daily newspaper in Texas and the only daily in San Antonio. It serves a metro area of 2.5 million people. By one name or another, it traces its roots back to 1865. Over the past three years, the paper has reorganized to focus on digital journalism and substantially increased the audience for its subscriber website, ExpressNews.com. Over the same period, the Express-News has won a George Polk Award, two IRE (Investigative Reporters and Editors) Awards, and numerous regional and state journalism prizes.

It is part of Hearst, a diversified global media, services and information business. Hearst Newspaper Group includes the Express-News, the Houston Chronicle, the Austin American-Statesman, the San Francisco Chronicle, the Albany Times Union and other daily and weekly papers.

job.title: Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement
job.description:
Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement to lead the next chapter of our digital strategy.

This senior leader will oversee efforts to grow and deepen audiences for the Houston Chronicle across video, engagement and conversation, social platforms, emerging platforms, local trends and trending content. The role will help transform viewers, listeners, readers and commenters into loyal fans of our journalism—and build meaningful relationships with audiences across Houston.

We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about audiences: what they need, how they discover information, what makes them return and how journalism can better serve them. This leader should be able to articulate a clear, actionable philosophy for digital growth and translate that philosophy into newsroom strategy, daily operations and measurable results.

This is a hands-on role for a creative, data-informed and operationally minded digital leader who is comfortable with experimentation, change and scale. The successful candidate will understand that the audience strategies that worked in the past will not be enough for the future. As search traffic declines and platform and consumer habits continue to evolve, this leader will help us build new ways for audiences to discover, engage with and depend on our work.

This is an opportunity to bring your vision to a senior leadership team boldly reimagining what local news can be. You will help make the Houston Chronicle a powerhouse of digital journalism—one that serves all of Houston and remains essential for years to come.

As a member of the newsroom’s senior leadership team and masthead, the Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement will help shape strategy across the organization. This role reports to the editor-in-chief and oversees teams focused on video, audience growth and engagement, local trends and trending content, and social media.

You’ll join our news organization at a pivotal moment.

The Medill School at Northwestern recently named our newsroom a Bright Spot in Local Journalism. The American Press Institute recently included us in a creators cohort, and we wrote about our experiences innovating with creators. We were named the Best Newsroom in Texas for 2026 and were finalists for ONA Awards for innovative journalism and INMA’s Global Media Awards for newsroom innovation.

Some newsrooms are talking about change. We’re actually changing. Join us.

The Responsibilities

  • Lead audience growth and engagement strategy across platforms, formats and content teams.

  • Develop new strategies for audience discovery and loyalty as search declines and traditional content distribution models evolve.
  • Help the newsroom move beyond legacy content strategies by identifying new opportunities in video, audio, social, newsletters, communities, emerging platforms, creators and other forms of audience connection.
  • Articulate a clear point of view on digital growth and turn it into actionable plans, priorities and operating practices.
  • Coach teams and ideas with metrics at the forefront of decision-making; establish goals, evaluate performance and use audience data to guide experimentation and investment.
  • Build strategies that move audiences from casual discovery to sustained engagement and loyalty.
  • Understand how to grow fans on different platforms and operationalize effective tactics across the newsroom.
  • Lead and support experimentation, taking smart risks and learning quickly from what works and what doesn’t.
  • Embrace AI across the organization to help journalists with their work, improve audience understanding and drive innovation.
  • Work collaboratively with the managing editor of news and strategy to oversee the daily operations of the newsroom.
  • Champion inclusive reporting that reflects the diversity of Houston, with strategies and journalism designed to serve communities—not simply report about them.
  • Demonstrate collaborative, creative and transformational leadership centered on learning, strong journalism and innovation.
  • Push the organization to bring new approaches to old problems and explore new platforms, possibilities and audience relationships.

  • Partner across editorial, product, technology, marketing, analytics and business teams to align audience strategy with the organization’s broader goals.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Significant experience leading audience growth, engagement, digital strategy or a related function in a news or media organization.

  • A strong understanding of how audiences discover, consume and engage with journalism across platforms.
  • Experience developing new growth strategies in a rapidly changing digital environment
  • Proven track record of developing viewership around franchise shows and YouTube strategy
  • A track record of using data, experimentation and audience insights to improve reach, engagement and loyalty.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and a deep respect for journalism and public service.
  • Comfort working across strategy and execution, with the ability to move from a big-picture vision to daily operational decisions.
  • A creative, entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for emerging platforms, technology and AI.
  • A commitment to inclusive journalism and serving the full breadth of Houston’s communities.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

To Apply

As part of your cover letter, please explain your philosophy of audience growth and engagement. Please also share specific examples of how you have driven digital growth and built meaningful relationships with new readers, listeners or viewers, particularly through strategies that went beyond traditional search or legacy distribution models.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

job.title: Customer Service Rep- CCLI (Vancouver)
job.description:
Christian Copyright Licensing International (CCLI) is seeking a Customer Service Representative to join our team in Vancouver, Washington. In this role you will be responsible for supporting customer needs by answering questions, providing information on CCLI licenses and services, as well as first level technical support. In addition, the Customer Service Representative contacts existing customers to ensure retention, processes orders for new and renewing licenses and services, and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Responds to large volumes of incoming calls and written communications to ensure timely and accurate responses to customer needs.
  • Asks qualifying questions to properly identify the needs of current and prospective customers, educates and recommends appropriate products and services as solutions, answers questions, resolves objections in order to successfully renew or issue new license.
  • Follows up on leads, responds to inquiries and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and expertise to license holders/customers by confidently and accurately providing information about CCLI’s suite of product offerings and services (including CVLI and ScreenVue), terms and conditions, church music offerings, rights owner information, and copyright law.
  • Assists customers with license renewals, identifies and fulfills product and service needs.
  • Instructs customers in the proper application of CCLI licenses, completion of responsibilities and the use of tools to access song, publisher and resource information.
  • Answers questions regarding licensees’ activity reporting and clarifies procedures, and assists IP department on reporting accuracy for royalty payouts.
  • Ensures customer accounts and profile information is properly updated in computer databases/software systems.
  • Maintains current knowledge of products and services, and customer service best practices through ongoing training and education in areas of responsibility.
  • Provides first level technical support to customers for CCLI’s online services.
  • Informs supervisor about customer concerns and escalates difficult customer contacts as needed. 
  • Special project and duties as assigned.

 

What Makes You Qualified:

  • High School diploma or two years of equivalent work experience in customer service.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
  • Fluency in Spanish or a territorial second language desired.
  • Critical thinking skills with ability to apply sound judgment.
  • Highly organized, ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
  • Solutions oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; able to work professionally with coworkers and customers. 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite. Confident working with and learning new technologies. Ability to adjust to varying workloads.
  • Basic knowledge of copyright law, Christian music, and related terminologies is helpful.

 

The duties listed above are not all inclusive. This job description is not intended to cover all aspects of the responsibilities of the job. The position is expected to perform other work-related duties as assigned even though they may not be considered essential functions or specifically identified in this description.

 

This is currently a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Vancouver, Washington office a minimum of three days a week.

Business Process Improvements

  • Identify “root cause” of the issues and suggest strategies to resolve

  • Collaborate closely & coordinate with various teams on joint work items (including IS&T and off-shore partners)

  • Ability to analyze and review information from several different sources (corporate systems)

  • Capable of working independently, while also integrating into a team environment
  • Solid understanding of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel

job.title: VP, Commerce, Latin/Iberia - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The VP, Commerce, Latin-Iberia is an entrepreneurial commercial leader responsible for developing and executing the region’s commerce strategy across digital platforms, physical, direct-to-consumer, YouTube Ad Sales, and brand partnerships. The role will identify scalable growth opportunities, strengthen platform relationships, and translate market insight into measurable revenue for clients and the company.

Reporting to the SVP, Co-Managing Directors, Latin-Iberia, this executive will work in close partnership with Relationship Managers and territory leaders to align commerce priorities with each client’s objectives, release plans, and broader business strategy. Relationship Managers retain primary ownership of the client relationship and client communication; the VP, Commerce serves as their senior commercial partner, providing platform expertise, actionable insights, and tailored growth solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Regional Commerce Strategy: Build and own the Latin-Iberia commerce roadmap, operating model, and KPIs. Translate global company priorities into regionally relevant plans and ensure disciplined execution across territories.
  • Relationship Management Partnership: Partner closely with Relationship Managers to understand client objectives, release priorities, and business needs. Develop tailored commerce strategies and opportunities that strengthen client outcomes and drive revenue, while ensuring Relationship Managers retain primary ownership of the overall client relationship and communication.
  • Platform Strategy & Partnerships: Lead senior-level relationships and commercial strategy across DSPs and other key platforms. Shape regional platform priorities, secure high-impact opportunities, and build initiatives that improve visibility, engagement, monetization, and market share.
  • Multi-Channel Revenue Growth: Identify and execute opportunities across streaming, physical, D2C, YouTube Ad Sales, and brand partnerships. Connect these pillars into cohesive commercial plans tailored to each market and client.
  • Territory Leadership & Coordination: Work with local territory leaders and Commerce teams to establish priorities, share best practices, remove executional blockers, and ensure consistent regional standards while respecting local market dynamics.
  • Data, Insights & Scalable Execution: Partner with Analytics and business teams to embed data-driven decision-making into commercial planning. Use tools, automation, audience and platform insights, and performance reporting to identify opportunities and improve execution at scale.
  • Financial & Performance Accountability: Establish revenue targets, forecasts, and performance indicators for regional Commerce initiatives. Track results, communicate risks and opportunities, and recommend adjustments based on measurable business impact.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the regional Commerce team, fostering commercial creativity, accountability, collaboration, and a strong service mindset toward Relationship Management teams and clients

Who you are:

  • Industry Experience: 12+ years of relevant experience in music distribution, digital commerce, platform partnerships, commercial strategy, or related fields, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep understanding of the Latin American and Iberian music markets, including their commercial dynamics, cultural differences, platform ecosystems, and client needs.
  • Platform & Channel Knowledge: Strong knowledge of DSPs and other commerce channels, including physical, D2C, and brand partnerships.
  • Relationship-Driven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through partnership with Relationship Managers, territory leaders, clients, platforms, and cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience with revenue planning, forecasting, performance measurement, and the use of data and insights to prioritize opportunities and drive business growth.
  • Executive Communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex commercial ideas clearly and credibly to senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Spanish required; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Travel & Availability: Availability to travel within the Latin-Iberia region as needed for meetings with clients and artists, business engagements, industry events, and awards ceremonies.

What We Give You

  • You’ll join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey.
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA). A group created by a group of our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • We invest in your professional growth & development
  • Time off for a winter recess

Job Title: Sr. Analyst, Financial

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music Group's Global Business Services (GBS) is home to the finance operations, legal, and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our global Finance labels and affiliates. Each regional center embodies the collaboration and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in cultivating entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities.   • Take an active role in team development by guiding analysts, providing ongoing review feedback, and facilitating training sessions for new hires to demonstrate standard processes in Participations accounting.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships across the company—from label finance and legal teams to senior executives—acting as a trusted partner with a high degree of professional IQ and responsiveness.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the department by identifying inefficiencies and implementing solutions supported by modern tools. You will champion automation initiatives and process improvements that drive team-wide excellence and scalable growth.

Distribution Operations is responsible for all physical supply chain processes across the entirety of product lines under WEA Distribution.  The department’s core focus is to work cohesively with all WMG divisions and departments globally, as well as outside vendors, carriers, and label partners, to ensure that the highest quality of products are distributed to customers in a timely manner. Key functions shared by the Distribution Operations team include inventory management, manufacturing, order fulfillment, compliance, and logistics.

The Manager of Inventory Operations, plays a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of   physical product distribution at Warner Music Canada across both Retail and D2C platforms ensuring that artists’ music and products reach fans efficiently, on time, and across all platforms.  This role oversees the end-to-end workflows of inventory management to freight invoice processing.  You will collaborate cross-functionally with Warner Music Canada’s internal teams (A&R, Marketing, Sales, and Finance) to streamline operations, optimize processes, and drive overall efficiency across the label’s business lines. ●       Monitor and forecast product demand, coordinating with supply chain partners to minimize overstock or shortages

●       Maintain release schedules and ensure all operational deliverables are met on time.

●       Approve invoices and provide accounting info for freight and Distribution Accruals

●       Provide returns forecast for Accounting

●       Track and report on sales trends.

●    You have a history of excelling in fast-paced, high-energy environments.

●    You look beyond the obvious, ask thought-provoking questions, and provide valid solutions.

●       Possess SAP Purchasing and Invoicing experience.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day. SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America. As the combined advertising revenue organization of Sirius XM Holdings Inc.,

SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBCUniversal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Account Manager is a key contributor on SXM Media’s Client Services team that drives and defends revenue by being a trusted client partner and resource working with internal and external partners to independently design, execute, monitor, and optimize advertising campaigns across a portfolio of Advertisers/Agencies. The right individual will be highly effective in communication, organization, and critical thinking, while thriving in an ever-evolving, fast-paced environment. Your team will include thoughtful, problem-solving individuals who are passionate about growing the SiriusXM Media brands. This role applies developing professional expertise, company policies, and established procedures to resolve a variety of client, campaign, creative, technical, billing, and delivery issues.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and cultivate positive business relationships with clients and sales, creative design team, sales research, and technical teams.
  • Partner with sales team to develop ideas and materials for Proposals/Avail submissions including media recommendations, research, competitive data, and advise on what is technically feasible to execute. Evaluate client objectives, inventory, product mix, technical requirements, and revenue impact to recommend appropriate campaign solutions.
  • Be a product expert, know your client and the right SXM Media products that will meet their marketing needs and drive positive results.
  • Ensure revenue goals consistently inform all facets of account management; design and execute media plans and campaigns; work directly with client on all pre-launch elements related to creative specifications and submission. Independently manage defined campaign tasks and apply judgment within established procedures to determine next steps, resolve variances, and escalate risks when needed.
  • Create and manage creative and technical production timelines with Advertisers/Agencies and asset delivery to ensure campaigns launch in a timely manner.
  • Work with internal traffickers, creative design, and client as needed to troubleshoot any ad creative issues that impact tracking, implementation, or reporting. Review campaign data and partner inputs to diagnose issues of moderate scope and recommend practical solutions.
  • Be the frontline on all booked revenue to monitor campaign delivery and pacing; escalate issues when applicable. Proactively identify delivery risks, communicate options to internal and external partners, and support corrective action to protect revenue and client outcomes.
  • Collaborate with billing team to resolve monthly invoicing queries.
  • Provide necessary campaign deliverables including but not limited to: reporting, screenshots, and ad-hoc requests.
  • Coordinate work with internal resources as necessary to support campaign execution, timelines, and issue resolution.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience in digital/radio/mobile advertising operations or account management.
  • Extremely proactive and highly organized, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple and varied tasks and campaigns in a timely manner.
  • Excellent client service and verbal and written communication skills; results driven with strong analytical skills.
  • Knowledge of pre- and post-sale process and creation of media plans; experience with custom display, mobile, audio, and video advertising products.
  • Experience working within internal order management systems and third-party systems including ad servers.
  • Ability to analyze campaign, client, and operational inputs to resolve a variety of issues and determine appropriate action within defined procedures and practices.
  • Enjoy working in a collaborative team environment, sharing knowledge across the department.
  • Areas of experience that are preferred but not essential include: knowledge of programmatic transactions; performance campaign management handling conversion data and related ad technology.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the annual salary for this this position to be between $60,000 - $82,350 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

job.title: Deputy Director, Photo
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

T Magazine is looking for a temporary deputy photo director with experience in print and digital storytelling.

You will assign photography covering a wide array of subject matter and photographic genres including fashion, portraits, interiors, travel and still lifes. You have experience producing editorial photoshoots involving studios, set builds, hair and makeup, location scouting, casting, and wardrobe. You have strong knowledge of photographers around the world.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • In partnership with the Director of Photography, produce photo shoots for all sections of the magazine and website including fashion, interiors, travel and still lifes.
  • Source freelance photographers, producers, stylists, hair and makeup artists, set builders, prop designers, location scouts, casting agents, animal handlers, and fabricators for photo shoots.
  • Handle several projects simultaneously that span the areas of fashion, travel, still life, interiors, portraits, and special packages.
  • Manage photo editors working in photo research, art commissions and digital shoots.
  • Maintain budgets and contracts for photo shoots; process and approve invoices for photo shoots in a timely manner.
  • Partner with the Director of Photography to negotiate fees with vendors such as studios, photo labs and photo agencies.
  • Work with the editorial and design teams to produce multimedia features.
  • Meet with photographers, gallerists, photography agents and book publishers to find new photographers and keep up with trends in the art world.
  • Do portfolio reviews and mentoring to find new photographers.
  • Mentor junior members of the photo department.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Photo Director.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years producing creative photography including fashion, interiors, travel, and still lifes for print and digital.
  • Experience liaising well with top editors, writers, designers, and photo editors while producing shoots.
  • Knowledge of journalistic ethics, standards, and practices.
  • Knowledge of the top creatives working in the fields of art, photography, and video.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience recognizing, developing, and recruiting new talent.
  • Experience working across multiple platforms including photography, video, multimedia, and social media.
  • Experience managing a team and advising junior staff editors.
  • Must work well with editorial and creative teams.
  • Willingness to work nights and weekends as needed.

job.title: Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Program Manager to join Translation!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.


What You'll Do

  • Own the how. Develop scopes, timelines, budgets and delivery systems for programs ranging from complex to “simple.” Don’t assume one size fits all. 
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings throughout the lifecycle of the program, and maintain close coordination with key stakeholders, including Business Leadership and Production.
  • Deliver strategic and creative deliverables directly to day to day clients. Own contact reports, internally and back to the client.
  • Manage talent allocations week over week. Work with the Group Engagement Director and Business Leadership to ensure programs are planned to achieve successful completion, including coming in on time and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal teams, ensure high quality delivery, and manage back to overarching strategy of the engagement.
  • Develop a strong understanding of client’s business and industry, key competitors, and audience demographics.
  • Help maintain integrated ways of working by reinforcing team processes and managing documentation and communications.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality. You take immense pride in your work. You’re results-driven and detail-oriented, but also passionate about people, culture, and creativity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, accurately, and succinctly.
  • Stellar time management and organizational skills, able to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Thick-skinned, persistent, and diplomatic—you handle challenges with optimism and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable navigating across multiple internal disciplines (creative, production, strategy) and external partners to keep projects moving forward.
  • An understanding of when to escalate challenges and opportunities to the appropriate leads.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a creative agency or similar communications environment, with a strong understanding of advertising, marketing, media, production, and agency finance.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns across broadcast, digital, experiential and/or social.
  • Experience supporting or leading calls with cross-functional agency teams and interfacing directly with clients.
  • Fluent in Google Suite (especially Sheets and Slides); experience with resource management or workforce planning, as well as project planning tools.
  • Strong curiosity with a strong desire to learn and engage AI tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience directly managing timelines and deliverables for creative and production workstreams.
  • Exposure to or direct experience with production processes.
  • Acted as a producer or account executive in an agency environment with client facing
  • A passion for culture, innovation, and helping brands show up meaningfully in the world.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.title: Vice President, Publicity and Communications GSA, Paramount Direct to Consumer
job.description:
Paramount is looking for a Vice President of Publicity and Communications to lead publicity for Paramount+ and Pluto TV, based in Berlin — one of Europe's largest and most competitive entertainment markets. Reporting to the SVP, Publicity and Communications for EMEA, this leader will develop and execute best-in-class publicity strategies that spark global cultural conversation, drive subscriber acquisition, and establish Paramount+ Originals and Pluto TV as must-watch television — translating that success into measurable outcomes including media impressions, social engagement, brand elevation, and industry credibility. This is a hybrid role for a senior strategist who's equally comfortable counseling global leadership and getting hands-on with campaign execution: sharpening a press line, briefing talent, or walking into a room of senior stakeholders and owning it. 

Role responsibilities:

  • Campaign strategy, start to finish. Lead comprehensive publicity campaigns for Paramount+ Original series — scripted and unscripted — from announcement through premiere and across full season runs, plus publicity for Pluto TV's diverse, always-on programming slate. Design 360-degree strategies spanning traditional media, digital platforms, social, podcasts, and emerging channels, and advise on premiere timing and launch windows to maximize impact.
  • Media relations at the top table. Serve as the primary media relations lead, building and maintaining relationships with top-tier entertainment journalists, critics, trade press, podcasters, and digital influencers. Secure high-value placements across broadcast morning shows, late-night, major publications, and digital platforms, while overseeing all press materials — releases, alerts, talent bios, and pitch materials.
  • Talent relationships built on trust. Work directly with agents, managers, and personal publicists to align on campaign goals and secure press participation. Navigate complex talent dynamics with diplomacy, prepare talent for media appearances, and coordinate availability for interviews, photoshoots, and events across global markets.
  • Press events that generate real coverage. Conceptualize and execute high-impact premieres, screenings, junkets, and experiential activations — serving as on-site lead and overseeing press list development, credentials, and event collateral.
  • A team that delivers. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of publicity professionals, while partnering seamlessly with Marketing, Creative, Awards, Social Media, Events, and Content teams to ensure every campaign is fully integrated.
  • Budget with accountability. Manage the publicity budget in partnership with department leadership, allocate resources across multiple titles to maximize ROI, and negotiate agency and vendor contracts.
  • A seat at the global table. Be the senior voice representing Berlin and the German market inside a global matrix — aligning local publicity strategy with worldwide campaigns for Paramount+ Originals and Pluto TV, and representing Paramount+ at industry events.

What you will bring:

  • 10+ years of progressive entertainment publicity experience across television, streaming, or film — with a portfolio of campaigns that achieved significant media coverage and measurable business impact. Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or related field.
  • Publicity leadership built for the German market — one of the most competitive entertainment landscapes in Europe — backed by an extensive network across entertainment journalism, trade press, and digital media.
  • A track record of managing senior stakeholders across global markets, leading cross-functional teams, and building or reshaping agency relationships that deliver.
  • Sophisticated strategic vision: the ability to spot cultural moments, build multi-phase campaigns, and craft narratives that break through a crowded streaming landscape — paired with the business acumen to tie publicity directly to subscriber acquisition and brand impact.
  • Proven talent relations instincts — known for diplomacy, discretion, and building trust with high-profile creators and performers — plus experience navigating crisis communications with calm, sound judgment.
  • Comfort operating inside a fast-moving global matrix organization: equally credible counseling senior leadership and rolling up your sleeves when a launch is 48 hours out. Highly organized, deadline-driven, and adaptable to shifting priorities and timelines.
  • Digital fluency across social platforms, influencer landscape, and campaign analytics, with the flexibility to work evenings, holidays, and weekends around events and premieres.

Position Overview
This entry-level role provides essential clerical and technical support to the news production team. Freelance Production Assistants operate the teleprompter during live newscasts, manage and organize archival materials, and assist with daily newsroom communications. Successful candidates show drive, curiosity, and enthusiasm for journalism and local news while upholding high standards of professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Operate teleprompter and assist technical staff during live or recorded broadcasts
  • Locate, catalogue, and retrieve file video and archival material
  • Answer phones, relay information, and handle general office tasks
  • Run newsroom errands and assist with set logistics as needed

Cross-Training Opportunities
Cross-training and advancement opportunities may be available for freelance Production Assistants who excel but are not guaranteed parts of this position.  Our goal is to help freelance Production Assistants expand their skills and grow into other newsroom roles through cross-training. Those who consistently demonstrate drive, initiative, and enthusiasm will be considered for advancement opportunities as they develop professionally.

  • Writing news copy for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Managing and creating posts for social media accounts
  • Editing video and audio for broadcast
  • Operating technical production equipment
  • Supporting the Assignment Desk: story research, pitching, and newsroom coordination

Desired Qualities

  • Demonstrated enthusiasm, initiative, and excitement for new opportunities
  • Strong curiosity about news, journalism, and broadcast media
  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a motivated team
  • Willingness to work flexible hours - including mornings, nights, and weekends
  • Reliability, punctuality, and professionalism are essential


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS WITH NORAH O’DONNELL, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.description:
Job Title

GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization

Job Description

About The Position :

The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution.

As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine.

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team:

The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution.

About The Position’s Contributions:

35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory

  • Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible.

  • Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog.

35% GTM Program Management & Training

  • Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks.

  • Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it.

30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly analyze internal sales data and product adoption metrics. Identify which packages are driving the highest yield and surface trends regarding what is selling well versus what isn't.

  • On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

  • 4–7 years of experience in ad product operations, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, digital media project management, product marketing, commercial operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing cross-functional product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting revenue organizations within digital advertising, media, ad tech, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Relationship Building & Empathy: High emotional intelligence with a proven track record of earning trust across diverse commercial teams. Exceptional ability to act as a supportive, empathetic partner to quota-carrying sellers.

  • Program & Project Management: Highly organized with the disciplined capability to manage multiple moving parts of a launch simultaneously, enforce deadlines, and keep diverse stakeholders communicating effectively.

  • Product Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, ad tech, and sales lifecycles. Ability to quickly master technical ad product configurations and explain them simply to non-technical teams.

  • Data Curiosity: A natural inclination to look at sales spreadsheets, ask probing questions about revenue performance, and translate numbers into actionable insights for catalog optimization.

% Travel Required (Approximate): < 5%

Job Description :

The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The Post Digital Network is a top 10 digital news publisher in the United States. Our brands include the New York Post, California Post, Page Six, and Decider.
 

Who We Are Looking For:

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Paid Media Account Manager, Commerce to support our rapidly growing Paid Media business. This role is ideal for a post-sale champion who excels at client communication, project management, and operational execution within the performance marketing space.

In this role, you will be the strategic bridge between our brand partners, and internal sales and social teams. You will take the reins once a partnership is secured, ensuring successful partner onboarding and fast-turnaround campaign launches. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

Our team is a competitive and agile group that is first to react to market trends and opportunities. We use data-driven insights to guide decisions, combining sharp instincts and thorough analysis to drive success for both the business and our brand partners.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Client Communication & Onboarding: Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for brand and agency partners, onboarding them and managing ongoing communications.

  • Creative Review & Workflow Management: Review client creative assets, and ad copy to ensure compliance with both New York Post brand guidelines and social platform policies.

  • Internal Collaboration: Liaise closely with the Paid Media Sales team and coordinate with the internal Social team to fast-track creative approvals and asset delivery.

  • Campaign Launch & Quality Assurance: Oversee the technical setup and launch of paid media partnership through relevant platforms  (Meta Business Manager, TikTok Brand Access, etc.), ensuring all tracking and permissions are set up correctly.

  • Client Success: Act as an extension of your partners’ growth marketing teams through proactive communication, strategic collaboration, and optimization guidance.

  • Market Expertise: Stay ahead of the curve on social platform advertising trends, compliance shifts, and emerging digital opportunities.

  • Billing Support: Take ownership of the post-campaign financial lifecycle by assisting with monthly invoicing, spend tracking, and revenue reconciliation.

Requirements: 

  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: A master of execution who can track multiple client timelines, creative deadlines, and financial sheets without missing a beat. 

  • Exceptional Communicator: Highly professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage client expectations gracefully. 

  • Problem-Solver: Proactive in identifying potential campaign bottlenecks (e.g., ad rejections, tracking issues) and quick to implement solutions. 

  • Collaborative: A true team player who enjoys working cross-functionally across sales, editorial, social, and finance departments.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience in digital account management, client success, or ad operations.

  • Foundational understanding of the Paid Social ecosystems (e.g., Meta, TikTok), and Paid Search.

  • Comfortable working with data, Excel/Google Sheets, and analytics dashboards.

  • Basic experience with or understanding of digital media billing, tracking insertion orders (IOs), and monthly financial reconciliation.

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven media environment.

​Note: This role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of being on-site in the New York metro area three days per week (subject to change).
