job.title: Art Director
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

WMX, Warner Music Group's culture-driving merchandise, creative content, and artist services division, is a global full-service team that offers creative direction, production services, and support for WMG licensed artists and labels. As the Retail Art Director, you will step into a brand-new, highly strategic role designed to grow and develop our retail business strategy as a whole. You will act as the vital creative bridge on our team, working directly with our Creative Directors to align on artistic vision, while collaborating hand-in-hand with our Retail Sales team to build bespoke presentations for global retail partners. Your work will directly impact how our entire artist roster breaks into major retail spaces, transforming creative concepts into massive commercial realities.

Your role:

As Art Director at WMX, you’ll bring our artists’ visual worlds to life across music, fashion, and culture. You’ll focus directly on developing visual concepts, leading art direction for merch collections, and collaborating closely with both in-house talent and freelance creators. This role is fast-paced, hands-on, and deeply plugged into culture. You’ll be turning artist identities into compelling, fan-obsessed merchandise and visual assets across our roster.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Develop Visual & Art Direction: Create the visual language and offer creative mentorship for merch collections and campaigns. Confirm every concept reflects the artist's identity and resonates with their fanbase.

  • Lead the visual invention and curation of merchandise lines for artists represented by our company. Progress collections from initial aesthetic moodboards to fully realized visual concepts.

  • Guide In-House & Freelance Designers: Source, brief, and direct internal designers, outside studios, and specialized freelancers (illustrators, typographers, graphic designers). Provide clear feedback to elevate output and ensure visual consistency across all assets.

  • Partner with Artists & Management: Work directly with artists, managers, and internal brand teams to understand aesthetic goals and translate them into cohesive visual designs.

  • Ensure Visual Quality & Brand Consistency: Review and refine all art deliverables to ensure high aesthetic standards, on-brief execution, and visual harmony across product lineups.

  • Collaborate with Production & Operations: Partner with production teams to manage asset handover, review tech packs, and refine designs to align with physical production capabilities without compromising creative vision.

  • Stay Ahead of Visual & Fashion Trends: Maintain a deep awareness of emerging fashion, music, design, and subculture trends, continually infusing fresh visual ideas into our artist collections.

About you:

  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in art direction, graphic design, or brand design, preferably within retail, fashion, or corporate pitch-deck creation.

  • You have a proven track record of trend forecasting and a deep understanding of commercial retail landscapes and consumer behavior.

  • You have expert-level layout and presentation skills, with a portfolio that proves you can turn complex strategies into clean, beautiful, and compelling visual stories.

  • You enjoy acting as a bridge between highly conceptual creative ideas and business-driven commercial targets.

  • You are passionate about emerging fashion, design, and music culture, and you instinctively know how to translate those movements into retail-ready product ideas.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have expert knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and key presentation platforms like Keynote or PowerPoint.

  • You have a deep passion for fashion and product design

  • You have experience designing mockups for apparel, retail packaging, or point-of-sale displays.

  • You have a passion for emerging creative tools, trends, and technologies (AI, AR, motion, etc.) and how they can elevate storytelling


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.title: Paperhandler (Casual)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

#LI-Onsite 

The New York Times is an international brand that prints nine daily newspapers. These are printed at our Print Plant in College Point, Queens, and distributed to the New York Metropolitan area and the Eastern Seaboard. Our daily work is guided by our mission and values. 

We are looking for a part-time casual Paperhandler with in-depth knowledge of all Paperhandler equipment and multiple newsprint roll types for commercial printing. You will undergo a training period, after which you will read work orders or receive instructions to determine work assignments, material, and equipment requirements. You will be reporting to the Deputy Plant Manager and you will report to work onsite at our Printing facility in College Point, Queens, New York. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Ensure that all paper rolls for the nine daily newspapers are handled and transported safely. 
  • Work in a Union production environment with deadlines on a daily basis. 
  • Take inventory of paper rolls and prepare them for use in the printing facility. 
  • Ensure that all paper rolls are stacked according to safety regulations. 
  • Operate Paperhandler equipment safely while working with extreme care and caution. 
  • You must maintain a clean environment in the paper storage area. 
  • You must follow all safety guidelines and report any accidents or incidents to the supervisor. 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Must be willing to work flexible hours in a Union production environment on a daily basis. 
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. 
  • Can stand and walk for 8-10 hours per shift and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be willing to undergo a background check. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience in a production environment. 
  • The ability to work with different types of paperhandler equipment. 
  • The ability to work in a team environment. 

This role is a union role represented by the Paperhandlers and Straighteners Union.

job.title: SVP, Product
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.

Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.

Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.

The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.

As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. This leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
  • Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
  • Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.

Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.

Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.

What we’re looking for:

  • A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
  • A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
  • Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
  • Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
  • Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
  • A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
  • The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.
  • The ability to distinguish a meaningful product opportunity from an interesting AI demo.

Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $285,000 - $315,000, plus a 25% bonus, and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend

  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers

  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. job.title: Senior Director - Integrated Marketing & Growth
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

At SoundCloud, we believe growth is not the responsibility of a single channel. Growth happens when products, experiences, customer journeys, marketing channels, creators, communities, and partnerships work together as a unified system.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Integrated Marketing & Growth to oversee SoundCloud's growth marketing ecosystem and connect every customer touchpoint into a unified engine that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and advocacy. In this role, you will build SoundCloud's growth operating system, own the end-to-end customer journey strategy, and lead performance, lifecycle, and organic growth channel strategy, while ensuring our platform remains discoverable in a world increasingly shaped by AI-powered search and recommendation engines. Working closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Community, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Executive Leadership, you will drive integrated campaign orchestration across the business, modernize marketing measurement and experimentation, and build and lead a high-performing growth organization.

Reporting to the Chief Growth & Marketing Officer, you will be ultimately responsible for how users discover, engage with, subscribe to, and advocate for SoundCloud,  maximizing long-term customer value across our entire ecosystem.

Above all, we're looking for a builder — someone who can connect people, teams, channels, and ideas into a growth engine that helps more creators and fans find success on SoundCloud.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days/week in our NYC office.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and lead the growth operating system, processes, and planning rhythms that unify efforts across Product, Marketing, Community, Partnerships, and Analytics into coordinated, scalable strategies, with clear prioritization and resource allocation
  • Refine end-to-end creator and fan journeys to eliminate friction, bridge conversion gaps, and partner cross-functionally to accelerate activation, engagement, retention, and lifetime value — tying marketing efforts to customer behaviors, not just channel activity
  • Own the overarching performance strategy for acquisition, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and conversion optimization, while expanding emerging discovery channels including SEO, AI search, AEO, App Store Optimization, and growth loops
  • Lead integrated campaign orchestration across major product launches and brand moments (in close partnership with Product Marketing) establishing repeatable frameworks to sync execution across paid, owned, earned, and product surfaces
  • Modernize measurement and attribution alongside Analytics and Data Science by advancing incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, forecasting, LTV frameworks, and growth scorecards for the executive team
  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing growth organization grounded in a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and data-driven accountability

Experience and Background:

  • 10+ years in Growth Marketing, Growth Strategy, Integrated Marketing, consumer technology, marketplaces, or platform businesses
  • Experience leading large-scale acquisition, retention, and lifecycle programs for subscription or consumer businesses
  • Demonstrated success building growth systems, operating models, and cross-functional organizations
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, measurement, attribution, and growth analytics
  • Experience managing complex customer journeys and multi-channel ecosystems
  • Fluent with AI tools and comfortable building them into growth, discovery, and measurement workflows
  • Strong strategic thinking paired with operational excellence
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influence skills
  • A real passion for creators, music, technology, and culture

The salary range for this role is $210,000 - $260,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

What You'll Need:

  •   Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required.
  •  The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be.
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  •   General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  •            Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  •    Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  •   Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  •   Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  •   Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, including a floating holiday that enable our teams to celebrate the holiday of their choosing, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  •   Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

Job Title:  Morning Show Co-Host - WNGC Athens Radio

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

 

Please include your Air Check Package with application!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Co-host a live, personality-driven morning show that delivers compelling storytelling, listener interaction, local content, interviews, and engaging entertainment.
  • Develop and execute daily content plans, recurring features, story arcs, and digital content across social, video, web, and podcast platforms.
  • Voice-track assigned shifts and create commercial, promotional, and endorsement content as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.

  • Understanding of audience retention, content pacing, teasing, show momentum, and the Country radio audience.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.
  • Proficiency creating social media and video content across multiple digital platforms.
  • Creative, prepared, coachable, and able to collaborate effectively within a morning show and across Programming, Promotions, Digital, and Sales with a strong work ethic and team-first mindset.
  • Availability for early mornings, local or regional travel, and occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, events, and remote broadcasts.

  • Knowledge of Country music, Country lifestyle culture, and relevant pop-culture trends.

  • Experience creating podcast, video, interview, or social-first content.

Top candidates must be able to identify what matters most in our community, verify information quickly, coordinate coverage in the field, and make sure our newsroom is delivering useful, distinctive journalism to our multi-faceted audience. 

Understanding that an assignment desk is more than scanners and press releases is critical in this position. The desk is the newsroom’s nerve center where listening, verifying, communicating, planning ahead, and finding stories that move beyond the obvious are all vital to creating winning content.   • Track crews in the field, communicate changing details and logistical needs, and help ensure reporters and photographers are positioned for the strongest coverage.
  • Build and maintain relationships with first responders, public officials, community leaders, and other newsmakers.
  • Share verified updates quickly and clearly with anchors, reporters, producers, digital editors, and newsroom leadership.
  • Publish breaking-news content across station platforms, including website updates and mobile push alerts.

  • Monitor social platforms for credible news tips, eyewitness content, and public response.

     

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of local newsgathering technology, newsroom terminology, and field logistics and comfort learning new tools and workflows, including the use of AI

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, even under deadline pressure
  • Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays

 

 Salary

WCPO Cincinnati | WEWS Cleveland | WKBW Buffalo

Scripps is seeking a Regional General Manager to lead three of the company's most important local media operations: WCPO in Cincinnati, WEWS in Cleveland, and WKBW in Buffalo. This executive leader will serve as the senior accountable leader across the market group, providing strategic, operational, financial, and people leadership to drive audience growth, revenue performance, community impact, and organizational effectiveness.

The Regional General Manager is a collaborative leader who models the company's core values, develops strong local leadership teams, and partners closely with corporate stakeholders to advance Scripps' mission of creating a better-informed world. This role requires a proven operator who can lead through influence, inspire innovation, develop talent, and deliver results across multiple markets while maintaining strong local brands and community connections.

Work Arrangement: The successful candidate may be based in any of the three station markets and will travel regularly among WCPO, WEWS, and WKBW to support employees, clients, and community partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead and oversee fully functioning multi-platform media operations across Cincinnati, Cleveland, and Buffalo with a focus on growing revenue, audience, brand strength, and community impact.

  • Serve as the senior accountable leader for ratings, revenue, operational performance, and execution across the assigned market group.

  • Develop and guide strategic and operational plans that support multi-platform content delivery, revenue generation, audience growth, and local brand alignment.

  • Partner with local leadership teams to establish market-specific priorities while ensuring consistent execution of company strategy and operating standards.

  • Lead with positive motivation, direction, insight, and accountability while supporting market leaders in achieving operational and financial objectives.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and appropriate risk-taking throughout the organization.

  • Provide visible leadership across all assigned markets through engagement with employees, community leaders, advertisers, clients, and business partners.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, agencies, community organizations, and civic stakeholders.

  • Create highly collaborative, performance-focused environments that encourage teamwork, transparency, and accountability.

  • Coach, develop, and support succession planning for market leaders and key talent across the region.

  • Guide financial performance across assigned markets, including budgeting, expense management, operational planning, and capital investments.

  • Partner closely with sales, news, content, finance, engineering, HR, legal, and other corporate teams to strengthen business performance and drive strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with FCC, EEO, SOX, and all applicable regulatory and company requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to scale best practices, improve operational effectiveness, and enhance market performance across the region.

  • Maintain the highest ethical standards and reinforce a culture aligned with Scripps values.

job.title: Director of Meteorology
job.description:
Position Summary 


The Director of Meteorology serves as the authoritative scientific compass for The Weather Channel. In this pivotal leadership role, you will leverage expert-level meteorological knowledge to guide company-wide forecasting strategy, drive scientifically sound storytelling, and uphold the highest standards of accuracy across all platforms.

As a master communicator, you will translate complex atmospheric science into engaging, clear, and relatable narratives for a nation-wide audience. You will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership—informing critical operational decisions such as field crew deployments and breaking news preemptions—and act as our chief ambassador to the broader weather enterprise, government entities, and academic partners.

Note: This is not a 9-to-5 role. It is a dynamic leadership position driving the meteorological direction of a 24/7 news and intelligence organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Scientific Leadership & Quality Assurance

Network Authority: Serve as a principle decision-maker for high-stakes, network-imperative meteorological calls.

Accuracy & Standards: Review scripts, broadcast graphics, and published media across all digital and broadcast platforms to ensure flawless scientific accuracy and adherence to TWC standards.

Performance Coaching: Monitor airtime, review broadcasts, and provide constructive feedback to On-Camera Meteorologists (OCMs) on science communication, narrative clarity, and forecast accuracy.

Innovative Experiences: Serve as the guiding scientific voice for Immersive Mixed Reality (IMR) experiences

Editorial & Newsroom Integration

Daily Intelligence Briefings: Lead meteorological briefings during editorial meetings to guide daily story selection and production focus.

Breaking News Liaison: Act as the critical bridge between the meteorological team and editorial production teams—especially during fast-moving breaking news and extreme severe weather events.

Message Alignment: Collaborate closely with the Principal Weather Producer to align internal analysis with clear, consistent external messaging.


External Partnerships & Enterprise Relations

Chief Scientific Ambassador: Represent The Weather Group to local, state, and federal agencies, scientific institutions, and government officials.

Industry Engagement: Stay engaged with the broader weather enterprise to keep the network ahead of scientific advancements, technological shifts, and policy/political movements affecting the industry.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements 

  • Advanced Degree: Master’s or Ph.D. in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or a closely related physical science discipline.

  • 10+ Years Experience: Demonstrated track record of professional meteorological experience, including a minimum of 5 years actively communicating complex forecasts to the public.

  • Proven Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, driving decision-making under high pressure, and mentoring technical talent

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

  • Expert level understanding meteorological phenomena for all seasons

  • Thorough comprehension of numerical models

  • Monitors and comprehends the latest peer-reviewed weather and climate studies 

  • Strong ability to communicate orally and verbally.  Ability to disseminate complex meteorological information in a useable and understandable manner

  • Ability to write scripts

  • Possesses exceptional interpersonal and teamwork skills

  • Proficient in leveraging AI toolsets to develop and create

  • Knowledge of social media and its role in the information and content gathering process

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, involving cross-functional teams, in an efficient manner

  • Exhibits creative problem solving skills and unique resourcefulness in order to complete tasks

  • Quickly learns and applies new technologies

  • Customer focused, innovative, and self-motivated

  • Receives feedback constructively and incorporates that feedback into work products and performance

  • Good multitasking and trouble-shooting skills

  • Displays strong collaborative skills and works effectively through conflict

  • Maintains high standards for product, performance, and ethics

  • Effectively contributes to team goals within a highly interactive, and at times, stressful environment

  • Dependable and flexible in a 24x7 operational environment

TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Role Summary

The Facilities Coordinator performs hands-on maintenance and supports day-to-day facilities operations at WWE's corporate headquarters in Stamford, CT. Reporting to the Facilities Senior Director, this role keeps building systems, office spaces, and on-site amenities running safely and to a high standard, and delivers responsive, white-glove support to staff and executives. This is an on-site, hourly position that requires 24x7 on-call availability and occasional after-hours and weekend work.

Reports to: Facilities Senior Director

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on corporate headquarters building systems—including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and life-safety equipment—troubleshooting and repairing MEP systems to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Handle general repairs and finishes—including drywall, painting, and carpentry—using hand and power tools.

  • Conduct routine inspections of offices, conference rooms, common areas, and building equipment to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns.

  • Maintain and upkeep the on-site state-of-the-art gym.

  • Perform office reconfigurations, furniture moves, and workstation setups, manage occasional TV installations, and provide event support for executive meetings and corporate functions.

  • Assist the Facilities Director and team with building projects, furniture installations, and space-planning projects (employee adds, moves, and changes), including updating floor and seating charts in AutoCAD.

  • Maintain general supply orders and support inventory management by monitoring maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment—including medical, cleaning, and special-request items—to ensure operational readiness.

  • Manage the maintenance log and CMMS / work-order system, responding promptly to facility service requests in a fast-paced corporate environment while maintaining high standards for professionalism, safety, and customer service.

  • Read and work from blueprints and coordinate with architects and engineers as needed.

  • Coordinate with outside vendors and contractors for scheduled maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facility improvement projects.

  • Provide 24x7 emergency-response support for situations such as power outages, water leaks, and HVAC failures, including after-hours building issues and events.

  • Support and monitor records management and retention

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of corporate or commercial facilities maintenance experience (broadcast/media environment a plus).

  • High school diploma or GED; trade-school training or relevant certifications a plus.

  • Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems.

  • Valid driver's license.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel.

  • Clear communication skills—able to communicate effectively with executives, peers, and team members.

  • Strong customer-service orientation, with the ability to deliver an outstanding client experience.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to problem-solve and work both independently and as part of a team with minimal supervision, while maintaining accurate documentation.

  • Availability for 24x7 on-call, extra hours, and weekend/after-hours work as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, generators, and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

  • Experience maintaining security panels and alarms and life-safety systems (fire panel and sprinkler systems) and supporting fire drills.

  • Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) or work-order platform.

  • Experience in a broadcast, media, or entertainment corporate environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift 50+ pounds.

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, bend, kneel, and work in various positions for extended periods.

job.title: Digital Design/Development Intern, Summer 2027
job.description:
San Francisco Chronicle Summer Digital Design/Development Internship

The San Francisco Chronicle is seeking motivated students and recent graduates interested in pursuing careers in visual, product and UI/UX design, visual storytelling and coding/development for journalism. 

The Chronicle’s design team is a multidisciplinary group responsible for elevating the newsroom’s most ambitious journalism. We are a diverse group of designers, illustrators, graphics/data reporters and developers of varied backgrounds. Our projects range from crafting design systems for lines of coverage to piecing together immersive storytelling approaches for longform narratives and investigative reports. Recent successes include an Online Journalism Award-winning project on the impact of the World War II incarceration of Japanese Americans on San Francisco’s Japantown and the extremely successful relaunch of our list of Top 100 Restaurants in the San Francisco Bay Area that we rebranded and redesigned with new product features and audience strategies. We also contributed to two investigations — “The Right to Remain Secret” and “Fast and Fatal” — that were finalists for the Pulitzer Prize in 2025.

Our interns have worked on a variety of projects depending on their interests and emerging skillsets. A more coding-focused intern helped create tools to make it easier for other members of the team to produce bespoke, custom-coded projects. Another designed unique visualizations for a story on how winter storms impacted areas around Northern California’s Feather River. You may find yourself creating motion graphics, static and/or interactive information graphics, page designs or new components, such as a better video player over the course of your internship.

Prior interns have gone on to internships or full-time jobs at the Chronicle (and its sister publications or groups in Hearst Newspapers), The Pudding, the Seattle Times, the Texas Tribune, the New York Times and the Washington Post.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Participate in brainstorming and design sprints for newsroom projects
  • Execute assignments via reporting, writing, designing and/or coding as needed
  • Communicate effectively with collaborators within the newsroom
  • Manage the production process for your projects

 

Requirements

  • Must be a college junior, senior or recent graduate at time of application
  • Must have an interest in journalism and/or design demonstrated by coursework or practical experience at student publications or professional internships
  • Must be able to work in the Chronicle’s San Francisco office at least three days a week.
  • You should have a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

 

Skills that we like

This is a list of skills that we would put to use on the design team. It’s impossible to be skilled at everything. We only expect you to do a couple of these. 

  • Basic reporting and writing for accuracy, brevity and clarity
  • News design techniques
  • Visual, UI/UX and/or product design, including typography, color and grid
  • Ability to use the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Development experience with HTML, CSS, Javascript and React, with version management via Git and GitHub
  • News tools such as ArchieML and AI2HTML
  • Data reporting and analysis via Python (preferred) or R
  • Data visualization via DataWrapper or D3
  • Three.js
  • Illustration
  • Animation/motion
  • Video
  • Social media design

 

Internship details

  • Interns are paid $20.50 per hour.
  • Interns work 40 hours a week from Monday through Friday. We generally work from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Depending on news coverage needs, you may be occasionally asked to work nights or weekends.
  • The summer internship is 12 weeks long. The exact start and end dates are slightly flexible, but, for the best experience, we want the majority of your time with us to sync up with the rest of the summer internship class. It typically begins in June and ends in August or September.
  • In addition to feedback on your assignments, you will have a weekly check-in with your supervisor to talk through your work, your internship and your career goals.
  • Based on your interests, we will match you with a mentor in the newsroom who will augment the feedback you receive from your supervisor. 

 

Application details

  • Please send a resume, a cover letter explaining why you’re interested in this role and links to your portfolio and/or GitHub profile if applicable
  • Also, in your cover letter or in a second document, please direct us to three projects that showcase what you consider to be your best or more interesting work. If the project is not immediately related to journalism or design, please explain what is special about the piece.
  • If you have any questions, please contact Chronicle Creative Director Alex K. Fong at alex.fong@sfchronicle.com
  • Application Deadline is October 10, 2026

In this role, you will help define how global artists and international repertoire become relevant, visible and successful across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, working closely with European Marketing teams across the region. If you combine strong leadership with global thinking, cultural understanding and a clear sense of what makes music resonate in the GSA market, we are looking for you!

  • You develop the overall marketing strategy for international artists and global releases in GSA, translating international campaign guidelines into tailored, culturally relevant GSA strategies

job.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Data Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Products within the Global Data & Analytics team.

You are passionate about leading teams that deliver scalable, reliable, and AI-ready data platforms that power enterprise decision-making, advanced analytics, and ecommerce growth. You understand that modern data platforms must not only support reporting, but also enable machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent applications through high-quality, well-governed, semantically consistent enterprise data.

In this role, you will lead teams of data engineers responsible for delivering domain-specific data products, semantic layers, and data marts that serve as trusted, AI-ready sources of truth across the organization, while shaping how data is structured, governed, and exposed to support AI/ML use cases, feature engineering, and semantic consistency across tools and applications.

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Lead and manage a team of data engineers delivering enterprise-grade data products, data marts, and AI-ready data assets.

  • Lead the strategic design and delivery of scalable data pipelines and architectures that support commerce analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads.

  • Partner with Ecommerce, Product, Growth/Marketing, Finance, and Data Science stakeholders to enable AI use cases, feature stores, and model-ready commerce datasets.

  • Champion engineering best practices for AI-ready data foundations, including data quality, completeness, consistency, lineage, customer identity resolution, and trusted order/product/customer domains.

  • Lead development and implementation of semantic layers that standardize business definitions.

  • Ensure enterprise data is structured and documented to support LLMs, knowledge graphs, personalization, forecasting, and downstream AI applications.

  • Own platform reliability, including SLAs, monitoring, observability, and incident management for ecommerce analytics and AI data pipelines.

  • Lead the implementation and enforcement of data contracts and schema governance to improve stability and usability for AI and analytics consumers.

  • Lead adoption of modern data architecture patterns (lakehouse, real-time streaming, batch processing, feature stores, data monitoring, and observability).

  • Guide platform optimization for performance, scalability, freshness, and cost while supporting high-volume ecommerce data and compute-intensive AI workloads.

  • Collaborate with governance teams to ensure data is discoverable, explainable, and compliant, especially for AI use cases.

  • Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering expertise in data engineering and AI data readiness principles.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 10+ years of data engineering experience, with 3+ years in a leadership role and direct ownership of ecommerce, digital commerce, DTC, retail, or marketplace data domains.

  • Deep knowledge of modern data architectures (lakehouse, real-time streaming, batch processing).

  • Strong understanding of data modeling, including dimensional modeling, feature engineering, and semantic layer design.

  • Proven leadership experience delivering AI-ready data platforms and ML/AI workflows, including feature stores, training datasets, model data pipelines, personalization, demand forecasting, churn/retention, attribution, and other generative AI initiatives.

  • Experience driving data quality, governance, and observability frameworks critical for AI trust and explainability.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business, ecommerce, analytics, and AI requirements into scalable data engineering solutions.

  • Strategic exposure to AdTech and MarTech, with experience in the music/entertainment industry preferred, and the ability to connect audience engagement, marketing technology, and data-driven growth initiatives

  • Experience with cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and big data technologies (Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.). GCP is a strong plus.

  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Awareness of data governance and privacy principles, including customer data privacy, is preferred.

  • Ability to lead effectively in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities while maintaining quality, stakeholder alignment, and delivery discipline.

  • Ability to lead the creation of impactful executive presentations that communicate strategy, tradeoffs, roadmap decisions, and measurable business outcomes.

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM 

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Director, Planning & Portfolio Management leads the department-level Planning & Portfolio team within Enterprise Planning & Portfolio Management. This role is responsible for the operating backbone that enables P&T to govern its enterprise portfolio with consistency, transparency, and decision quality.

The role manages the team supporting business-critical portfolio operations. This team owns the frameworks, processes, tools, reporting structures, automation, portfolio data products, and AI-enabled knowledge base that support planning and portfolio governance across P&T.

What you'll do:

This leader ensures that portfolio information from Tempo, EOS, Jira, and internal data tools is translated into trusted weekly, monthly, and quarterly rollups for Catalyst operations, Finance, Accounting, P&T Operations, PTLT, and C-suite reporting. The role sits at the intersection of planning, execution, investment governance, operating rhythm, and executive decision support.

The successful candidate will be expected to maintain continuity for existing enterprise portfolio operations while continuing to mature the function from manual reporting and local process variation toward scalable systems, standardized governance, and AI-enabled portfolio intelligence.

  • Lead the department-level Planning & Portfolio team responsible for the core infrastructure of P&T portfolio governance, including frameworks, processes, tools, data, automation, reporting, and AI-enabled knowledge management.

  • Drive the use of AI and modern work tools, including Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, and other approved enterprise platforms, to reduce manual effort, improve insight quality, accelerate reporting, and strengthen portfolio decision support.

  • Own the operating mechanisms that support quarterly and annual planning, portfolio intake, prioritization, roadmap governance, initiative tracking, and enterprise portfolio visibility.

  • Ensure portfolio data across Tempo, EOS, Jira, Databricks, and internal data tools is accurate, consistent, timely, and usable for executive reporting, planning decisions, investment reviews, and operational governance.

  • Oversee weekly, monthly, and quarterly portfolio rollups supporting Catalyst operations, Finance, Accounting, P&T Operations, PTLT, and C-suite reporting.

  • Establish and improve standards for portfolio data integrity, initiative metadata, reporting inputs, dependency visibility, delivery health, prioritization signals, and planning artifacts.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, TPM, Finance, Accounting, Catalyst, and P&T Operations leaders to ensure portfolio information supports clear decisions, visible tradeoffs, and reliable execution oversight.

  • Lead portfolio reporting and governance mechanisms that help senior leaders understand what work matters most, what is moving, what is at risk, and where executive decisions are required.

  • Continue evolving portfolio tooling, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled knowledge systems to make portfolio governance more scalable, consistent, and insight-driven across P&T.

  • Coach, develop, and manage a geographically distributed team, including people managers and senior individual contributors as applicable, responsible for portfolio operations, data support, planning execution, reporting, and WBR mechanisms.

  • Own planning, staffing, budgeting, expense-priority recommendations, vendor-management inputs, and operational-change implementation for the Planning & Portfolio function.

  • Serve as the escalation point for portfolio data issues, reporting gaps, planning risks, governance breakdowns, and cross-functional alignment challenges.

What you'll need:

  • Typically requires 10+ years of portfolio management, program management, or technical operations experience in a large-scale technology or media organization.

  • Typically requires 5+ years of management experience leading teams, people managers, and/or multidisciplinary portfolio operations, planning, reporting, or governance functions.

  • Strong financial acumen, including direct experience with capitalization, CapEx tracking, and/or FP&A processes, and experience partnering with Finance and Accounting on CapEx/OpEx and investment reporting.

  • Experience defining and advancing AI, automation, and tooling strategies for portfolio operations.

  • Sufficient technical fluency to prototype and develop AI-enabled tools, automations, workflows, integrations, or other lightweight solutions that improve planning, portfolio management, reporting, and decision support.

  • Experience with vendor management.

  • Demonstrated cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Catalyst, P&T Operations, and TPM.

  • Experience leading enterprise portfolio governance and planning.

  • Experience designing and evolving portfolio operating models.

  • Strong experience with portfolio data strategy, reporting, metrics, and data-driven decision support.

  • Strong executive communication skills and experience supporting senior-level decision-making.

  • Demonstrated people leadership and team development experience.

  • Strong systems thinking and experience with enterprise process design.

  • Strong judgment in prioritization, escalation, risk management, and navigating complex trade-offs.

  • Ability to translate senior leadership strategy into actionable operating plans, decision forums, governance standards, and measurable execution routines.

  • Experience ensuring budgets, schedules, work plans, reporting standards, and portfolio operations meet enterprise requirements.

  • Hands-on experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms.

  • Must have the legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $190,100 to $240,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

job.title: Senior Staff Editor (Temporary)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Washington bureau is seeking a temporary senior staff editor to work on editing Washington news, including stories on the White House, Congress, the military, intelligence agencies, the Justice Department, the State Department, the Supreme Court, health care, economics and more.

You will work on a mix of daily and enterprise stories as well as breaking news and live coverage during weekday evenings, picking up from the dayside team and working alongside other editors in the Washington bureau and on the Live team in New York, as needed. You will also monitor news developments, consult with the Washington Night Editor and bureau leadership about priorities, do first and second reads and make judgments on the length, placement and framing of stories and, at times, assign stories to reporters.

You will need to have familiarity with a wide variety of topics, versatility, speed, proven judgment and the ability to collaborate across desks and platforms.

This is a temporary position based in Washington, D.C., with regular presence in the office, 4 days per week. It includes night and weekend work as newsroom needs require.

Responsibilities:

  • You will work with other editors and reporters to ensure stories are cleanly edited.
  • You will edit a wide range of material for accuracy, grammar, style and readability, including breaking news, live updates, daily news and major enterprise stories.
  • You will provide first and second edits for a variety of stories and topics across the desk.
  • You will manage coverage of breaking news stories, coordinate with other editors on deployment decisions and launch reporters as needed.
  • You may work with reporters on stories from assigning to publication, including framing, shaping and close-in editing.
  • You will monitor wires, social media and other sources for news developments and stay in touch with reporters and editors about advancing running news stories to keep the report fresh and competitive through the evening, with an eye to coverage into the next news cycle.
  • You may manage the Washington live blog, as needed. Be familiar with its workflows and adjust presentation and coverage plans as news developments require.
  • You will work with other editors in the Washington bureau, on the Live team and across the newsroom to collaborate as necessary.
  • You will coordinate with editors and the audience team on story publication and promotion plans as needed.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Washington Night Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of editing and writing experience at a journalism or media company or other relevant organization
  • Commitment to The New York Times strategy, ethics, standards and mission for themselves, their team, stringers and colleagues
  • A willingness to collaborate and the ability to partner with colleagues across the Washington bureau and The New York Times newsroom
  • Experience working in high-pressure, deadline-driven newsrooms, including breaking-news or live-coverage workflows
  • Writing and editing skills that demonstrate mastery of journalistic style and standards, including ethical and superb news judgment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strong understanding of Times style and standards
  • Experience managing or contributing to a live blog, running news report or other continuous coverage format
  • Knowledge of Washington politics, policy and institutions
  • A willingness to be flexible as the bureau and newsroom's needs evolve

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

job.title: Head of Editorial, Axios Live
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We’re hiring a Head of Live Editorial to join our award-winning events team, Axios Live!

Why it matters: Axios Live is one of Axios’ three core business pillars, bringing Axios journalism to in-person and virtual audiences through interviews, panels, roundtables, and executive forums. This senior editorial leader will oversee macro people management, connect the Booking and Coverage silos, and serve as the primary liaison between Axios Live and the broader newsroom. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Global Head of Axios Live, this role ensures our live events portfolio meets Axios’ editorial standards, reflects diverse perspectives, and strengthens Axios’ position at the forefront of news and business storytelling.

Go deeper: This is a high-impact leadership role with broad editorial and operational responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Axios Live Editorial Leadership

  • Set the editorial vision and strategy for Axios Live programming across all event formats.
  • Ensure all Axios Live editorial outputs, including onstage interviews, marketing materials, recap articles, and post-event coverage, meet Axios’ editorial standards and Smart Brevity style.
  • Exercise sound editorial judgment in fast-moving news environments, adapting programming as news develops and ensuring live-event scripts, materials, and coverage assets are ready for breaking-news needs.
  • Lead and develop the Axios Live editorial team, including editors, bookers, coverage leads, and Managing Editor; oversee team structure, role design, performance management, and career development.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing culture aligned with Axios’ mission and values.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to the broader newsroom, aligning editorial priorities, event coverage, and resource sharing.
  • Partner with Communications to align on timely promotion, amplification, and coverage of Axios Live events, while identifying opportunities to grow the Axios brand, audience, and event reach.
  • Lead rigorous copy editing and final editorial review of Axios Live’s external-facing materials, including event scripts, moderator notes, speaker introductions, marketing copy, run-of-show materials, recap stories, social copy, and other audience-facing assets, to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to Axios’ editorial standards and Smart Brevity style.

Programming and Standards

  • Develop event concepts, programming arcs, and editorial frameworks for all Axios events, summits, and larger Axios-hosted programs.
  • Shape a diverse, compelling Axios Live programming portfolio that keeps Axios at the forefront of news, policy, and industry storytelling.
  • Partner with Sales and Partnerships to design sponsored and branded programming that maintains editorial integrity.

Strategy and Innovation

  • Contribute to the strategic growth of Axios Live, including new formats, verticals, and revenue opportunities.
  • Demonstrate comfort with and understanding of AI, automation, and emerging tools, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and quality across research, booking, production, and editorial workflows.
  • Represent Axios Live internally and externally, and potentially onstage at live events, as a senior editorial voice.

Connect Booking and Coverage

  • Own the connective tissue between Booking, including securing newsmakers and influencers, and Coverage, including event language, recaps, live-tweeting, and post-event content.
  • Ensure seamless coordination among editorial, events, sales, and partnerships so programming is editorially sound and commercially compelling.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a deep passion for Axios’ mission and journalism, and the following skills:

  • 12 - 15+ years of journalism or editorial experience, including significant experience leading teams and complex editorial operations.
  • Significant experience in live news, events, TV or video production, or related fields.
  • Proven success working in, or closely with, a newsroom and building strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Excellent writing, copy editing, and research skills, with exceptional attention to detail, keen news judgment, and storytelling ability.
  • Deep familiarity with digital and social media landscapes and how news travels across platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Axios’ Smart Brevity style and the ability to teach and uphold it across a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and scale editorial teams, including managers and senior individual contributors.
  • Ability to operate in high-pressure situations, meet tight deadlines, and make calm, sound decisions under pressure.
  • An extensive rolodex of senior leaders, policymakers, CEOs, and other newsmakers, along with the ability to scout, pitch, and book editorially sound guests for high-profile onstage moments.
  • Understanding of how editorial excellence supports business goals, including sponsorships, partnerships, and ticketing.
  • Ability to travel for major events and activations, which may include Davos, Cannes Lions, SXSW, CES, Climate Week, and political conventions.
