job.title: Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

With a strong pipeline of returning franchises and bold new formats coming down the line, Fox Entertainment Studios is in search of a Senior Vice President, Unscripted Studio - Production to shepherd its unscripted slate to air, ensuring the delivery of shows with the highest levels of entertainment and production value — on budget and on schedule.

We are looking for a leader who can take a complicated concept and simplify the process, working closely with creators and colleagues to champion shows and bring them to life. This executive will have deep knowledge of the unscripted production process from bottom to top — casting and field production through story, post and delivery — and the instincts to balance the creative ambition of each show against the financial resources available to produce it.

The Senior Vice President will join an innovative leadership team that isn't afraid to take calculated risks and experiment with content and production models. This is an untapped opportunity to be nimble, thoughtful, and innovative about how the content the studio creates comes to life and reaches audiences across platforms domestically and abroad.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee all aspects of physical production across a high-volume portfolio of concurrent unscripted series, returning multi-season franchises and paid development
  • Oversee integration and product placement deals on shows, vetting network and platform approval on all terms
  • Oversee productions made with external production companies and partners — assessing and approving each partner's production plan, budget, schedule and staffing, and holding them to Fox's creative, technical, legal, cost and delivery standards from greenlight through final delivery
  • Oversee risk management and insurance for both corporate and production
  • Provide insight and guidance to efficiently resolve creative, production and post-production hurdles, successfully balancing the creative needs of the shows with the financial resources available to produce them
  • Work closely with showrunners, executive producers, line producers and key department heads to ensure shows are produced at the highest quality within the constraints of budget and schedule
  • Innovate new unscripted production models and partnerships that speak to today's business realities — including domestic and international productions and co-productions — to protect margin without compromising on screen
  • Build the production plan, budgets, calendars, and assumptions for every project
  • Manage and oversee all line producers to ensure they are hitting milestones, on budget and on schedule
  • Negotiate budgets with network and platform production executives. Partner with development and current teams to build budgets for new shows and paid development
  • Supervise series physical production and delivery schedules and cost reports in accordance with each network's and platform's deliverable requirements. Track costs and create cost reporting for the development and finance teams
  • Hire, supervise, and mentor a team of production executives, line producers, EICs, production managers, and freelancers; build credibility and strong working relationships across the organization
  • Collaborate across departments to strategize, develop systems, problem-solve, and ensure company resources are maximized across the full slate
    • Partner with Finance to ensure proper cash flow, funding, and cost reporting on all projects
    • Partner with Business & Legal Affairs to negotiate network and platform deals, talent and producer contracts, staffing agreements and access agreements as needed
    • Partner with Production Legal to anticipate and manage legal and clearance issues
    • Partner with Current Programming to ensure a smooth handoff at greenlight and maintain brand and format integrity throughout the production lifecycle
  • Run and continually optimize the studio's production and post-production operation — studio and stage space, edit bays, equipment and gear — that serves the full slate, maximizing utilization, revenue and margin across shows
  • Supervise, secure, track, and manage all state and international tax incentive programs on eligible shows, including financial reporting and auditing
  • Lead international co-productions and the physical production of FAE-owned global formats across territories — partnering with local producers and broadcasters (e.g., TF1, ProSieben) to deliver Fox-owned IP to spec, on budget in every market
  • Identify production challenges and risks and work with the appropriate teams to resolve issues, streamline processes, and foster innovation
  • Stay on top of key industry trends and identify opportunities. In concert with senior leadership, evaluate opportunities for increasing revenue and margin across the studio
  • Drive operational excellence — ensuring systems are in place to direct and control costs, measure key financial and performance metrics, and identify opportunities for optimization
  • Participate in the analysis and development of new ideas, formats, and pitches, bringing a producer's lens to what each concept will take to execute

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 15+ years of progressive production experience culminating in a senior executive role (SVP/EVP/Head of Production level) at a major unscripted studio, production group or group of networks, with responsibility for a high-volume slate
  • Demonstrated knowledge of production from bottom to top: field production, postproduction, story structure, and staff management

job.title: Client Services Content Creator
job.description:

Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Client Services Content Creator. This hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-quality creative content across multiple markets and platforms.

As a Client Services Content Creator, you will help bring client, market, regional, and national creative ideas to life. This role is ideal for someone who is confident in the full production process, comfortable managing multiple creative assignments, and able to work independently while collaborating with Sales, Client Services, project management, and creative leadership.

This is a practical, hands-on creative role. The right candidate should be ready to pick up a camera, shape a script, produce a shoot, solve an edit, build polished content, and support priority projects from concept through final delivery.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an ACCET Client Services Content Creator in our Baltimore, MD market, you will create commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while helping maintain strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Create High-Quality Multi-Platform Content

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

  • Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need.

  • Support projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports.

  • Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value.

  • Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges and improve the final product.

 

Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs

  • Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations.

  • Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require.

  • Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders.

  • Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, urgent deadlines, and time-sensitive client deliverables.

 

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with Sales, Client Services, Creative Services, Production, Digital, Project Managers, and market leadership to understand goals and expectations.

  • Participate in creative discussions, campaign planning, production conversations, and feedback exchanges as needed.

  • Translate creative direction and client objectives into content that is effective, polished, and production-ready.

  • Communicate clearly about project status, creative needs, production challenges, and delivery timelines.

 

Maintain Workflow, Quality, and Production Standards

  • Use Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems to track assignments, respond to requests, update project status, and support workflow accuracy.

  • Review project details, creative assets, scripts, approvals, and delivery requirements to help prevent delays or rework.

  • Follow ACCET production standards, file management expectations, brand guidelines, and quality-control steps.

  • Stay open to new tools, templates, AI-supported workflows, and production processes that improve efficiency and creative quality.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL

  • A hands-on creative role with impact across multiple television markets.

  • Opportunity to produce commercial, branded, digital, and promotional content that supports clients and markets.

  • A chance to contribute to local, regional, and national creative work inside ACCET.

  • A fast-moving environment where storytelling, production skill, collaboration, and problem-solving matter.

  • A role that helps shape ACCET as a trusted creative production resource across the company.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong writing, producing, shooting, editing, storytelling, communication, and organizational skills.

  • 2+ years of experience in commercial production, broadcast television, creative services, video production, post-production, digital content, agency work, or a related field preferred.

  • Ability to independently produce polished commercial, branded, digital, or promotional content from concept through delivery.

  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including concept development, scripting, shooting, editing, graphics, audio, client approvals, revisions, and final export.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, or similar tools is a plus.

  • Digital ad design and motion graphics/animation experience a BIG plus.

  • Familiarity with digital video, social media content, OTT/CTV advertising, branded content, and multi-platform campaign production preferred.

  • Comfort working in project management systems; Adobe Workfront experience is a plus.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move production equipment as needed; valid driver license and good driving record may be required for production-related needs.

  • A proactive mindset focused on creativity, collaboration, accountability, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

 

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

  • You love creating content that connects with audiences and supports client, market, and company goals.

  • You are comfortable writing, shooting, producing, editing, and solving creative problems hands-on.

  • You can manage several projects at once while keeping quality high and deadlines on track.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well, and work effectively with creative, Sales, client, and leadership partners.

  • You want to help ACCET deliver meaningful, high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms.

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday 9a - 5p.

  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, station events, regional or national productions, or other time-sensitive projects.

  • Some longer days, nights, weekends, or holidays may be required based on business needs.

  • Travel may be required but is expected to be infrequent.

job.description:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. job.title: Senior Director, Engineering
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment. We are hiring a Sr. Director of Engineering to lead the people, systems, and practices behind reliable products. 

Why it matters: This leader will develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders while closely guiding teams using AI to build and experiment. Working closely with the CTO, you will turn company technology direction into clear engineering decisions and execution.

Go deeper: The role spans engineering across Axios products, platforms, and workflows, from our CMS and axios.com to newsletters, Local products, internal tools, and systems supporting the Newsroom and business teams. Product, Newsroom, and business leaders set the goals. Engineering builds the systems and capabilities that help achieve them. The right leader will speed decisions, shorten the path from idea to product, spot risks early, and escalate issues before they grow. Responsibilities include:

  • Partner closely with the CTO and engineering leaders to shape engineering strategy and technical direction.
  • Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, supporting clear accountability and a healthy culture. Develop and retain strong talent, and hire thoughtfully as needs evolve.
  • Strengthen planning, delivery, quality, and reliability. Help teams make faster decisions, move ideas into products, spot risks, and escalate issues early.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Newsroom, and business leaders to turn priorities into technical plans and match engineering capacity to the most important work.
  • Bring strong judgment to architecture, platforms, and reliability, especially when tradeoffs span teams.
  • Own the operating standards, guidelines, and practices that help engineering teams plan, build, test, release, operate, and learn effectively.
  • Establish shared benchmarks and baselines for engineering health.
  • Lead vendor evaluation and selection for engineering tools, platforms, and services, balancing capability, cost, security, reliability, support, and long-term fit.
  • Help define modern engineering leadership inside an AI-native media company and shape how Axios builds, learns, and delivers at speed.

Worthy of your time: This leader must be a close partner to the CTO and senior leaders who can explain technical details clearly and dive deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions. Success means faster decisions, a shorter path from idea to product, strong engineering leadership, reliable systems, and an organization that sees around corners. What we’re looking for:

  • You have led and developed engineering managers and senior technical leaders, setting clear expectations and addressing performance directly.
  • You have helped teams use AI to improve how they build, test, and operate software and to experiment with new product capabilities.
  • You translate technical details for executives and nontechnical partners while going deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions.
  • You quickly understand unfamiliar areas, ask the right questions, and know when to bring in expertise, invest in platforms, simplify systems, or accept a short-term tradeoff.

job.description:

Status of Employment:

Permanent

English, French

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-29 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.


Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.


A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.


This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.


Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Information Security Analyst, Third-Party Security and Data Breach Expert, to spearhead its Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program for external partners and vendors.

 

In this role, you will oversee and execute ongoing assessments of third-party technology risk to ensure vendor risks remain within acceptable tolerance thresholds while maintaining compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. You will report the overall risk posture to information security governance and management committees. As a recognized subject matter expert, you will serve as a trusted adviser for governance, risk and compliance (GRC) across the organization.

 

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

 

What’s in It for You

 

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

 

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Drive the TPRM program: Lead and oversee the organization-wide Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, from process development through to operational implementation.
  • Define assessment methodologies and standards: Design, maintain and update third-party risk classification frameworks (criticality, data sensitivity) and security assessment questionnaires aligned with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Assess compliance and security posture: Evaluate the security posture and maturity of third parties by reviewing SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test results and regulatory compliance attestations (e.g., GDPR, Quebec’s Law 25).
  • Address risks and recommend mitigation: Assess identified security gaps, formulate risk mitigation strategies or compensating controls, and establish binding remediation plans with vendors.
  • Define and validate complex contractual security requirements, including audit rights, incident notification SLAs (24- to 48-hour response windows), encryption standards and business continuity plans.
  • Negotiate directly with partners and vendors: Engage directly with vendor security leaders during contracting phases to advocate for and enforce organizational security requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership during third-party security incidents or data breaches.
  • Manage third-party risk registers: Maintain an up-to-date mapping and complete inventory of all external partners and their corresponding risk levels.
  • Oversee periodic reassessments: Schedule and perform ongoing security evaluations based on vendor criticality (e.g., annual reviews for high-risk third parties).
  • Champion security best practices across internal teams to foster a security-first mindset from contract initiation.
  • Advance the TPRM strategy: Continuously adapt assessment processes in response to emerging cyber threats and regulatory updates.
  • Produce governance dashboards and metrics (KPIs/KRIs): Report third-party risk metrics to leadership (e.g., assessment completion rates, turnaround times, open risk findings).
  • Maintain broad knowledge of best practices and trends in information security.

 

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in IT risk governance and TPRM, including a minimum of three years focused on information security.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with legal teams to define and negotiate contractual security and privacy requirements (e.g., security schedules, audit rights, data breach notification timelines).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions. Commissions rates generally range from 2.0% to 10%+ depending on product, station and type of business.

job.title: Weekend Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Orlando, FL)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for a Weekend Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Weekend Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

The schedule for this position will be Monday-Tuesday, Friday-Sunday.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.

  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.

  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.

  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.

  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.

  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.

  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.

  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.

  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.

  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.

  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.

  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.

  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).

  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.

  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.

  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.

  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $75,000.00-85,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

KMVT, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Twin Falls, Idaho, is seeking a Senior Reporter who is passionate about investigative journalism and meaningful storytelling. This role is perfect for a seasoned journalist ready to lead by example, mentor others, and deliver impactful stories that resonate across multiple platforms.

As our Senior Reporter, you'll serve as a subject matter expert in investigative and long-form journalism while building authentic connections with our community. You'll be at the forefront of breaking news, diving deep into stories that matter, and inspiring others with your commitment to the highest journalistic standards.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a network of sources throughout the community to leverage local experts.

  • Research stories by investigating public records, personal sources, and other contacts to determine the most effective approach for a story.

  • Use visual journalism such as graphics, photography, and videography as well as digitally distinct content.

  • Operate camera with still and video capabilities.

  • Serve as a lead reporter for in-depth breaking news and stay abreast of local developments.

  • May serve as back-up for editorial coverage.

  • Periodically required to drive personal or company vehicle to cover various assignments.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in news reporting including in-depth long form reporting required

  • Experience in community, digital and solutions-based reporting, and journalism preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

With affordable living, excellent schools, and a growing economy, Twin Falls provides an exceptional quality of life for those seeking both professional fulfillment and outdoor recreation.

job.description:
Regional News Director, KMGH, KOAA, KKTV, KKCO & KJCT

Are you a transformational news leader ready to shape the future of local journalism across Colorado?

The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Regional News Director to lead one of the most important news regions in our company. Based in Denver at KMGH, our ABC affiliate serving Colorado's largest market, this leader will serve as News Director for KMGH while providing strategic leadership and oversight across KOAA (Colorado Springs/Pueblo), KKTV (Colorado Springs), KKCO (Grand Junction), and KJCT (Grand Junction).

This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished newsroom executive to influence journalism, content strategy, audience growth, and newsroom performance across multiple markets while leading a high-performing newsroom in Denver. We are looking for a collaborative, innovative leader who understands how to build strong newsroom cultures, elevate storytelling, develop talent, and leverage the collective strength of multiple stations to better serve audiences across Colorado.

The ideal candidate combines a passion for exceptional local journalism with the strategic vision, leadership skills, and business acumen necessary to guide news operations in a rapidly evolving media landscape.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth, journalism excellence, and newsroom operations at KMGH.

  • Communicate a compelling and inspiring vision for the newsroom that aligns with company strategy and content priorities.

  • Develop and execute measurable strategies to grow audiences across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry, audience behaviors, competitive landscape, and local news environment.

  • Oversee newsroom staffing and personnel decisions.

  • Develop and manage the annual newsroom budget in accordance with station and company guidelines.

  • Build and maintain key community relationships that strengthen KMGH's reputation and impact.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, journalistic standards, and company policies.

  • Collaborate with station leadership to achieve overall station and organizational goals.

  • Lead and develop newsroom leaders and staff through coaching, feedback, accountability, and performance management.

  • Partner with station, regional, and corporate leadership to strengthen newsroom performance and align journalistic priorities across KMGH, KOAA, KKTV, KKCO, and KJCT.

  • Identify and lead regional coverage opportunities that leverage the collective strengths, talent, expertise, and resources of Colorado stations.

  • Establish clear performance expectations for market News Directors and provide coaching, mentorship, feedback, and accountability through a dotted-line leadership structure.

  • Evaluate content and journalism across assigned stations to ensure alignment with enterprise content strategy, audience priorities, journalistic standards, and company objectives.

  • Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets to promote best practices and innovation.

  • Partner with station and regional leaders to support workforce planning, resource allocation, and organizational effectiveness across the region.

  • Identify opportunities for shared coverage, breaking news collaboration, investigative initiatives, enterprise reporting, and special projects.

  • Use audience, performance, and operational data to identify opportunities, address challenges, and improve results across markets.

  • Support organizational change and the adoption of emerging technologies, workflows, and content strategies that strengthen local journalism.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive news management experience, preferably including leadership of large newsroom operations preferred.

  • Experience leading multiple teams, markets, stations, or geographically dispersed organizations preferred.

  • Demonstrated success driving audience growth and newsroom performance across multiple platforms.

  • Proven experience leading change, developing talent, and building strong newsroom cultures.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A deep commitment to quality local journalism, ethical decision-making, and serving local communities.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing content strategies that drive audience growth and engagement.

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to translate enterprise goals into actionable newsroom plans.

  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of empowering teams, establishing accountability, and producing results.

  • Ability to influence and collaborate across organizational boundaries and multiple markets.

  • Strong understanding of audience analytics, content performance metrics, and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Knowledge of newsroom technology, digital publishing platforms, streaming products, and emerging media trends.

  • Ability to adapt resources, workflows, and talent strategies to meet changing audience expectations and business needs.

  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, editorial judgment, and applicable laws affecting news operations.

LOCATION

This position is based in Denver, Colorado, at KMGH-TV. The successful candidate will serve as News Director for KMGH while providing regional leadership for KOAA, KKTV, KKCO, and KJCT. Regular travel throughout Colorado will be expected to support station partnerships, coaching, collaboration, and regional initiatives.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

Denver offers an unbeatable combination of professional opportunity, cultural vibrancy, and outdoor adventure. With more than 300 days of sunshine each year, residents enjoy easy access to the Rocky Mountains, world-class skiing, hiking, biking, and countless outdoor activities.

As Colorado's largest city, Denver features a thriving downtown, outstanding restaurants, professional sports teams, a vibrant arts and entertainment scene, and a strong economy. From Red Rocks Amphitheatre and the Denver Art Museum to weekend adventures in Vail, Aspen, or Breckenridge, Denver provides an exceptional quality of life and is consistently recognized as one of the nation's best places to live and work.

job.description:
KUTV is looking for a take-charge Live Desk Anchor/Reporter for our morning show to help us continue to grow and empower our audiences! We are seeking a motivated, energetic, creative, and aggressive anchor who can think and perform outside the box. The ideal candidate should be able to develop story ideas and gather information, prioritizing anchoring from our live desk during key morning newscasts and for our digital platforms. 

Anchoring on the live desk is a specialized role.  The ideal candidate must follow what’s happening locally, nationally, globally: then produce live desk segments in real-time on the morning newscast.  They will be an active and savvy social-media user with strong digital newsgathering skills. After the newscast is finished for the day, the ideal candidate will then work as a reporter, creating content for broadcast and digital platforms.  This content may be prioritized for future morning newscasts, YouTube, and other platforms.  The ideal candidate should also have sound writing skills, a great work ethic, and a can-do attitude.

No day will look the same as a Live Desk Anchor/Reporter; however the main responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Research, investigate, write, and present meaningful and timely stories for station newscasts that can be used across multiple platforms
  • Engaging with local community members
  • Reviewing material for fairness, accuracy, and balance
  • Work closely with all members of the news team, which would include Producers, Editors, Anchors, News Management, etc.

Additionally, this person should have...

  • Proven knowledge and experience working with current media creation tools and contemporary newsroom systems
  • Excel in storytelling across multiple platforms
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills are a must
  • 4 years of experience as a reporter.
  • Live Desk, or similar anchoring experience preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field preferred
  • Must be able to work well under pressure to meet strict deadlines

job.title: General Assignment Reporter/Weather Forecaster
job.description:
KUTV seeks an enterprising and General Assignment Reporter/Weather Forecaster to join our team. 

Are you a news-driven person who has experience with forecasting?  A journalist who enjoys news, weather, and has the ability and drive to excel at both?  KUTV has a unique opportunity for a journalist/forecaster hybrid role.

On the reporter side, we are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with an edge, and use strong storytelling and TV production to make it impactful and memorable. Knowledge of current events, educational and political systems is essential, with a focus on government accountability. 

On the forecasting side, the ideal candidate has a high interest in weather. You will turn weather-related stories. Fill-in forecasting on different shifts when needed.  Do you love sharing the big weather story, whether that is on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, a mobile app, or on TV? Do you love explaining the why and the how of weather, far beyond current radar and the 7-day forecast?  Utah is a dynamic state to cover weather, providing significantly different forecasts for different parts of the state.  We want someone who is hungry to learn about the impact the weather has on our communities.

Must have great organization and time management skills for both roles to be able to create a pipeline of stories, and connections within the community, track and hit deadlines on time. Your responsibilities in addition to television include reporting and forecasting for our digital and social platforms. Examples include- but not limited to- producing stories for KUTV.COM that include unique digital-only content. You will also be expected to post unique content to YouTube, Facebook, Twitter and other social media platforms.  Our newsroom is one that places a high value on being a voice for the voiceless through holding those in power accountable.  As a reporter in our newsroom, you’ll be expected to find and pitch these stories- then enjoy the satisfaction knowing your reporting is truly making a difference.  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 3 Years of reporting/MMJ experience
  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch enterprise stories that are unique and land in key topic areas
  • Work closely with newsroom managers to refine pitches and story scripts
  • Produce digital versions of your reports.  This may include digital-only elements, producing unique content for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook.  Working with the digital team to create a unique digital plan for each story.
  • Shoot and edit stories
  • Maintain an active social media presence to build your brand. 
  • Produces and presents weather reports for all platforms when needed, including filling-in on newscasts.
  • Produce weather graphics and maps for all platforms
  • Report live during weather events
  • Be part of the news team ensemble where you will do non-weather things like trending topics, community events, interviews and traffic, as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Previous on-air experience presenting weather is preferred.
  • Have proven knowledge and experience working with current media creation tools
  • Excel in storytelling across multiple platforms

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

This role is responsible for supporting the pre-sale and mid-flight operational process — developing accurate, strategic media plans and ensuring smooth campaign delivery across Digital, Linear, Social, and Audio platforms.

The Sales Planner works closely with Sales, Pricing & Planning, Inventory, and Ad Operations to ensure proposals, billing, and reporting are precise and aligned with business goals. This position is focused on sales and planning operations, not client relationship management.

job.description:
The People function at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Senior Manager, Benefits & Wellbeing to join our team.

The Senior Manager, Benefits & Wellbeing serves as a strategic lead responsible for helping shape and drive the Company's Health, Wellbeing and Retirement strategy, ensuring programs remain competitive, financially sustainable, operationally effective, and aligned with the Company's Total Rewards philosophy.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Total Rewards & People Operations, this role partners closely with Finance, HR Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Legal, Communications, brokers, consultants, and external vendors to continuously evolve our benefits portfolio while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional employee experience.

While this position maintains a strong understanding of benefits administration and provides strategic oversight of day-to-day operations, its primary focus is to lead and advance plan design, financial strategy, governance, market competitiveness, vendor management, and continuous improvement across the Company's benefits programs.

ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced and strategic Benefits professional with strong expertise in health, wellbeing and retirement strategy, benefits financing, plan design, regulatory compliance, and governance. You are ready to operate as a senior lead, take ownership of key workstreams, and help shape the future direction of the Company’s benefits programs.

You understand the operational mechanics behind benefits administration and can effectively guide and influence operational teams to ensure seamless execution. While the Benefits Administration team within HR Operations manages the day-to-day execution of the Company's programs, you provide strategic guidance, governance, and continuous improvement leadership necessary to deliver a best-in-class employee experience.

You are equally comfortable partnering with Finance on long-term cost strategies, influencing brokers and consultants, evaluating emerging market trends, preparing executive recommendations, and driving innovative benefit solutions that balance employee value, financial sustainability, and business objectives.

You combine strong business acumen with analytical capabilities and are comfortable translating complex financial and regulatory concepts into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy & Plan Design

  • Develop and execute the Company's multi-year Health, Wellbeing and Retirement strategy, balancing employee experience, market competitiveness, financial sustainability, and operational excellence.
  • Help shape and drive the strategic direction of the Company's benefits programs, ensuring alignment with business priorities and the Total Rewards philosophy.
  • Develop and recommend innovative benefit programs and plan design enhancements that improve employee experience while maintaining long-term financial sustainability.
  • Monitor healthcare, wellbeing, retirement, and regulatory trends to proactively recommend enhancements that strengthen the Company's employee value proposition.
  • Evaluate the Company's benefits portfolio against market practices, benchmark studies, and industry trends to ensure competitive positioning.

Financial Stewardship

  • Partner closely with Finance, brokers, and external consultants to develop long-term healthcare cost strategies, financial forecasts, and funding recommendations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the financial and operational drivers of the Company's benefits programs, using data and market insights to recommend sustainable plan design and funding strategies.
  • Analyze claims experience, utilization trends, vendor performance, and plan costs to identify opportunities for optimization and cost containment.
  • Develop business cases, executive dashboards, and financial analyses supporting strategic recommendations, plan design decisions, and cost-management initiatives.

Vendor & Consultant Management

  • Influence and challenge external partners through market intelligence, financial analysis, and industry best practices to optimize plan performance and vendor outcomes.

Benefits Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead enterprise initiatives related to benefits programs, including Open Enrollment, vendor implementations, technology enhancements, wellbeing initiatives, and process improvements.

Employee Experience

Leadership

Strategic AI Portfolio Leadership

Own PMO oversight of the end-to-end AI/ML portfolio, including long-range we plan and select where to invest. We also measure the results based on specific goals.

Enable software product operating models that support high-volume experimentation, rapid learning cycles, and continuous improvement.

Drive issue resolution for complex, cross-team challenges by facilitating rapid root-cause analysis, aligning stakeholders on tradeoffs, and ensuring timely, durable outcomes.

Synthesize and communicate clear, data-driven insights on program health, risks, and strategic tradeoffs to engineering management and executive stakeholders.

Lead executive-level discussions on program health, delivery progress, and measurable outcomes across AI initiatives.

12 + years of experience in Technical Program Management, or similar roles.

Technical/Engineering.

Demonstrated hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, low-code/no- code, for prototyping, automation, and analysis.

Knowledge with the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data sourcing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Experience with experimentation frameworks including A/B and multivariate testing, offline vs. online evaluation, and model iteration

loops.

Knowledge of model performance metrics and tradeoffs (accuracy, latency, bias, explainability).

Experience supporting applied ML use cases such as personalization and recommendation systems, search and ranking, content knowledge, or generative AI for text, image, or video.

job.description:

Overview 
The CBS Sports Social Media team creates and distributes content across CBS Sports, CBS Sports Network, and CBS Sports Digital's social media channels. In a crowded sports media landscape, we pride ourselves on developing creative concepts that break through the noise, engage fans, and reflect the passion of the global game.
CBS Sports is expanding its Golazo soccer social media team and is looking for a football-obsessed content producer who lives and breathes the sport. The ideal candidate loves working behind-the-scenes and has a deep understanding of the global football landscape—from the UEFA Champions League to the men’s and women’s domestic leagues across Europe, the U.S. and beyond.
You must be a football fan and have a strong grasp of best practices across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter/X—as demonstrated by your portfolio of work. This role requires someone who can be thought-partners with show producers, consistently identify key moments from live studio shows, execute high-quality social edits, and publish in real time to drive engagement with a global football audience.

Role Details
As a Social Media Producer for CBS Sports Golazo, you will be embedded within our Golazo Network studio, working directly alongside show producers and talent to shape how our studio programming and live moments come to life on social.You’ll sit at the intersection of production, editorial, and social, ensuring key moments, storylines, and performances are identified early, clipped quickly, and distributed effectively across Golazo’s social platforms. This role requires strong editorial instincts, a deep understanding of football culture, and the ability to translate live television and studio discussion into compelling, platform-specific social content that resonates with fans globally. Beyond publishing, you’ll be expected to independently create high-quality vertical video edits, quick-turn graphics, and behind-the-scenes content, while also feeding social performance insights back into the production process to help inform future shows and segments. If you thrive in a fast-paced studio environment, are comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with production teams, and know how to turn live football conversation into standout social moments, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities
●    Be embedded within the Golazo Network production unit in Stamford, participating in daily production meetings and live studio workflows.

●    Serve as the social point of contact for studio shows, working closely with producers and talent to identify, clip, and distribute real-time moments that resonate on social.

●    Create and publish platform-specific content from live shows, matches, and breaking news, including elevated vertical edits, behind-the-scenes content, and quick-turn graphics.

●    Track social performance, identify trends and standout moments, and share insights with studio producers to help inform future topics and segments.

●    Collaborate with the wider Golazo social team to ensure studio content aligns with overall brand voice and strategy.

Qualifications
●    3+ years of experience managing branded social media accounts, ideally within sports, media, or live production environments.

●    Strong editorial judgment and a clear understanding of what works across different social platforms.

●    Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro, with the ability to independently execute high-quality edits and graphics.

●    Deep passion for global football, with working knowledge of competitions including the UEFA Men’s and Women’s Champions League, domestic and international men's and women’s soccer in the U.S., Premier League, EFL, and more.

●    Experience publishing content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter/X.

●    Ability to work quickly and calmly under tight deadlines in a live studio setting.

●    Strong writing and storytelling skills, with excellent attention to detail.

●    Clear communication skills and confidence working directly with producers, talent, and teammates.

●    Flexibility to work evenings and weekends to support live shows and marquee matches.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

job.title: TOC/Editor
job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.

Overview:

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.

Overview

Reporting to team leadership, this role manages a project-based team of 3-5 resources building cloud-native media platforms, workflow automation, integrations, and AI-driven production services. 


The Senior Manager translates management's technical direction into executable engineering plans and owns day-to-day delivery, implementation quality, and production readiness. The role stays hands-on in solution design, code review, and high-risk work, and serves as a senior day-to-day technical lead, maintaining continuity of execution and technical direction. 

 


Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years hands-on software engineering experience building enterprise applications, APIs, or distributed systems.
  • 4+ years managing project-based engineering teams.
  • Strong development experience in Python or a comparable modern language.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS and/or GCP.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, security, and observability.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent engineering workstreams in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to select, lead, and maintain continuity across contract engineering teams.
  • Strong communication skills, able to translate technical risk and trade-offs for nontechnical stakeholders, with sound judgment under strain and the ability to influence across teams and vendors without direct authority. 

 


Core Responsibilities
Engineering & People Leadership

  • Select, onboard, direct, and evaluate consultant resources; manage vendor performance, project capacity, deliverables, and structured knowledge transfer as assignments change.
  • Build team depth so delivery and technical knowledge don't sit with one individual.
  • Stay hands-on in solution design, code review, troubleshooting, and high-risk work. 


Engineering Delivery

  • Translate architecture direction into technical plans, milestones, staffing, and releases.
  • Own backlog management, estimation, dependencies, scope, delivery risk, and release readiness.
  • Balance strategic projects, platform improvements, technical debt, and production needs.
  • Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements, define technical scope and acceptance criteria, and identify delivery risks before work begins.


Technical Leadership

  • Provide day-to-day technical direction within architecture standards set by leadership.
  • Set expectations for code quality, testing, APIs, documentation, security, and deployment automation.
  • Promote reusable services and integrations over one-off solutions.
  • Escalate significant architecture, platform, and vendor decisions to leadership.
  • Maintain enough architectural depth and institutional knowledge to represent the team's technical direction independently when leadership is unavailable. 


AI Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Ensure appropriate attention to security, identity, cost, monitoring, and supportability across cloud and AI services. 


Production Ownership

  • Own production readiness and engineering support for services built by the team.
  • Ensure monitoring, runbooks, deployment procedures, rollback plans, and escalation paths are in place.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring defects and reliability issues.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between frontline operational support and engineering escalation.

  • Experience with MAM/PAM platforms, metadata management, transcoding, workflow orchestration, or archive systems.

  • Experience with large-scale content migration and enterprise system integration.
