job.title: Creative Operations Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Creative Operations Lead to join Translation!

What You'll Do

The Creative Operations Lead is a critical operational leader at Translation, responsible for ensuring the right people are on the right work at the right time across every active account and initiative. This role sits at the center of the agency's capacity ecosystem, partnering closely with the Program Management team to keep delivery on track, talent balanced, and the business protected.

As Translation scales its resource planning capabilities — including the rollout of a new, intuitive staffing and capacity platform, this lead will serve as both the operational owner of that tool and the strategic steward of how people are planned, protected, and prioritized across billable and non-billable work.

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Own and manage staffing allocations across all active client accounts, ensuring people are planned accurately and updated in real time.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing adoption of Translation's new resource management platform, serving as the primary administrator and internal champion.
  • Surface capacity conflicts, volume pressure points, and over-allocation risks proactively — before they become delivery problems.
  • Partner daily with the PM team to align headcount plans with project timelines, scope changes, and shifting client demands.
  • Develop and maintain clear visibility into who is available, who is over-committed, and where gaps exist across all functions.
  • Track talent skills and passions.

Workload Balancing & Prioritization

  • Balance competing demands across billable client work, proactive creative opportunities, new business pitches, and internal initiatives.
  • Make and communicate clear recommendations on when and how to pull staff from non-billable work in service of billable priorities.
  • Establish and enforce workload thresholds that protect talent from burnout while maintaining agency output and quality.
  • Build frameworks for how to triage competing requests, ensuring leadership has the right information to make fast, informed staffing calls.

Freelancer Management

  • Proactively source and pipeline freelance talent in advance of high-volume periods, ensuring the agency is never caught flat-footed when capacity spikes.
  • Manage first holds on preferred freelancers across disciplines, maintaining relationships so Translation has priority access when demand peaks.
  • Negotiate freelance rates with an eye toward engagement length securing better terms for longer commitments while staying within agency margin thresholds.
  • Vet new freelancers in partnership with relevant discipline leads and key creative, strategy, and production leaders before adding them to the approved roster.
  • Own and maintain a current, organized freelancer database including rates, availability windows, past project history, and performance notes  so the agency can move quickly when a need arises.

Awards & Case Study Management

  • Own the end-to-end process for awards submissions tracking eligible work, managing timelines, coordinating materials, and submitting entries across relevant shows.
  • Build and maintain a living library of agency case studies, ensuring work is documented accurately and kept current across accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development, Business Leadership, Strategy, and Creative to capture the story behind Translation's best work in a format ready for new business, press, and agency promotion.
  • Develop a calendar and workflow for proactive awards planning to avoid last-minute scrambles.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the PM team, creating tight alignment between resource plans and delivery commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Leadership and Client Engagement teams on capacity and staffing strategy, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with People Operations on headcount planning, open role identification, and freelance needs driven by capacity gaps.
  • Represent resource management in agency planning conversations, including scoping, new business, and organizational design discussions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account staffing in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • Strong command of resource management tools and platforms; experience leading a tool rollout or system migration is a plus.
  • Experience managing or willing to learn managing awards submissions and/or case study development, with a clear understanding of how agency recognition supports business development.
  • A systems thinker who is equally comfortable in the weeds of a staffing grid and in a strategic conversation about organizational design.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can translate operational complexity into simple, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and maintains it under pressure.
  • High integrity around people data: this role has visibility into utilization and performance-adjacent information and must handle it with discretion.                                                                             

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in resource management, project management, creative operations, or a related function within a creative agency or marketing organization.
  • Deep understanding of how creative agencies work, the rhythms of production, the difference between billable and non-billable time, and how to protect both.
  • Freelance recruiting experience and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and enhancing a product or platform.
  • A strong network of freelance talent relationships.

About UnitedMasters, Inc. 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $140,000 - $165,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  

We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.description:
Title: Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts

Reports to: General Counsel, Meruelo Enterprises

About the Role:

The Associate Corporate Counsel - Construction and Commercial Contracts is a parent-company legal role responsible for supporting contract review, negotiation, risk management, and contract governance across Meruelo Enterprises and its subsidiaries. The position partners with subsidiary contract coordinators, business leaders, project teams, and corporate functions to promote consistent contracting practices, identify and mitigate risk, and support timely business decisions. The role provides legal guidance and functional oversight while each subsidiary contract coordinator remains responsible for local contract intake, administration, tracking, and execution support.

Key Responsibilities:

² Serve as the centralized legal resource for contracts submitted by Meruelo Enterprises subsidiaries and corporate departments.

² Review, draft, analyze, and negotiate construction contracts, subcontracts, master service agreements, professional services agreements, vendor and supplier agreements, purchase orders, nondisclosure agreements, leases, and other commercial agreements.

² Identify and communicate legal, operational, financial, insurance, and compliance risks in clear, practical business terms.

² Review and provide guidance on various union labor agreements.

² Reference utilizing Document Crunch.

² Prepare contract redlines and alternative language addressing indemnification, defense obligations, limitations of liability, consequential damages, insurance, bonding, payment, change orders, warranties, delays, liquidated damages, termination, dispute resolution, and other risk-allocation provisions.

² Advise executive leadership and subsidiary stakeholders regarding contractual obligations, exceptions, and recommended risk-mitigation strategies.

² Provide legal guidance and functional oversight to contract coordinators located within each subsidiary, including review of escalated issues and nonstandard terms.

² Establish consistent enterprise contract intake, legal review, approval, execution, retention, and escalation practices in partnership with subsidiary contract coordinators and business leaders.

² Develop and maintain approved templates, clause libraries, contract playbooks, review checklists, approval matrices, and negotiation guidelines.

² Support project teams during contract performance, including interpretation of notice requirements, change-order provisions, payment rights, claims procedures, and closeout obligations.

² Assist with construction and commercial disputes involving change orders, delays, payment, defaults, mechanics liens, stop notices, bond claims, collections, and other contract matters.

² Coordinate with outside counsel on specialized legal issues, disputes, litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other matters as directed by the General Counsel.

² Partner with Risk Management and insurance professionals to evaluate contractual insurance and indemnity requirements.

² Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Estimating, Procurement, Project Management, Human Resources, and executive leadership on contract-related matters.

² Provide training to contract coordinators and business stakeholders regarding contract risk, company standards, and escalation requirements.

² Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting construction and commercial contracting and recommend updates to templates, processes, and guidance.

² Maintain organized legal records and support reporting on contract volume, risk themes, cycle times, escalations, and other relevant metrics.

² Perform other legal duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

² Active membership in good standing with the State Bar of California.

² Two to three years of legal experience in commercial contracts, construction law, corporate transactions, procurement, real estate, or a related practice area.

² Demonstrated experience reviewing, drafting, or negotiating contracts through employment, a clerkship, internship, or law firm practice.

² Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and contract-drafting skills.

² Ability to explain legal issues and recommendations to nonlegal stakeholders in practical, business-focused terms.

² Ability to manage multiple matters, prioritize deadlines, and work across several subsidiaries in a fast-paced environment.

² Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn contract management and document-management systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

² Experience with construction, engineering, utilities, infrastructure, telecommunications, public works, or related industries.

² Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.

² Active membership in good standing with the State Bar of California.

² Familiarity with California construction law, public contracting, mechanics lien and stop-notice requirements, insurance, bonding, and construction claims.

² Experience supporting multiple business units, subsidiaries, or decentralized contract-administration teams.

² Prior in-house legal department experience or law firm experience representing construction or commercial clients.

² Experience developing contract templates, clause libraries, playbooks, or standardized review procedures.

² Bilingual English and Spanish skills are a plus.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements:

² Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment, with regular use of a computer and other standard office equipment.

² Ability to review detailed documents and remain seated for extended periods.

² Occasional travel to subsidiary offices, project locations, or legal proceedings may be required.

² Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTTV Fox 11 is seeking a per-diem Transmitter Engineer to support our primary broadcast transmitter facility atop Mt. Wilson during high profile events or emergencies.

This role requires extensive experience in television transmitter site operations and maintenance and the Mt. Wilson transmission complex.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.

Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PlutoTV pod. You will focus on Channel, Guide, and Schedule personalization. Your goal is to make the FAST (Free Ad-supported Streaming TV) experience feel as dynamic as a premium on-demand service. You will help build the models that select which channels appear in the guide and how content is scheduled to maximize viewer session length.   This role requires deep knowledge of FAST systems and the unique constraints of linear programming. You will implement features within our GCP stack, leveraging Qdrant for content similarity and Post-training RL to optimize the "Lean-back" viewing experience.   Why This Role Matters
  • Modernizing Linear TV: You are part of the team transforming the static EPG (Electronic Programming Guide) into a personalized, data-driven discovery engine.
  • Optimizing the "Lean-Back": Your models help users find something to watch immediately, reducing the friction inherent in "channel surfing."
  • Global Scale: PlutoTV is a leader in the FAST space; your code will impact the viewing habits of millions of users worldwide.
  Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development: Design and deploy ML components for channel ranking and guide personalization.
  • FAST Metadata Integration: Work with linear scheduling data to create features that account for "Current" vs "Next" program relevance.
  • Vector-Based Similarity: Use Qdrantto group similar channels and content to improve the "More Like This" experience within the guide.
  • Model Refinement: Train and iterate on models using TensorFlow/PyTorch, focusing on session-start and watch-time metrics.
  • Independent Execution: Own the delivery of defined tasks within the PlutoTV roadmap, from data exploration to production deployment.
  Basic Qualifications
  • Minimum: 3+ years in MLE; proficiency in Python/SQL; experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch and GCP.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred: Knowledge with FAST or Broadcast TV data structures; experience with Qdrant or similar vector databases.

Job Title: Coordinator, Business & Legal Affairs & Contract Administration
 

A Little Bit About Our Team: 
This role reports directly to the Business & Legal Affairs leadership team, providing comprehensive support across Business & Legal Affairs and Contract Administration. Our team serves as a critical bridge between legal operations, label management, A&R Administration, Licensing, and Royalties. We oversee the review and vetting of audio/video releases, maintain side artist clearances, manage third-party licensing requests, and handle administrative and legal workflows in a fast-paced environment.
 

Here You’ll Get To:

  • Contract Administration & Licensing:

    • Process, track, and clear incoming promotional clearance requests across active catalog releases, samplers, TV shows, and artwork, including drafting gratis licenses and no-objection letters.

    • Obtain internal and management approvals for third-party soundtrack and compilation licensing requests.

    • Research, maintain, and update side-artist clearance logs and legal records, including setting up and advising on market share splits 

  • Legal Operations & Rights Research:

    • Conduct contractual research regarding rights, restrictions, litigation, and licensing inquiries across various internal departments.

    • Review audio/video content for potential trademark, copyright, or SoundExchange conflict issues.

    • Prepare, send, and track execution-ready contract copies while maintaining organized legal filing systems.

  • Executive Support & Administrative Operations:

    • Manage calendar scheduling, call logs, meetings, and travel bookings for department leadership.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Roku
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

About the Role

We are seeking contract professionals to support live broadcast and media operations across both cloud-based and on-premise environments. This role will be based in the Stamford, CT office and work alongside engineering and operations teams to support real-time broadcast workflows, monitor system health, and assist in troubleshooting and system setup. Structured training will be provided, but this role requires initiative and the ability to quickly build confidence in fast-paced, live environments. The ideal candidate brings a base of broadcast knowledge, fluency in cloud workflows, and the ability to learn and adapt as our platforms Evolve.

 

The ideal candidate for this role appreciates the discipline and precision of traditional broadcast, while embracing the agility and innovation of modern streaming; someone who sees both worlds not as separate, but as converging.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support live broadcast operations across control rooms, cloud systems, and distribution platforms
  • Monitor signal flow, stream health, and system performance during live events
  • Assist with setup, configuration, testing, and validation of broadcast and media systems
  • Troubleshoot issues in real time and escalate clearly and efficiently
  • Follow established operational procedures while adapting to new tools and workflows
  • Collaborate with engineering, production, and operations teams to support live event execution
  • Contribute to documentation, process improvement, and knowledge sharing
  • Perform system updates, maintenance, and testing to ensure platform stability and readiness

 

 

Qualifications (Must-Have)

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in broadcast, media operations, or live streaming environments, with a genuine passion for the space
  • Familiarity with signal flow concepts (video, audio, or IP-based workflows)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow technical processes
  • Ability to learn new systems and tools quickly
  • Comfortable working in time-sensitive, live-event environments
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset

 

 

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Live Linear Playout System (AMPP, Amagi, Imagine…etc.)
  • Experience with SRT-based signal routing and distribution platforms (Netinsight, Techex, Haivision Gateway or similar)
  • Familiarity with closed captioning workflows in broadcast environments, including CEA-608/708 standards and AI-driven captioning services (EEG, AWS Transcribe, Verbit, or similar)
  • Basic experience with Linux or command-line tools
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, IAM, networking basics); familiarity with AWS Media Services a strong plus
  • Experience with OTT/streaming quality monitoring platforms (TagVS, Conviva, NPAW, or similar)

 

Training & Development

  • Structured onboarding with hands-on system training
  • Direct mentorship from engineering and operations staff
  • Exposure to modern cloud-based and IP-based broadcast workflows
  • Opportunity to take on increased responsibility as proficiency grows

 

Success in this Role Looks Like

  • Building confidence and reliability in live broadcast environments
  • Demonstrating strong situational awareness during live event support
  • Identifying, troubleshooting, and escalating issues effectively
  • Growing from task-based support into more independent operational ownership
  • Contributing to consistent, high-quality execution of live broadcasts

Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next

job.title: Director, Financial Reporting - SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a a Director, Financial Reporting to join our team in Nashville. As the Director, Financial Reporting you will own the Group’s consolidated financial reporting under US GAAP and will assist foreign subsidiary teams in relevant technical accounting areas, as necessary. In this role you will lead technical accounting research and conclusions, reviews contracts for the appropriate accounting treatment, supports M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, and work hands-on with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, intercompany eliminations and equity movements. As it relates to accurate and timely financial reporting, a key part of the role is leading the finance team’s adoption of AI to create efficiencies across the financial reporting process.

As the successful candidate, you will be comfortable working independently and shows initiative in identifying problems, leading solutions and ensuring appropriate resolution and recording in the general ledger. You will also be comfortable and confident in leading and presenting your work to both the finance team and company leadership, and bring exceptional analytical and critical-thinking skills, strong attention to detail, and clear, collaborative communication, together with a thorough, technical-level understanding of US GAAP.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Technical accounting research and interpretation of accounting guidance in areas such as business combinations, stock-based compensation, debt, software capitalization etc. and document conclusions in accounting memos on an as-needed basis.
  • Assessing accounting implications for complex transactions and guide the accounting team in accurately reflecting the accounting and financial reporting impact in the Company’s financial statements (both through journal entries and financial statements presentation).
  • Leading and guiding the team on AI implementation to create efficiencies in the financial reporting process. This would entail running process deep dives to identify where AI can improve operational and reporting efficiency and delivering those improvements.
  • Supporting M&A transactions from an accounting and general-ledger perspective, including purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, GL recording and integration of acquired entities to help implement standardized processes related to financial reporting.
  • Reviewing nonstandard contracts, including revenue, debt, investment etc. to determine the appropriate accounting treatment and document the conclusions.
  • Implementing and evaluating new accounting standards.
  • Reviewing monthly and quarterly consolidation and primary statements at the group level.
  • Taking a hands-on approach with the subsidiary finance teams on consolidation, US GAAP and local GAAP differences, intercompany eliminations, settlements, and equity movements etc., ensuring group figures are complete, accurate and well-supported.
  • Preparing annual US GAAP consolidated financial statements including drafting of disclosures.
  • Serving as the primary liaison for the external auditors for overall audit management, including presenting and defending accounting positions taken by the Company.
  • Working cross-functionally with other departments to increase financial reporting accuracy.
  • Assisting and overseeing special projects as assigned.
  • Other duties as needed and assigned by supervisor.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related field, or equivalent combination of education & experience.
  • 5+ years high-quality experience in a technical accounting and/or financial reporting role.
  • 2+ years public account experience preferred.
  • Active CPA license required.
  • Big 4 public accounting firm experience strongly preferred.
  • A confident self-starter — comfortable working independently, taking initiative to solve problems, work collaboratively with the finance team to lead solutions through to completion, and presenting work to both the finance team and leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations and settlements, and equity movements.
  • Experience supporting M&A transactions — purchase accounting, opening balance sheets, and GL recording and integration of acquired entities.
  • Experience reporting under both US GAAP and foreign GAAP (IFRS or local) preferred.
  • Comfortable adopting and working with new technology, with a curiosity for emerging tools — including AI — and how they can improve financial reporting.
  • Have exceptional attention to detail and an ability to effectively prioritize work to meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Office products (especially Excel).

This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Function

  • Implement continuous detection: Develop and execute procedures to detect inadvertently exposed services, expired or vulnerable certificates and leaked credentials or source code on the public web.

  • Define the scanning strategy: Establish the scope and frequency of automated and manual vulnerability scans across the entire IT environment.

Monitor residual risk levels, update mitigation plans and present clear status reports to governance and executive committees to inform adjudication and investment decisions.

  • Drive program evolution and threat intelligence: Continually enhance security tools and processes to address emerging threats (e.g., zero-day vulnerabilities). Monitor global vulnerability trends, proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits and evolving frameworks (e.g., CVSS v4, MITRE ATT&CK).

    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.

Corus est une force motrice de l'industrie des médias, avec un portefeuille diversifié de marques reconnues qui divertissent et informent les auditoires par le biais de récits exceptionnels et de contenu captivant, touchant chaque jour des millions de personnes à travers le monde entier.

Notre culture et notre équipe sont ce qui fait de nous, noUS.

Nous sommes passionnés par le désir de tisser des liens avec le monde qui nous entoure : nous voulons exprimer, échanger et faire partie de la vie des gens. Notre culture primée est l'expression de qui nous sommes, ce que nous faisons et comment nous prospérons. Nos valeurs représentent notre culture en action. Elles décrivent notre manière d'atteindre nos objectifs, de travailler ensemble, de nous engager avec nos partenaires et d'interagir avec nos collectivités. Chez Corus, nous Gagnons ensemble, Pensons différemment, Faisons avancer les choses, Apprenons chaque jour, et Démontrons notre bienveillance.

Prêt à vous joindre à noUS?

Description de l'entreprise

Corus exploite au Québec les marques de télévision spécialisée francophone Historia, Séries plus, Télétoon et la plateforme francophone Vivéo.

Sommaire du poste

Corus cherche une candidate pour combler rapidement le poste de Voix hors champs pour la chaîne de télévision Séries Plus. Ce poste temporaire d’une durée d’un an est situé à Montréal.

Vous relèverez du directeur créatif et durant les sessions d'enregistrement, serez dirigée par un membre de notre équipe de réalisation.

Description des tâches/Responsabilités

• Effectuer dans notre studio d’enregistrement la narration des auto-promos de la chaîne Séries Plus sous la direction de notre équipe de réalisation.

• Interpréter les textes promotionnels en respectant le ton, le style et l’identité de la marque Séries Plus.

• Adapter la prestation vocale selon les directives créatives et les besoins spécifiques de chaque campagne promotionnelle.

• Faire preuve de flexibilité quant aux horaires d’enregistrement

• Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes créatives, de production et de postproduction afin de livrer un produit final de haute qualité.

• Contribuer à créer une expérience de marque engageante pour les téléspectateurs grâce à une interprétation authentique et professionnelle.

• Être diplômé(e) en théâtre et/ou en cinéma.

Exigences

• Avoir une excellente diction

• Collaborer avec notre équipe de réalisation lors des sessions d’enregistrement

• Démontrer une très bonne expérience en cinéma, télévision et/ou théatre

• Très bonne connaissance du français, parlé et écrit

Date limite de soumission des candidatures : le 18 septembre, 2026

Candidat(e)s internes

Chaque jour, nous travaillons forts pour devenir un lieu de travail encore plus diversifié, équitable et inclusif, qui favorise le bien-être de nos employés et apporte une contribution positive à nos communautés. Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? Consultez notre plan d'action pour la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion ainsi que notre rapport sur le développement durable pour obtenir plus d'informations sur notre approche en matière de personnes, de planète et de responsabilité.

Nous voulons que notre main-d'œuvre reflète toute la diversité des communautés à travers le Canada.

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience accessible à tous les candidats, quelles que soient leurs capacités. job.title: Board, Executive Assistant
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Legal

Status: Full-Time (Hybrid)

Location: Toronto, ON

About the Role

The Board Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and organizational support to the Board of Directors and Executive Leadership. As a trusted partner, this role ensures the smooth and efficient operation of Board activities, executive schedules, meetings, travel, and confidential communications.

The successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced public company environment and brings exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion when working with sensitive information and senior stakeholders.

You Will Contribute By

• Providing comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the Board of Directors, including meeting planning, scheduling, catering, logistics, and on-site coordination and support.

• Preparing, coordinating, and distributing Board packages and materials, including agendas, presentations, briefing documents, and other confidential materials.

• Maintaining Board calendars, annual meeting schedules, and key governance deadlines.

• Serving as a primary point of contact for Board members and Executive Leadership.

• Managing complex calendars, competing priorities, and shifting schedules with a high degree of discretion and judgment.

• Coordinating Board and executive travel arrangements, including itineraries and related logistics.

• Preparing correspondence, presentations, reports, briefing materials, and other executive communications.

• Ensuring meeting action items and follow-up documentation are completed and appropriately distributed.

• Managing directors’ expenses, invoices, and other administrative activities.

• Coordinating confidential communications and handling sensitive matters with professionalism and discretion.

• Supporting other board and executive activities and initiatives as required.

Skills & Experience You Will Bring

• Demonstrated experience supporting boards of directors, board committees, C-suite executives, or senior leadership teams.

• Experience in Board administration and a strong understanding of corporate governance practices.

• Experience working in a public company, publicly traded organization, or highly regulated environment is preferred.

• Experience in media, telecommunications, broadcasting, or a similarly complex corporate environment is an asset.

• Proven ability to support multiple executives and/or Board Committees simultaneously while managing competing priorities.

• Experience coordinating board or executive-level meetings, events, travel, and governance processes.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams.

• Experience with Board portal software, such as Diligent Boards or an equivalent platform, is an asset.

• Exceptional organizational, communication, and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Excellent judgment and the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Outstanding professionalism, discretion, and integrity when handling confidential and sensitive information.

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with executives, Board members, and colleagues at all levels of the organization.

Application Deadline: September 29, 2026

Every day, we work hard to become an even more diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace that supports the well-being of our people and makes a positive difference in our communities. Want to learn more? Have a look at our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Action Plan and Sustainability Report for more information on our approach to People, Planet and Responsibility.

We want our workforce to reflect the full diversity of communities across Canada.

Global Toronto is currently looking for a Full-Time Producer to join their team. Reporting to the Executive Producer Multi-Market Content & OTT, the successful candidate will be an experienced and creative producer, who is passionate about news. A journalist who understands what it takes to create smart, innovative, and impactful live programming, and approaches it from a multi-platform view. • Having the ability to be a strong team player on the editorial team.

• Working with fellow producers and writers to maintain Global News editorial standards.

• Planning, selecting, and requesting production and resource elements.

• Working with affiliates and other Global News departments to co-ordinate coverage and resources.

• Displaying strong editorial judgement.

• Planning and producing special events and breaking news coverage.

• Occasionally taking live programs to air in a control room setting, in a calm and decisive manner.

• A university degree or equivalent post-secondary education in a broadcast-related field.

• The ability to respond quickly and knowledgeably to breaking news.

• Exemplary leadership and communication skills.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and maintain creativity in a high-pressure, deadline-oriented environment.

• Ability to handle the demands and pressure of broadcast deadlines.

iHeartMedia Markets

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

We’re seeking an experienced Broadcast Transmission Engineer to maintain our digital broadcasting electronic systems

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain overall digital broadcasting electronic systems and related equipment for optimum transmission/broadcast performance

  • Maintain traditional radio and digital broadcasting electronic systems and equipment, including, but not limited to, RF switchers, transmitters, transceivers, studio consoles and associated audio equipment

  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions and related technical problems

  • Conduct routine diagnostic testing, repair and replacement of all equipment used for radio station broadcasts

  • Assist clients, fellow technicians and service personnel in the installation, training and support of software, hardware and related third party peripheral components, including, but not limited to, file servers, commercial grade workstations, networking switches, NICs, monitors, KVMs and radio equipment

  • Document equipment maintenance, repair and replacements

  • Make decisions about test equipment, parts and related tools needed for use in maintenance and repair

  • Install, maintain and support desktop computer equipment for internal users as well as company-owned sites within market

  • Periodic travel to other iHeartMedia locations to assist in equipment installation or troubleshooting

  • Occasional night and weekend work is expected and must be on-call and available to respond 24-7

  • Service oriented work requiring excellent written and oral communication, as well as daily and personable interaction with executive management, programming and sales departments

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Previous radio broadcast experience is required

  • Associate degree or greater in a technical field or equivalent experience is required

  • SBE certification is a plus

  • Ability to climb ladders, work in small spaces and have the ability to lift 50 pounds

  • Valid state driver’s license and an excellent driving record

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • SBE Certification a plus
  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function
  • Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
  • Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
  • Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

job.title: Fleet Manager
job.description:
Title: Fleet Manager

Reports to: VP of Operations

 

Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Fleet Manager to oversee the vehicles and specialized equipment supporting our underground civil and electric utility construction operations.

This position is responsible for fleet safety, availability, maintenance, compliance, utilization, and cost control. The Fleet Manager will work closely with operations, safety, accounting, purchasing, and field leadership to ensure equipment is properly assigned, maintained, inspected, documented, and ready to support daily production.

Our fleet includes service and foreman trucks, pickups, dump trucks, trailers, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, vacuum excavators, bucket trucks, digger derricks, and other utility-construction equipment.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Manage the daily operation, maintenance, assignment, and utilization of company vehicles, trailers, and construction equipment.

²  Maintain accurate fleet records, including unit numbers, registrations, insurance, inspections, warranties, service histories, mileage, and operating hours.

²  Develop and manage preventive-maintenance and inspection schedules.

²  Ensure compliance with DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and applicable state and federal requirements.

²  Coordinate equipment repairs, breakdown response, towing, rentals, and replacement units to minimize field downtime.

²  Review repair estimates and approve work within established authorization limits.

²  Track fleet expenses, including maintenance, repairs, fuel, tires, rentals, registrations, and insurance.

²  Monitor fuel-card activity, identify unusual usage, and ensure transactions are assigned to the correct vehicle, employee, and project.

²  Manage rental equipment and vehicles, including approvals, extensions, off-rent dates, damage documentation, and invoice reconciliation.

²  Coordinate the assignment, transfer, and return of vehicles and equipment between projects, yards, and employees.

²  Ensure all company units are properly numbered, branded, equipped, and documented before deployment.

²  Manage GPS, telematics, dash-camera, and driver-performance systems.

²  Monitor equipment utilization and recommend when to purchase, lease, transfer, replace, or dispose of assets.

²  Conduct regular fleet audits and yard inspections.

²  Maintain vendor relationships and negotiate pricing for repairs, parts, tires, fuel, rentals, and fleet services.

²  Support incident investigations involving company vehicles or equipment.

²  Verify that operators and drivers are properly licensed, qualified, and authorized for assigned equipment.

²  Develop and enforce fleet policies, inspection procedures, and accountability standards.

²  Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering fleet availability, downtime, utilization, repair costs, fuel consumption, rentals, and compliance.

²  Support project planning by confirming that the correct equipment is available, compliant, and job-ready.

 

Qualifications:

²  Five or more years of fleet-management experience, preferably within underground utilities, electrical construction, heavy civil construction, or a related field.

²  Strong working knowledge of construction vehicles and specialized utility equipment.

²  Experience managing preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, registrations, rentals, and fleet records.

²  Knowledge of DOT, DMV, BIT, CHP, OSHA, and commercial-vehicle compliance requirements.

²  Experience with GPS, telematics, fleet-management, fuel-card, and asset-tracking systems.

²  Ability to review repair estimates, identify unnecessary costs, and make sound repair-versus-replacement decisions.

²  Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

²  Ability to work effectively with field employees, foremen, superintendents, project managers, mechanics, vendors, and executive leadership.

²  Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and fleet-reporting systems.

²  Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

²  Ability to visit project locations and respond to urgent fleet issues when necessary.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

²  Experience supporting underground civil and electric transmission and distribution operations.

²  Familiarity with bucket trucks, digger derricks, vacuum excavators, backhoes, excavators, skid steers, dump trucks, and commercial trailers.

²  Experience managing a multi-location fleet.

²  Commercial Driver’s License is a plus.

²  Experience with Samsara, ToolWatch, Fleetio, or similar platforms.

²  Technical or mechanical background is highly desirable.

²  Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

 

Performance Expectations:

²  The successful candidate will be measured on:

²  Fleet availability and equipment uptime

²  Preventive-maintenance completion

²  Regulatory and inspection compliance

²  Repair and maintenance costs

²  Fuel and rental cost control

²  Accurate fleet records and asset accountability

²  Reduction in preventable breakdowns and vehicle incidents

²  Timely support of field operations

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Director, AI Execution & Operations
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

 

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.
  • Maintain consistent executive communication and reporting cadences.
  • Manage operational relationships with AI vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and service providers.
  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education, professional experience, certifications, and demonstrated success leading technology transformation, AI adoption, operational excellence, automation, and organizational change will be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant work in technology, AI adoption, operational leadership, change management, enterprise program execution, business operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives with executive visibility and measurable business outcomes.
  • Natural curiosity and a track record of applying technology, automation, or AI to solve business problems and improve operational outcomes.
  • Track record of translating business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions and operational improvements.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and applying Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, automation, or related AI technologies in a business environment.
  • Deploying, governing, supporting, or driving adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot and related AI capabilities, or comparable AI platforms.
  • Leading or supporting enterprise AI, Generative AI, automation, digital transformation, or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partnering across business, technology, vendor, and executive stakeholder groups to successfully execute AI initiatives and drive business value.
  • Driving technology adoption, communications, stakeholder engagement, and AI enablement programs.
  • Building executive reporting, KPI frameworks, operational dashboards, and business performance metrics.
  • Measuring AI utilization, productivity gains, business impact, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience building and scaling solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
  • Experience establishing AI governance, adoption, enablement, or value realization frameworks.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience scaling AI initiatives from pilot programs into ongoing business operations.
  • Understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, connectors, and business process automation.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate and Power BI.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into scalable operational execution.
  • Background in media, broadcasting, advertising technology, revenue technology, or digital operations.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Digital Content Producer - KIRO TV

 

Position Overview

KIRO 7 News is seeking a Digital Content Center Producer to help drive audience growth, maximize engagement, and lead our digital-first news strategy.

 

This role is central to how we cover breaking news, elevate enterprise journalism, and connect with audiences across web, mobile, OTT, search, and social platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is an expert in digital audience development, SEO, and content optimization, with strong editorial judgment and exceptional writing and editing skills. They understand how audiences discover news, what drives engagement and loyalty, and how to use analytics to make real-time content decisions. They thrive in fast-moving news environments, know how to identify high-impact stories, and can quickly adapt coverage strategies based on audience trends and performance data.

 

This is a hands-on, on-site role within the Content Center. Digital Content Center Producers collaborate closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom leadership to ensure KIRO 7 is first, fastest, and most accurate online while continuously expanding our digital audience and strengthening our position as Western Washington's leading local news source.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor local and national news, field calls and tips, listen to police and emergency scanners, and track developing stories through public records and court systems.
  • Communicate and coordinate with newsroom staff and sources as stories develop.
  • Write, edit, and publish content across digital platforms including KIRO7.com, the mobile app, OTT, social media channels, and push alerts.

job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking a Digital Traffic Specialist to own the execution and quality control of digital advertising orders across the station portfolio. Reporting
