You will be an editorial leader with keen news judgment, high standards and an uncompromising attention to detail. You will be comfortable making independent editorial decisions in accordance with the CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices, ensuring our work upholds the principles of accuracy, fairness, balance, impartiality and integrity, and you are familiar with the legal issues that can arise in news coverage.

You will put audience needs at the centre of your decision-making, ensuring our news content connects our audiences to the news they need to know, the stories that affect their lives and the issues that resonate in their communities. You will strive to broaden the range of perspectives and experiences reflected in our news content, especially those from people who have been traditionally underrepresented in the media.  

As an experienced mentor, you are a thoughtful coach and collaborative team player, someone who deeply enjoys helping journalists develop their writing skills and produce content of the highest quality.

This role requires full-time on-site presence in Iqaluit, Yellowknife or Whitehorse.

Hours of Work: 12:00pm-8:45pm

Your responsibilities:

  • Copy edit breaking, enterprise and feature news content, as well as multimedia projects, newsletters, social media copy, video titles and photo descriptions.

  • Work with writers and editors to ensure content meets high editorial standards including identifying and fixing issues related to accuracy, structure, story flow and context, as well as maintaining consistency in style. 

  • Write compelling headlines that drive audience interest and engagement.

  • Quickly write breaking news and curate website lineups as needed.

  • Build and package digital stories with multimedia content

  • Monitor news developments to maintain content on CBC North’s website that reflects the latest news and varied content of interest to our audiences.

  • Provide coaching and feedback to help journalists and freelancers develop their skills.

  • Assist in communicating digital news best practices.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced, daily multi-platform news environment. 

  • Strong journalistic and critical thinking skills, including knowledge of and familiarity with CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices as well as the legal and ethical issues related to journalism.

  • Ability to manage and organize large volumes of fast-moving information

  • Substantial experience in copy editing content for digital and social platforms, including fact-checking, legal vetting and packaging.

  • Advanced knowledge of web, mobile and social media tools and industry and audience trends.

  • Deep knowledge of Canadian Press style. Knowledge of CBCNews.ca style is an asset.

  • Superior communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.

  • A high-energy leader with a positive, team-first attitude and the demonstrated ability to motivate and coach teams, and encourage creativity.

  • A strong proven connection to the communities we serve in all three territories. 

  • A keen desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture. 

  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours as required.

  • Possession of a valid driver’s licence as well as a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada's insurance company.

job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Corus Radio

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Guelph, ON (On-site)

About the Role:

We have an exciting opportunity for a passionate and creative broadcaster to join our team as a Network Midday Host / Programming Assistant.

Based in Guelph, this full-time role offers a unique combination of daily on-air hosting and hands-on contributions to programming,

content development, and station operations, making you an integral part of the team both on-air and behind the scenes.

You'll host middays across multiple Hot AC stations, connecting with listeners through engaging, relatable content while helping execute the programming strategy behind the scenes.

We're looking for someone who is organized, adaptable, digitally savvy, and enthusiastic about creating great radio.

You'll work closely with programming leadership to support music scheduling, content planning, promotions, social media, and day-to-day programming needs.

You will contribute by:

• Hosting a compelling and engaging weekday midday show.

• Creating relatable, topical, and entertaining content that connects with Hot AC listeners.

• Assisting with programming execution, music scheduling, and daily log management.

• Preparing and organizing show content, contests, promotions, and station features.

• Supporting station websites, social channels, and digital content initiatives.

• Collaborating with programming and on-air teams to execute station strategies and promotions.

• Recording commercial, promotional, and imaging content as required.

• Voice tracking additional stations and supporting network programming initiatives.

• Assisting with promotional appearances, station events, and community activations.

• Helping identify and execute revenue-friendly programming and promotional opportunities.

• Providing vacation and short-notice coverage for other dayparts when required.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• 2 to 5 years of radio broadcasting experience preferred.

• Previous on-air hosting experience with a strong understanding of audience engagement.

• Excellent content creation skills across on-air, social, digital, and video platforms.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

• Experience with music scheduling and programming systems is considered an asset.

• A solid understanding of the Hot AC format and current music trends.

• Strong social media instincts with a proven ability to create engaging content.

• Experience recording and editing audio and video content.

• A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to collaborate.

• Comfortable using industry technology and broadcast tools to execute a professional, polished show.

• Valid driver's license and willingness to participate in station events and promotions.

job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Revenue (Digital Sales)

Status: Full Time (Hybrid)

Location: Toronto

About the Role

You will work with Account Managers on the National Sales team in a client-facing role that supports all digital sales. As the National Digital Strategist, you are responsible for developing and executing strategic digital and integrated campaigns that align with client objectives, agency requirements, and key performance indicators. In addition, you act as the national team’s digital subject-matter lead by bringing forward strong recommendations on packaging, targeting, measurement, and performance. You will help ensure campaigns launch smoothly, deliver against client KPIs, and generate renewal and incremental revenue opportunities.

You will contribute by:

• Work closely with National Account Managers to understand each advertiser’s performance objectives, success criteria, and key points of contact; be empowered to present recommendations, solutions, and implementation approaches that drive revenue generation and upselling.

• Support the pre-sale process by assisting with RFPs/proposals, sourcing research, providing historical performance proof points, and supplying examples of reporting and measurement approaches.

• Attend client/agency meetings and presentations to provide consultation on the role of digital in the campaign; support Account Managers in preparing for pitches and presenting solutions.

• Manage the day-to-day digital direct, integrated, and programmatic guaranteed campaign details during post-sale; ensure launch readiness, pacing, optimization, and delivery against contracted goals and communicated KPIs.

• Work with Ad Operations, Programmatic, Revenue Management, Product, and other internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns are successfully launched—on time, on budget, and aligned to requirements; facilitate resolution of issues and coordinate changes based on partner recommendations.

• Maintain understanding of privacy and industry standards (e.g., site terms of use, consent/compliance considerations, IAB standards, brand safety, sensitive categories) and keep up to date with digital industry trends and Corus digital brand performance.

• Support internal stakeholders on digital product offerings and best practices; contribute to playbooks, templates, and ongoing training to improve digital fluency across the National Sales team.

• Monitor and optimize live campaigns; prepare, analyze, and communicate performance reporting and post-campaign insights that highlight learnings, renewal opportunities, and future advertising recommendations; identify process-efficiency opportunities and act on them.

Skills and experience you will bring

• 2–5+ years of experience in digital advertising (inside sales, digital strategy, and/or ad operations), ideally supporting national accounts and/or the agency buying community.

• Knowledge of the digital advertising landscape, including ad serving, brand safety, viewability, measurement pixels, and common third-party verification (e.g., IAS, MOAT, DV).

• Experience with digital platforms and programmatic concepts (DSPs, SSPs, DMPs) and understanding of video, display, and mobile assets.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort presenting recommendations to clients/agencies and collaborating across internal teams.

• Aptitude for analytics: ability to interpret performance results, identify optimization opportunities, and translate data into actionable insights and next steps.

• Strong ownership, interpersonal skills, and stakeholder management across Sales, Ad Operations, Programmatic, Revenue Management, and Product.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, client-focused environment; highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

• Proficient in MS Office and comfortable learning new systems; familiarity with Salesforce, AdBook/AdStore, and/or Google Ad Manager is an asset.

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

Here's what we're looking for... 

  • Minimum 1 year of hands-on ministry experience required.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience working in a customer service environment required.
  • Previous ministry training required (volunteer, leadership or staff training)
  • Solid understanding of scripture and demonstrate strong knowledge of God's word.
  • Able to demonstrate discernment on spiritual issues and have excellent listening skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong computer skills;  MS Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook), and Social Media platforms, ability to learn new systems.  Keyboarding speed of about 45+ WPM.
  • Ability to multi-task inbound/outbound calls and verbal/written communication with accuracy and excellence.
  • Associates degree (or higher) in biblical studies, theology or equivalent a plus!
  • Bilingual skills a plus!
  • This is an on-site position, so candidates within commute distance of Franklin, TN preferred.
  • Most importantly, someone who is grounded in their faith and passionate about the mission of K-LOVE.  (Our Mission, Values & Beliefs)

 *Must be able to work holidays as needed.

 

Location:   On-site in Franklin, TN 

Available Schedule:   Tuesday - Saturday  2:00pm - 10:30pm or Sunday - Thursday 2:00pm -10:30pm

 

Want to know more? As a Care Team Specialist I, here are a few things you'd be doing...

  • Maintain a commitment to model our Care Team Values in every interaction with our ministry contacts and the rest of the Care Team.
  • Practice the “5Cs” on every call and interaction (where applicable) across all our ministry channels.
  • Answer prayer line calls and screens for appropriate support based on caller communication.
  • Provide professional and personal experience, demonstrating empathy and care about their struggles, needs, and concerns.
  • When necessary, completes prayer edits, and perform other tasks for the ministry.
  • Support additional channels, such as emails, chat, text, multi-language, generation-specific, etc. if necessary.
  • When appropriate, transfer callers to pastors or other departments for additional support. This includes triaging, and appropriately transferring crisis calls.
  • Meet and exceed minimum expectations for work production, quality, and team culture.
  • Maintain command of essential Care Team tasks and an understanding of the Care Team ethos.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in initial Care Team tasks and responsibilities.
  • Proactively respond to inquiries; clearly and positively communicate solutions with exceptional follow through.
  • Collaborate with other departments as appropriate.
  • Assure a high level of accuracy when providing information about K-LOVE.
  • Effectively collaborate and communicate with peers. Model and communicate best practices while maintaining your own spiritual, mental, physical, and relational health.
  • Participate in additional training as necessary to keep skills current.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality with listener information and records.
  • Pastoral Care is a support department and is not closed on holidays. As a result, we generally have a reduced team scheduled on holidays, but it is expected that all team members will share coverage and annual rotations.

 

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

Good Karma Sports is seeking an experienced, results-driven Marketing Consultant to join our ESPN Milwaukee sales team. We are looking for a motivated sales professional who is passionate about building relationships and helping local and regional businesses grow. As a Marketing Consultant, you will develop new business, build long-term relationships with advertising partners and create customized marketing solutions utilizing ESPN Milwaukee and Good Karma Sports assets across audio, digital, social, video, live sports and events.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Identify, develop and secure new business opportunities throughout the Milwaukee market and State of Wisconsin.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with current and prospective partners while identifying opportunities for continued growth.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of ESPN Milwaukee and Good Karma Sports assets, audiences and marketing opportunities.
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions utilizing audio, digital, social, video, live sports, events and other ESPN Milwaukee and Good Karma Sports assets.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations and proposals that align marketing strategies with partner goals.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution and fulfillment of partner campaigns.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive activity and local market opportunities.
  • Consistently work toward individual and team revenue goals through new business development and growth of existing partnerships.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve new business outreach, partner research, campaign development, communication and sales effectiveness while maintaining a high level of personalization and partner interaction.
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Teamwork and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • 3+ years of sales experience, preferably in the Milwaukee market, sports media or advertising sales.
  • Experience selling play-by-play/live sports and/or existing relationships with advertisers who target sports content preferred.
  • Strong network and relationships within the Milwaukee business community.
  • Goal-oriented and creative self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit and strong follow-through.
  • Strong communication, organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative teammate who can work effectively as part of a team and independently, with a willingness to seek, accept and provide feedback.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office and emerging technology.
  • With this career, you are required to hold a valid driver’s license 

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is an exempt role with a competitive base salary plus commission. Actual compensation will be based on experience, skills and performance expectations. 

This role is eligible for full benefits to include health, dental, vision, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave and more, with opportunities for compensation growth based on skills, responsibilities and performance. The position will be required to work some evenings and weekends for events and games. 

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than September 30, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

KMTV, the E.W. Scripps CBS affiliate in Omaha, Nebraska, is seeking an experienced Multimedia Journalist to research, write, shoot, and edit compelling stories across multiple platforms. You'll cover the stories that matter most to our community while working both independently and collaboratively in an award-winning newsroom. We are looking for journalists with experience who want to continue growing their skills. Omaha is Nebraska's largest city, offering a blend of Midwest values and urban opportunities. With affordable living, a thriving downtown, and attractions like the Henry Doorly Zoo and the historic Old Market district, Omaha delivers big-city amenities with a strong sense of community. Apply today and work with a fantastic management team!

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.

  • Organize material and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assist in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.

  • Appear on TV in live and recorded situations.

  • Work cooperatively with photographers assigned to stories, if one is assigned.

  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.

  • Assist online staff in preparing for multimedia stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred

  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment

  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

#LI-SM2

#LI-ONSITE

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Hunt Valley, MD. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 Years experience in Master Control Operations functions (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 


 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
 About Us 

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.


 About the Team
 The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk. The hourly compensation range for this role is $18.50 to $19.00.  Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - ESPN
job.description:
Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.

A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology

  • Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

  • Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.

  • Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news.

Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity.

Job Summary:

ESPN is investing in large‑scale data infrastructure and real‑time processing platforms that power next‑generation personalization and live sports experiences. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will focus on building and operating distributed data and ML infrastructure that supports high‑throughput, low‑latency data processing and real‑time ML use cases.

In this role, you will work closely with senior MLEs, data engineers, platform/SRE, and product teams to develop streaming data pipelines, feature computation systems, and ML‑adjacent services that operate reliably at scale. The role emphasizes hands‑on engineering, strong fundamentals in distributed systems, and practical experience operating production data infrastructure.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

1) Large-Scale Data Processing & Streaming Systems

  • Build and maintain high‑throughput batch and streaming data pipelines to support ML, analytics, and real‑time decisioning use cases.

  • Implement data ingestion, enrichment, aggregation, and transformation workflows using modern distributed data frameworks.

  • Ensure pipelines meet latency, reliability, and data quality requirements for downstream ML and product teams.

2) Real‑Time Data & Feature Infrastructure

  • Develop and operate systems that support real‑time feature computation and delivery for online ML services.

  • Work with feature stores and event‑driven architectures to ensure consistency between offline and online data.

  • Improve data freshness, schema evolution, and backward compatibility in streaming environments.

3) ML-Adjacent infrastructure & Platform Engineering

  • Build and operate ML‑adjacent services such as inference inputs, feature APIs, and data access layers.

  • Contribute to scalable service patterns including autoscaling, rollout strategies, and resiliency mechanisms.

  • Partner with platform/SRE teams to improve system availability, performance, and cost efficiency.

4) Reliability, Observability & Operations

  • Instrument data and ML infrastructure with metrics, logging, and alerting to support production operations.

  • Participate in on‑call rotations and incident response for data and ML platforms.

  • Identify and remediate data pipeline failures, performance regressions, and operational risks.

3)  Collaboration & Engineering Execution

  • Collaborate with applied ML and data science teams to enable production ML workflows through reliable data systems.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.

  • Follow established platform standards and contribute incremental improvements over time

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Basic Qualification:

  • Experience building and operating large‑scale data or ML systems in production.

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and data processing architectures.

  • Hands‑on experience with streaming and batch data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, Flink, or equivalent).

  • Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Java, Scala, Go, or C++.

  • Experience operating systems in cloud‑native environments (AWS, containers, Kubernetes, IaC tools).

  • Familiarity with observability and operational best practices for production systems.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across engineering and data teams

Preferred qualification:

  • Experience supporting real‑time personalization, recommendation, or analytics systems.

  • Familiarity with feature stores, event‑driven architectures, and real‑time ML pipelines.

  • Exposure to ML infrastructure concepts such as inference pipelines, data validation, and model lifecycle tooling.

  • Experience optimizing data systems for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency.

  • Understanding of experimentation platforms and data instrumentation for online systems.

Experience with:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building data‑intensive or ML‑adjacent systems in production

Required Education  

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field


The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $148,700 - $199,400 per year and in Glendale, CA is $141,900 - $190,300. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

job.description:

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

CBS News Streaming Network is seeking a Segment Producer to join its team at the New York City Broadcast Center. This role is responsible for researching, developing, and producing high-quality, compelling news segments in a fast-paced, live environment.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Research, develop, and produce segments that incorporate robust editorial judgment, high-quality sound, graphics, maps, and banners.
  • Collaborate with Executive Producers and Line Producers to write anchor questions and shape segment content.
  • Coordinate closely with anchors and correspondents, providing detailed briefings on subject matter.
  • Actively contribute in the control room during live broadcasts, ensuring smooth execution of segments.
  • Pitch and refine timely, relevant, and compelling story ideas under tight deadlines.
  • Exercise well-developed editorial judgment to identify stories with high potential for impactful storytelling.
  • Participate in daily editorial meetings and contribute to show content development.
  • Ensure compliance with standards, rights, and clearances in coordination with senior production staff.
  • Maintain composure and professionalism in high-pressure, breaking news environments.
  • Demonstrate well-developed control room awareness and adhere to established production protocols.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of newsroom experience.
  • Well-developed background in journalism, including exemplary news judgment and critical thinking skills.
  • Exemplary writing skills, including mastery of grammar, spelling, AP style, and broadcast writing.
  • Proven ability to write clear, accurate, and engaging copy under deadline pressure.
  • Ability to pass a comprehensive CBS News writing test.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience within a national broadcast, cable, or streaming news organization.
  • Familiarity with ENPS or similar newsroom systems.
  • Line producing experience.
  • Deep knowledge of current events, including international, national, political, and cultural news.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments across both scheduled programming and breaking news coverage.
  • Experience working in live television environments with tight turnaround times.
  • Well-developed collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within a team.
  • Well-developed understanding of political news and public affairs.
  • Knowledge of digital and social media platforms and content strategy.
  • Passion for emerging trends in digital and streaming media.
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute meaningfully in both editorial planning and live production settings.
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 5 days/week in the office (current schedule is 3 am - 11 am ET; schedule subject to change based on business needs). Must be flexible and available for on-call shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required in a 24-hour news operation.

CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. Lead Product Designer, CBS Sports App

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.

 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

Job Title

Associate Social Media Editor & In-House Content Creator - Byrdie

Job Description

Byrdie is looking for a passionate and creative addition to our social media team! This role touches every part of Byrdie’s social presence—from creating, hosting, shooting, and editing video to community management, daily meetings and publishing, brainstorming captions, and developing and launching new social series. The ideal candidate lives and breathes the internet, with a strong pulse on pop culture and entertainment, beauty and fashion, emerging creators, trends, and the conversations shaping our feeds. They’re excited to experiment with new formats, jump on the right cultural moments, engage directly with our community, and turn ideas into content quickly. This role is for someone who is excited about the direction the social media space is headed, and is eager to grow alongside the brand. Above all, they understand Byrdie’s voice and POV and are enthusiastic about helping evolve how the brand shows up, connects, and creates across platforms.

About The Position | Job Responsibilities:

  • Pitch daily social-first news and content ideas, translating timely news into social posts or hosted social videos.

  • Create original content (Reels, TikTok, etc.), including video editing and on-camera hosting.

  • Monitor community engagement, responding to comments and questions across platforms.

  • Write social copy that reflects brand voice and follows brand writing guidelines.

  • Remain curious and conduct daily research on beauty/fashion social trends and broader platform trends.

  • Brainstorm regularly to help develop new social franchises and series that align with Byrdie’s social POV.

  • Cover live events (e.g., awards shows) alongside the Byrdie editorial team.

  • Serve as an extension of the brand's social presence and on-camera identity.

  • Pull weekly social insights alongside the Byrdie social team.

Hybrid 3x a week |  (New York City) 

This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | Byrdie

Byrdie is where beauty, fashion, and internet culture meet—with strong perspective, real personality, and a curation more credible than the algorithm. What makes Byrdie different is what makes us essential: We cut through the clutter to deliver only what’s worth knowing, shaped by voices who truly influence the space. From smart takes and trendspotting to glossy celebrity covers and creator-powered events, Byrdie crafts social-first content to spark conversation and build meaningful connections. We live for all things commentary, collaboration, and community. More than just coverage spanning skin, hair, makeup, style, and wellness, Byrdie is where tastemakers with passion and POV trade notes, swap recs, and gauge what’s next. For us, it’s all about the now, next, and niche.

create assets and content.

20%: Community management and monitoring while providing insights learned from our community.  

10%: Research to stay up to date on platform trends and report content performance.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

1-3 years of digital and/or social media experience, preferably at a brand, a news organization, and/or a content studio.

  • Familiarity with major social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, X)

  • Social video editing (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or other editing tools)

  • On-camera hosting

Job Title

Growth & Content Strategy Manager, Commerce News & Deals

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Growth & Content Strategy Manager will help drive audience and revenue growth across People Inc.’s portfolio of commerce brands through search and audience strategy, performance analysis, experimentation, automation, and scaled insights.

Reporting to the Director of Growth & Content Strategy for Commerce News & Deals, this role works alongside peer strategy managers and partners closely with editorial teams to identify opportunities, understand performance, and turn audience and commerce signals into actionable content strategies.

Commerce News & Deals operates in a rapidly changing audience ecosystem across Google Search, Google Discover, Apple News, social platforms, and other discovery channels. Success in this role requires SEO fundamentals, sharp analytical thinking, strong communication and presentation skills, and the ability to develop scalable systems and content strategies that help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York City) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions

Growth Strategy & Audience Insights

  • Partner with Commerce News & Deals editorial teams, newsletter and platform experts to identify opportunities that grow audience, engagement, and commerce revenue across each respective environment.

  • Review performance across organic search, Google Discover, Apple News, social platforms, and other key audience channels and provide actionable analysis.

  • Study search demand surrounding consumer trends, and identify opportunities around product launches, sales events, tentpoles, seasonal moments, trending products, brands, and celebrities.

  • Own and create recurring analyses, dashboards, and reporting that help teams understand performance and make better decisions.

  • Build and improve automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Google Apps Script, APIs, webhooks, Airtable, Google Sheets, and internal platforms.

  • Connect data across systems to improve visibility into audience, content, and affiliate performance.

Experimentation & Performance Learning

  • Develop and execute tests to better understand audience behavior, content formats, titles, page features, and other performance drivers.

  • Conduct retrospectives around tentpoles, algorithm changes, audience shifts, and major initiatives.

  • Communicate technical and analytical findings clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of SEO and data expertise.

  • 3-5 years of experience in SEO, audience development, growth strategy, digital publishing, commerce, or a related field.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling stories and actionable recommendations for a range of stakeholders.

Audience Editor, Entertainment

USA TODAY is looking for an innovative, high-energy, data-driven Audience Editor to lead audience engagement strategy for our Entertainment coverage.

As a key member of our reimagined USA TODAY audience team, you will utilize your expertise to enhance audience growth, engagement and revenue generation for USA TODAY Entertainment. This role is right for you if you’re passionate about entertainment, from movies and music to television, celebrity news, books and content creators. You understand how audiences discover and engage with entertainment coverage and continually explore new opportunities across social media, video, newsletters, search and emerging platforms. You combine strong news judgment with audience insights to test new approaches, identify opportunities and turn successful ideas into repeatable strategies.

The ideal candidate is as comfortable interpreting data and platform analytics as they are connecting with audiences on TikTok, Reddit, Instagram or through a newsletter. You understand that the audience is at the heart of everything we do. You will also be expected to monitor trends in the broader creator industry and identify ways to translate relevant tactics into strategies for our newsrooms.

This highly-collaborative role will be accountable for translating broader business and newsroom strategies into actionable steps for the journalists on the Entertainment team. The successful candidate will oversee a small team of content creators to put our best foot forward at every step of the audience journey. As such, you should be comfortable leading through both direct management and influence, building productive relationships with peers and partners throughout the organization.

The right editor will embrace the opportunity to introduce new ideas, improve established practices and help colleagues adapt to a rapidly evolving audience landscape. You will bring energy, resilience and a commitment to turning strategy into measurable action.

This role may require working extended hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly, when news requires it.

This role must be based in New York or Los Angeles.

Responsibilities:

• Develop strategies, workflows and best practices to rapidly achieve audience growth on search, social and newsletters in collaboration with the greater USA TODAY audience team and the USA TODAY Entertainment leadership team.

• Monitor analytics for USA TODAY Entertainment both on platform and on social, in newsletters and alerts, translating that data into action steps for journalists on your direct team and on the broader Entertainment team.

• Lead audience planning for major events, tentpoles and breaking news, determining how our journalism should be packaged, distributed and presented at each stage of the audience journey.

• Create, edit or optimize audience-focused content during major events and breaking news when needed.

• Partner with the content monetization team on new efforts to monetize our journalism and grow audience on social media and distributed platform channels.

• Manage a team of content creators charged with ensuring consistent brand strategy, voice and execution across platforms for USA TODAY Entertainment, including social channels, newsletters, section fronts, app alerts and wherever our journalism meets the audience.

• Create and monitor reporting and KPI progress, including metrics for loyalty, engagement, relevance and other business goals.

• Be an innovative, creative thinker that is willing to experiment to support company's goals.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• At least 5 years of newsroom experience, including management, preferably in an audience development role at a digitally-focused media organization with expertise in entertainment. Journalism experience is mandatory.

• A proven passion and experience with storytelling via social media, search and newsletters, with expertise in platforms such as Reddit, Discord, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, Threads and more.

• Passion for helping news organizations distribute indispensable journalism and building trusted relationships with readers.

• Proactive leader who can manage their time and prioritize tasks independently.

• Devotion to peer-to-peer training, as both a teacher and student.

Technical specifications:

• Experience using Google Analytics and Parse.ly or similar tools, experience with using AI to analyze data is a plus.

• Expertise in platform-specific data tools such as Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Salesforce is required.

• Experience with third-party distribution tools like Hootsuite, True Anthem and Echobox is preferred.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.

• Familiarity with news products and journalism and understanding of media analytics and ethics.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. Your resume – one to two pages.

2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

3. Examples of at least three projects or strategies that you’re proud of and had a hand in leading in the area of audience engagement. Please include a brief description of the work, your role and any relevant KPIs or results.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Digital Producer
job.description:
DIGITAL PRODUCER

 

The Times Union newsroom is seeking an enterprising, audience-focused and versatile journalist to manage and create content serving New York’s Capital Region and beyond. Producers curate and package stories from multiple sources, including the editorial staff, and publish across all digital platforms, including our website, app, newsletters, video and social media accounts.

 

Your duties on the team: 

  • Plan for, post and package stories on Times Union platforms. This requires sharp news judgment and fluency with real-time analytics. Tasks include adding links, photos and other related assets to stories, and sending breaking news emails and app alerts.

  • Edit video clips to produce content that can quickly be shared via social media and embedded into stories.

  • Help manage newsletter campaigns and social media accounts.

  • Monitor and act on website analytics, making content decisions that drive audience trust and growth.

  • Write compelling headlines for digital audiences, optimized for search engines and social platforms.

  • Contribute to digital projects, including photo galleries, restaurant guides, real estate spotlights and more. Work with digital project managers, editors and writers on innovative packages and new ways of storytelling.

 

Skills you bring to the team: 

  • Working knowledge of tactics to maximize reach and build an audience.

  • Understanding of best practices for audience engagement and the ability to implement that knowledge.

  • Basic video editing skills. Experience with Adobe Premiere and/or Canva is a plus.

  • Idea generation and collaboration: Keep fresh ideas flowing and work with others to shape ideas into compelling stories that connect with readers across the region. 

  • Excellent writing and communication chops.

  • Top-notch organization skills, ensuring audience needs and deadlines are met.

 

Requirements: 

  • Familiarity with AP Style and some news writing experience.

  • Awareness of media standards around fair use and accurate citation for content.

  • Knowledge of web and social media analytics tools, content management systems and search optimization platforms.

  • Experience editing video for social media platforms. 

  • Basic knowledge of HTML.

  • Sound news judgment and strong understanding of local content.

  • Ability to work effectively in a small organization that emphasizes teamwork.

  • Demonstrated success working in a deadline-driven environment.

  • Proven ability to effectively juggle multiple tasks and/or projects.

 

This is a full-time role and includes working one weekend day. Other shifts or hours may be required as news warrants.

 

About us

The Times Union is investing in digital journalism. This role provides a unique opportunity for a journalist to make an impact in local communities. 

 

The Times Union is committed to growing and retaining a more diverse workforce that better reflects the communities we serve. We strongly encourage all people of working age who are traditionally underrepresented in the media to apply, including women, people of color, applicants with disabilities, those from the LGBTQ+ community and veterans.

 

Some great candidates may not check all the boxes for this role. If you’re passionate, dedicated and interested in working with us but don’t have all the skills listed here, please still reach out and tell us more about what you bring to the table. 

 

The Salary Range for this role is $56K-$64K if hired into the state of NY and based on experience and skill set.

job.title: Senior Digital Audience Producer
job.description:
About Hearst Connecticut Media Group

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is the state’s largest local news organization. Through CT Insider’s websites and app, as well as newsletters, social media, audio and print, we deliver ambitious, useful journalism to audiences across Connecticut.

We are committed to reaching readers wherever they are, building lasting relationships with local communities and investing in journalism that informs and engages the people we serve.

The Opportunity

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is hiring two innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producers to help shape how our journalism reaches, engages and retains local audiences.

Each Senior Audience Producer will serve as an audience-strategy partner to editors and reporters across one or more topic teams. Coverage areas may include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports.

This is a hands-on newsroom role for someone who combines strong editorial judgment with audience analytics, platform expertise and an experimentation mindset. You will help teams understand audience behavior, identify coverage opportunities, optimize journalism across platforms and responsibly evaluate emerging tools - including AI - under HCMG’s editorial standards.

Working closely with the broader audience team, you will help increase engagement, reader loyalty, subscriptions and return visits while supporting high-impact local journalism.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with editors, reporters, photographers and audience team members to develop and execute audience strategies for assigned coverage areas.
  • Use audience data to identify opportunities, evaluate performance and inform short- and long-term coverage decisions.
  • Translate analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for newsroom colleagues with varying levels of data experience.
  • Optimize stories and other journalism for websites, search, social platforms, newsletters and additional distribution channels.
  • Develop effective headlines, framing, packaging and promotional strategies while maintaining editorial accuracy and integrity.
  • Apply topic-area knowledge and audience insights to identify story ideas, recurring coverage opportunities, content series and annual special projects.
  • Coordinate across departments during breaking news and planned events to ensure audiences receive timely, accurate updates across platforms.
  • Create or edit multimedia assets, including video, photography and audio, to strengthen storytelling and distribution.
  • Test new formats, tools and audience-development approaches, measure their effectiveness and share lessons with the newsroom.
  • Help newsroom teams assess and use AI-supported tools responsibly, transparently and in accordance with editorial policies.
  • Support a newsroom culture that values experimentation, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong editorial judgment and experience working in a deadline-driven newsroom or comparable publishing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to use analytics to guide editorial, distribution or audience development decisions.
  • Experience optimizing journalism for websites, search, social media and newsletters.
  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain data and audience insights clearly to editors, reporters and other stakeholders.
  • Experience creating or editing multimedia content using tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Premiere or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
  • Comfort troubleshooting technical or workflow challenges in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule when coverage requires it, including occasional nights and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant coverage areas, such as data, politics, investigations, sports, education, business or real estate.
  • Experience planning or producing livestreams, podcasts or other recurring audience-focused programming. One of the two openings may have a stronger emphasis on these formats.
  • Experience contributing to audience growth, subscription conversion or reader-retention initiatives.
  • Familiarity with newsroom AI policies, responsible experimentation or emerging publishing technologies.
  • A bachelor’s degree in journalism, English, communications or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

Benefits

At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family):

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • A resume
  • A cover letter explaining your interest in the role
  • Relevant work samples or clips
  • Nonconfidential examples or summaries of audience strategies, social campaigns, newsletters, video work, or other relevant projects. 
  • Please do not submit confidential or proprietary materials belonging to a current or former employer.
  • This role is based in Norwalk, Connecticut and is not eligible for remote candidates.

job.title: Photo Editor, California Post
job.description:

job.title: Manager, Mobile Software Engineering
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Do you want to play a major role in the future of public media? Do you have a passion for mobile technology, open-source software, and serving the public?

As our Mobile Software Engineering Manager on the Audience Technology team, you will lead a highly collaborative team of mobile software engineers building, testing, and delivering features for NPR's flagship mobile applications. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Editorial teams to identify priorities, architect new capabilities, and continuously improve mobile user experiences. In addition to internal team leadership, you will serve as the technical lead overseeing external vendor relationships, agency partnerships, and staff augmentation teams. In this role, you will act as a primary champion of team health, engineering excellence, vendor accountability, and inclusive career development.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership & Coaching: Manage, mentor, and coach a team of Mobile Software Engineers, actively investing in their career growth, professional development, and psychological safety.
  • Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Lead recruitment and hiring efforts for software engineering vacancies on your team, and manage the structured onboarding and training of new engineering staff.
  • Vendor & Agency Management: Oversee external software vendors, development agencies, and staff augmentation contractors. Define statements of work (SOWs), monitor deliverable milestones, enforce SLA quality targets, and manage budget utilization for external technical engagements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UX designers, data analysts, and editorial partners across all stages of the product development lifecycle.
  • Agile Delivery Management: Lead the technical planning, scoping, and execution of future software projects, facilitating Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, backlog refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives) as needed.
  • Technical Quality & Code Review: Conduct thorough software design and code reviews, providing constructive and substantive feedback to maintain code health, architectural integrity, and security standards.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Analyze, propose, and implement engineering workflow improvements to enhance the speed, safety, and quality of software delivery.
  • Developer Experience Automation: Identify common engineering blockers and pain points, writing helper tools or automation scripts to optimize team developer experience (DX).
  • Incident & Production Support: Oversee and coordinate the team's response to critical mobile production bugs or infrastructure incidents.
  • Vendor & Contributor Management: Coordinate workflows, code standards, and deliverables for external contributors and specialized development vendors.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least 3+ years of experience directly managing mobile software engineers within an agile organization.
  • 2+ years of experience overseeing external engineering vendors, contractors, or development agencies (including managing technical SOWs, deliverables, and code integration quality).
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor in engineering, testing, and shipping robust code for at least one large-scale mobile application.
  • Hands-on proficiency in modern mobile platform languages, specifically Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android).
  • Strong working knowledge of native mobile release infrastructures (such as Apple App Store Connect/provisioning profiles or Google Play Console/staged rollouts).
  • Hands-on experience working with modern version control systems (primarily Git).
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating within cross-functional Agile/Scrum product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience managing both internal employees and external agency vendors/contractors.
  • Experience with native mobile media streaming frameworks (such as AVKit/AVFoundation for iOS, or Media3/ExoPlayer for Android).
  • Familiarity with modern responsive design architectures (SwiftUI/Combine or Jetpack Compose/Coroutines), design patterns (MVVM), and automotive platforms (CarPlay/Android Auto).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Technical Design & Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts, system architectures, and engineering trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Inclusive Leadership: Demonstrated competency in fostering an equitable, supportive, and inclusive team culture.
  • Systemic Problem Solving: Strong analytical skill set with an "automation-first" mindset for resolving manual bottlenecks and production issues.
  • User-Centric Empathy: A strong focus on quality and empathy for end-users, ensuring highly performant, accessible mobile application experiences.
  • Agile Operations: Deep fluency in Agile methodologies and software project delivery management.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $165,000 - $175,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.
