job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets. 
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.

  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.

job.title: Seasonal Graphics Designer/Animator
job.description:
The Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to design and animate graphics and other design-based assets supporting shows, events, special programming or emerging platforms. This work involves a combination of creating unique designs and animations and iterating and expanding on existing style guides and toolkits, under the direction of a team of an Art Director and Creative Producer. 

Responsibilities

  • Design and animate content for the various groups serviced by NFL Creative LA. 
  • Be able to work with deadlines that can be as short as same-day, leveraging existing toolkits or unique assets, with the guidance of the project’s art director and creative producer, to deliver on time. 
  • Design show key art for partners using existing style guides as well as creating evergreen assets.
  • Resize existing assets to fit partner guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience working in the design-animation field. 
  • Proficient knowledge Adobe After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • A working knowledge of C4D (preferably Octane render engine) proficiency may be required, based on the job placement. 
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations that derive from style guides, existing graphics packages and/or references provided by art directors. 
  • Ability to adhere to communicated file naming conventions and shared organizational guidelines. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to perform in a highly collaborative setting. 
  • Confidence in a fast-paced environment 
  • Flexibility when faced with new information, needs or challenges 
  • Ability to ask questions and communicate with art directors and creative producers when uncertain about a current assignment or when ready for the next one.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking an experienced Audio 1 (A1) to lead audio production for live and recorded programming across NFL Media platforms. This position serves as the primary audio lead responsible for the planning, execution, mixing, and overall quality of audio elements supporting studio, remote, and special event productions. 

The ideal candidate possesses extensive live broadcast audio experience, strong technical expertise in modern IP-based audio environments, and a proven ability to perform in fast-paced, high-profile sports production settings. Production services will be based at NFL Media's state-of-the-art broadcast facility in Inglewood, California. 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead audio mixer for live and recorded productions, ensuring the highest level of audio quality and operational excellence.
  • Design, configure, and execute complex audio workflows for studio shows, remote broadcasts, special events, and digital productions.
  • Operate and mix live productions utilizing broadcast audio consoles, playback systems, communication systems, and IP-based audio infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, technical directors, engineering teams, and production personnel to deliver consistent and impactful audio experiences.
  • Develop and maintain show-specific audio configurations, routing strategies, and operational workflows.
  • Lead audio planning for remote productions, transmission paths, venue integration, and signal management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical audio issues in real time while maintaining on-air continuity.
  • Oversee proper setup, operation, and optimization of communications systems, including Riedel intercom platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with broadcast audio standards and best practices across stereo, surround sound, and emerging audio formats.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and operational direction to A2 and A3 personnel and freelance audio staff as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in emerging broadcast technologies, IP networking standards, and audio production workflows.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional broadcast audio experience, including significant experience mixing live sports and studio productions.
  • Proven experience serving as an Audio 1 (A1) or senior-level broadcast audio mixer in a professional television, streaming, or live event environment.
  • Advanced experience operating SSL audio consoles; experience with SSL System T and S500 platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in stereo, 5.1 surround, and multi-channel broadcast audio mixing.
  • Extensive knowledge of IP-based audio infrastructures, including AES67, Dante, SMPTE 2110, and related broadcast networking technologies.
  • Experience supporting complex remote productions, transmission workflows, and large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, routing, communications systems, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Proficiency with playback systems, audio servers, and broadcast production technologies.
  • Experience working with Riedel communications systems and networked intercom environments preferred. 

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting national sports broadcasts and large-scale live events.
  • Dante Certification or equivalent IP audio networking credentials.
  • Experience with EVS audio workflows and replay systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based or remote production environments.
  • CTS, Dante, or other relevant industry certifications. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple competing demands while maintaining production quality.
  • Strong technical proficiency with broadcast systems, production software, and collaboration tools. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.
  • Ability to support remote productions and occasional travel as business needs require.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities. 

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations   

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments  
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations   
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)   
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p   
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments  
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)  
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows  
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments   
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies   

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency  
  • Ability to remain calm and make precise technical adjustments under pressure in live broadcast environments

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

job.title: VP, Product & Design
job.description:
The VP (Vice President), Product & Design will lead product experience and roadmap development across the NFL’s portfolio of digital products and platforms, translating vision and strategy into scalable execution. As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Roadmap Leadership

  • Own the product roadmap for the NFL’s fan-facing product portfolio across web, app, CTV, identity, and subscription experiences
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate enterprise priorities and agreed business objectives into product roadmap decisions, prioritization, sequencing, and execution plans
  • Lead short-term, seasonal, and multi-year product roadmap planning and sequencing, aligned to the broader long-range business plan and agreed investment priorities
  • Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

Product Delivery & Performance

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for product roadmap execution, sequencing, delivery excellence, experience quality, product operating cadence, and post-launch value optimization across the digital portfolio
  • Translate agreed strategic priorities into delivered product outcomes that support business goals
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to define KPI frameworks, measurement processes, and post-launch evaluation methodologies
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation, learning, and iteration

Fan Experience & Design Leadership

  • Lead the Product and Design organizations responsible for creating engaging and intuitive fan experiences
  • Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys

job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Backend Architect
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. As we continue to grow our global streaming platform, ViX, our technology teams are focused on building scalable, reliable, and secure experiences for millions of users across devices and markets.

The ViX Engineering team is seeking a Software Engineer, Backend – Lead/Architect to provide senior technical leadership across the backend platforms and services that power our streaming ecosystem. This role will lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of highly scalable backend systems supporting APIs, content and metadata, identity and entitlements, subscriptions, payments, search, personalization, and other core platform capabilities.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Cloud/Infrastructure, DevOps, and Quality Engineering. The Lead/Architect will establish technical direction and engineering standards, lead complex initiatives, and provide architectural guidance and mentorship to engineers while remaining actively involved in development, releases, production support, and problem-solving.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (Responsibilities)

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems supporting ViX.
  • Define technical direction and architecture with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Remain hands-on in software development, including solution design, development of critical components, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Lead complex engineering initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation.
  • Design backend systems capable of supporting high-volume consumer traffic across multiple products, devices, and markets.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product roadmaps and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Cloud/Infrastructure and DevOps teams on cloud-native deployment, scalability, resilience, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner across Data, Analytics, Personalization, Payments, Content, Identity, and other technology teams to support shared platform capabilities.
  • Establish and promote engineering standards and best practices for architecture, API design, code quality, testing, observability, performance, and security.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability concerns, and opportunities to modernize systems and reduce technical debt.
  • Lead architecture and technical design reviews and influence major engineering decisions across teams.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, code and design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support production reliability, including incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that improve scalability, reliability, developer productivity, or customer experience.

YOU HAVE: (Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience)

  • 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and developing large-scale backend systems.
  • Experience operating at a Lead, Staff, Principal, Architect, or comparable senior technical level.
  • Deep expertise in backend architecture, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and scalable system design.
  • Strong hands-on software development experience using modern backend programming languages and frameworks.
  • Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available production systems.
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs, service integrations, API architecture, performance, and security.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, caching, and large-scale data access patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS, GCP, or comparable environments.
  • Experience with containers, orchestration, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and observability.
  • Strong understanding of scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, security, and operational reliability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams and interconnected systems.
  • Experience establishing architectural standards and influencing technical direction without requiring direct people-management authority.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with Product Management to translate product and business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience within streaming, media, entertainment, subscription services, e-commerce, or another large-scale consumer digital environment strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred but not required.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be willing to work in the U.S.
  • Employment and education will be verified.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The summer Accounting & Finance Rotational Program (AFRP) internship is an opportunity for undergrad students interested in a career in accounting to get a summer preview of The Walt Disney Company's two-year AFRP.

The AFRP is a full-time, entry-level program designed to provide recent college graduates a cross-functional, enterprise-wide learning experience within the Controllership and Finance departments at Disney. AFRP Analysts participate in four distinct rotations designed to build key technical and leadership skills needed to succeed within the many businesses of Disney. Analysts will set goals for their program experience allowing them to develop, grow, and enhance the necessary skills to become strong accounting and finance professionals. FOX 29 Philadelphia is seeking a passionate, versatile, and high-energy News Reporter who brings hustle, originality, and innovation to our newsroom every day. If you are ready to "GO THERE" in Philadelphia, we want to see your reel!   We are looking for someone with a passion for creating content across livestreaming news programs, digital news sites, social media, and linear TV, someone with a streaming and digital-first mindset that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs.  We are looking for someone who can execute non-traditional storytelling, creating content for live streaming, website, and social platforms in a way that can also be repurposed for linear.  This is a full-time staff position focused primarily on General Assignment Reporting, backed by a dominant live presence and strong field reporting capabilities, with the flexibility to serve as a fill-in host of our streaming hours.  The ideal candidate excels in fast-paced breaking news situations, possesses a deep commitment to fair and clear storytelling, and knows how to engage audiences across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms, with a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

  • Reporting & Storytelling: Pitch and develop original story ideas, cultivate local contacts, and deliver clear, fair, and impactful reports covering a wide spectrum of topics—from hard news to popular culture.

  • Fill-In Anchoring: Serve as a fill-in anchor on various newscasts when requested, delivering polished, authoritative coverage from the studio desk.
  • Multi-Platform & Social Media: Tailor content for linear broadcast, streaming, and digital channels. Utilize social media trends and best practices to interact with viewers and expand the station's reach.
  • Continuing Coverage: Track ongoing local issues, identify new developments, and provide meaningful context to complex stories.
  • Community Engagement: Represent FOX 29 professionally to foster trust and build strong, lasting relationships across the Philadelphia community.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional writing, researching, and on-air news reporting experience, preferably covering major news events in a Top 50 or medium-to-large market.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Broadcast Journalism, or a related field preferred.
  • Live & On-Air Excellence: Exceptional live field-reporting skills, polished on-air and anchoring presence, and outstanding written and verbal communication.
  • Editorial Judgment: Strong knowledge of current events, local issues, and a passion for owning your stories from concept to broadcast.
  • Flexibility: A collaborative team player willing to work non-traditional hours, including early mornings, weekends, holidays, fill-in anchor shifts, and dynamic field schedules as breaking news demands.

job.title: Anchor/Reporter Sports (per diem)
job.description:
WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms. This is a per diem position.

 

Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.

 

We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
  • Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
  • Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
  • Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
  • Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
  • Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
  • Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
  • Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
  • On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
  • Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
  • Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.
  • Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to thrive under live pressure, multi-task, and collaborate seamlessly with newsroom producers, digital team members, photojournalists, and editors.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Willingness and availability to work a flexible schedule that regularly includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel for major sports coverage.
  • This is a SAG/AFTRA position

job.description:

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS Sports is looking for an enthusiastic, detail-oriented sports fan to join our team of Researchers. The Associate Researcher will help create and deliver materials that provide in-depth, creative, and accurate information to inform coverage across studio and game broadcasts, as well as other CBS Sports departments.

 

The ideal candidate will use deep sports knowledge, insatiable curiosity, and sound news judgment to provide statistical, analytical, biographical, and other information that supports timely, relevant, and innovative storytelling. They will also partner with teammates to develop ideas for graphics and other visual presentations across the CBS Sports portfolio, including—but not limited to—the NFL, college football and basketball, golf, and soccer.

 

This is an on-site freelance position based in our Stamford office. Candidates must be available to work 40+ hours per week in the office. The pay range is $21.63–$26.44 per hour, equivalent to approximately $45,000–$55,000 annually.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Use deep sports knowledge along with strong research techniques to generate and support ideas based on live sporting events, breaking news and other developments in the sports world.
  • Contribute to the development of informational packets that include data about our games; statistical nuggets and analytical context; storylines ranging from matchups to profiles to features to columns; and ideas for on-screen elements.
  • Conduct a variety of searches using statistical tools and databases, school/team websites, social media, other media outlets, and other sources to support storytelling and coverage for all game and studio productions
  • Build relationships with producers, on-air talent, and graphics and video associates, to ensure the highest quality and depth of information
  • Maintain files of milestones, historical records, trends and developing themes, as well as releases, story ideas, scheduled events, and other relevant information about the sports, conferences, teams, coaches and players covered on CBS Sports platforms
  • In partnership with Research teammates, respond to relevant trends, developing storylines and noteworthy performances prior to and during live game action.
  • Communicate in a timely and effective manner with content creators to provide thorough, creative and accurate statistical and storytelling information that will support and enhance productions.
  • Under limited supervision, deliver real-time reactions to notable performances, significant plays, and developing on-field storylines from live games.
  • Chart out information that will be turned into graphics by presenting complex information in an easy-to-digest manner. Must have a keen eye to detail, an emphasis on accuracy and a focus on highlighting the priority storylines.
  • Prepare general background/research material for other entities as needed.
  • Assist Researchers and Senior Researchers with organizational tasks.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 0-3 years of experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred; current college students will be considered
  • Relevant educational or work experience in journalism, communications or production fields is preferred.
  • Experience working with numbers in any field, including your field of study
  • Experience in sports studio/broadcast environments, or other sports media fields, a plus.
  • Excellent working knowledge of and interest in multiple sports, especially NFL, college football, college basketball, golf and soccer.
  • A resourceful ability to conduct research with limited supervision and a passion for discovering and sharing new knowledge is a must.
  • Must be able to thrive in a team-oriented environment
  • Excellent interpersonal and multi-tasking skills, as well as a keen attention to detail, are required.
  • Must demonstrate ability and desire to work in a fast-paced environment under deadline, to prioritize assignments and ensure accuracy
  • Must be able to work nights, weekends and flexible hours.
  • Must demonstrate ability to communicate ideas effectively and efficiently.
  • Must be a self-starter with demonstrated initiative

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on Friday, October 2nd, 2026.

Application Instructions

In addition to a resume, please submit:

  • Instead of a traditional cover letter, provide a brief statement outlining your approach to creative leadership, team mentorship, and how you balance artistic innovation with organizational goals.

Intro to Position

NPR is one of the country’s most trusted brands, but its reputation was built in a media landscape that no longer exists. Audiences have scattered across owned platforms, social video, and a dozen competitors fighting for the same attention. The organizations winning that fight are the ones willing to look and sound different, not just distribute more. This role exists to help NPR make that shift real.

This is, and is not, a caretaker role for an established brand. It's a build and evolution role: new formats, new visual language, a creative team stood up for video at a scale the organization hasn't operated in before. 

You'll report to the SVP of Brand & Communications and work closely with Product, Audience Insights, Marketing, and Editorial to shift a beloved legacy brand into one that can compete with new creators and challengers.

Responsibilities

Drive a more distinctive cohesive brand in a saturated market

  • Establish technical brand standards, visual principles, and digital design systems that make NPR’s visual expression instantly recognizable across direct-to-audience platforms. 
  • Build platform-native video formats and visual frameworks that drive industry-leading differentiation, compelling audiences to choose NPR over thousands of alternative journalism and entertainment options 
  • Push beyond generic institutional and media-industry conventions to create work with greater personality, clarity, emotion, and cultural relevance.
  • Translate organizational values, editorial priorities, and public service mission into standardized motion assets, video packages, and platform-native visual frameworks. 
  • Analyze market landscapes and digital competitor trends to ensure NPR’s video and motion visual language remains distinct, modern, and culturally relevant. 

Build creative capacity for an owned-and-operated future

  • Define the technical visual frameworks and motion standards required to integrate video seamlessly across NPR’s owned digital ecosystem (websites, mobile apps, newsletters, and membership portals). 
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Editorial teams to establish a cohesive UI/UX and motion experience across owned platform touchpoints. 
  • Build modular, scalable design systems and template kits that enable teams across the organization to independently publish brand-aligned digital content. 
  • Ensure that creative work supports a deeper direct relationship with audiences rather than treating owned platforms simply as distribution channels.
  • Help develop the visual and verbal conventions that make the organization’s digital experiences feel distinctive, intentional, and connected.
  • Identify opportunities to use design, storytelling, video, motion, and other creative tools to increase engagement with owned experiences.
  • Utilize audience analytics and engagement data to continuously optimize digital assets and direct-to-audience visual experiences. 

Build a modern video and motion capability

  • Establish production standards, camera/lighting guidelines, motion graphic templates, and editing signatures for short-form, social, explanatory, and talent-led video formats. 
  • Procure, maintain, and manage specialized video studio hardware, camera packages, lighting setups, field audio gear, and editing suites 
  • Partner with Editorial and other teams to determine where technical brand video and motion graphics complement editorial production.
  • Develop recognizable approaches to motion, editing, typography, graphics, sound, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ensure that video is treated as a core creative medium rather than an adaptation of work conceived for print or static digital formats.
  • Supervise a dedicated, technical video and motion production squad (2 direct reports), managing daily project allocations, post-production workflows, and technical skill development 

Drive creative excellence

  • Establish operational SLAs, resource management models, and quality-assurance protocols to scale high-volume video publishing efficiently. 
  • Lead the creative development of campaigns, executive communications, fundraising materials, events, presentations, reports, digital experiences, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure creative work is aligned with organizational priorities, audience needs, accessibility standards, and brand guidelines.
  • Encourage experimentation while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Enforce strict compliance with federal digital accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1, closed captioning, color contrast, screen-reader compatibility) across all motion and video deliverables. 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of progressive creative leadership experience specializing in digital media, video production, or motion systems architecture within an in-house team or agency environment. 
  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating advanced technical mastery  conceptual thinking, creative direction, visual sophistication, and digital product visual identity across multi-platform ecosystems .
  • Demonstrated experience helping a brand evolve, modernize, or become more differentiated.
  • Deep technical proficiency in industry-standard video and motion software suites (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma design systems). and the changing ways audiences discover, consume, and engage with media.
  • Meaningful experience developing or directing video and motion work.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence cross-functional partners, and navigate complex organizational structures. .
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and creative budgets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with a media, technology, cultural, entertainment, consumer, nonprofit, or mission-driven brand undergoing significant transformation.
  • Experience helping an established or legacy brand evolve for new audiences or platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer, subscription, membership, or other owned-and-operated digital strategies.
  • Experience building or expanding an internal video, motion, or multimedia creative capability.
  • Experience developing enterprise design systems or brand governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with audience research, brand measurement, accessibility standards, and emerging creative technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing technical creative personnel, such as video editors, motion designers, and digital production leads. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong technical storytelling instincts across motion, video, and platform-native digital formats. 
  • Fluency in visual systems, digital motion design, video production workflows, and digital brand expression. 
  • Deep curiosity about media, culture, design technology, motion trends, and changing audience behavior on owned digital platforms .
  • Strong people leadership, technical team management, coaching, and talent-development skills.
  • Comfort leading creative/digital visual transformation within and systems integration within an established organization.
  • An ability to respect the equity of a legacy brand without being constrained by its history when building new platform formats. .

  • An ability to communicate the strategic, technical, and architectural reasoning behind creative choices.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions or Deadline: 

Application Deadline: Wednesday, September 30th at 12pm ET.

Materials to Submit:

  • A cover letter detailing your creative approach to explanatory journalism on video, your vision for adapting audio reporting to social platforms, and how you foster collaborative learning environments for colleagues new to video production.
  • Links to three short-form videos you conceived, shot, or edited that best illustrate your storytelling technique, editorial judgment, and technical execution. Please provide brief contextual notes on your specific role in each project within your cover letter.

Intro to Position

We’re looking for an experienced video maker to help us transition into a new era of video at Planet Money. The role is part creator, part strategist, part trainer.

Maybe you are a creator ready to join a team. Maybe you are a visual journalist who likes to build systems and start things. Maybe you’ve managed social channels and want to apply that to public media journalism. Maybe something else we haven’t thought of. In any case, here’s the job. 

First, you’ll work with the existing podcast/audio teams at Planet Money and The Indicator to pilot different types of social video or different processes for making them. Then together we will assess what works, what’s worth doing, and what’s not, and you’ll help us update our social video strategy and build sustainable workflows based on what we learn. By the end of your assignment, we hope to have a few new ways to represent our audio journalism on new platforms that our existing staff can sustainably carry on. 

A big part of the job will be helping our audio producers become comfortable creating more video on their own. You’ll help the audio team learn new video tools, analyze metrics and make smart choices about what to adapt to video and what not to. 

There’s wide latitude for experimentation, and an excellent team of creative, smart, fun journalists to collaborate with, including our existing video team. You’ll have lots of support and material to work with, and you’ll be a full part of the Planet Money and Indicator teams, with all the access to the podcast and reporting processes you need to make this work, including collaborating with our existing video colleagues. 

This is a temporary role with a specific mission: help a talented podcast team get a sustainable social video operation up and running and set them up to carry it forward after the assignment ends. There may also be some opportunities to pilot longer-form video, but our first priority is getting short-form systems working well. 

A little background may help you decide if this role is right for you:

Planet Money is like a little economics-themed media outlet within NPR. We explain how economics works and how it affects everyone’s life. We use stories to make the explanations memorable. We do this across media: two podcasts, Planet Money and The Indicator; regular segments on Morning Edition and All Things Considered; two newsletters; a nationally distributed weekend broadcast radio hour with How I Built This; a bestselling book; a board game; and, of course, video.

We’re extremely proud of our video presence, which has gone through several eras, beginning with our T-shirt project in 2013, to a series of live-action shorts in 2019, to a runaway TikTok channel starting in 2020. Now we’re ready to experiment more broadly with how Planet Money and The Indicator show up on video, and how we can do it more consistently and more frequently.

We are not replacing or ending our current short video approach. We couldn’t be more proud of that work! 

Our goal is to build on the excellent social videos our video team is already making. We love what we’re making there, and it works! We want to add more frequent videos that are more closely connected to the reporting we’re doing on the podcast and newsletters. To do that, we need more members of our team participating (maybe on camera and maybe in editing, that’s for you to help us answer). We want to find more opportunities to capture video and new processes that make all of that possible in intelligent, thoughtful and creative ways. Then we will know how to invest in our expanded video future. 

That’s where this role comes in. If you think you can help us build it, please apply.

 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Work with Planet Money leadership, video creators and NPR visual and social teams to refine and implement Planet Money’s video strategy, gathering and using audience and performance data to inform decisions. 
  • Lead experimentation with different forms of video journalism, assess results and help determine which approaches Planet Money should focus on. 
  • Collaborate with Planet Money and The Indicator editors, producers and hosts to conceive, produce, shoot, edit and publish video for NPR’s platforms and social media.
  • Train and coach some of our audio producers in video production and visual storytelling, video tools and interpreting performance metrics.
  • Develop short-form social video and other visual projects that extend Planet Money and The Indicator’s journalism to new and existing audiences.
  • Write and edit social video posts, captions, stories and other supporting copy and contribute to community engagement alongside other members of the team.
  • Coordinate production, publication and assessment of programming for visual platforms in collaboration with NPR’s visual and social teams.
  • Establish sustainable video production workflows that the podcast teams can continue on their own. 
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least four years of experience regularly making videos regularly in a journalistic, explanatory or comparable editorial setting. Please send us samples. 
  • At least two years of experience managing or creating video for social and digital platforms, with demonstrated experience using audience and performance data to inform editorial or creative decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of and interest in the topics Planet Money and The Indicator cover
  • Experience managing social media channels for a news or media organization, publisher or other editorial brand.
  • Experience helping journalists or other content creators develop video production and visual storytelling skills.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud programs related to video, photo and design. (Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere).
  • Advanced skill and experience with video podcasting tools such as Riverside, Descript and comparable platforms. 
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other relevant social media platforms, including experience using platform analytics and data for audience growth. 
  • Strong visual storytelling skills and editorial judgment across short-form and social video.
  • Ability to contribute to and execute a comprehensive, cross-platform video and social strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to coach colleagues with varying levels of video experience.
  • Strong understanding of copyright, journalistic ethics and editorial standards.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and to consistently work well with others and as part of a team, demonstrating at all times respect for the diverse constituencies at NPR and within the public radio system.
  • Must be able to lift video equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts as needed.

Education Requirements

  • While we value formal education, especially if you’ve studied the topic areas we cover, we do not believe that any specific degree is needed to perform this job successfully. 

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in the New York City area.

job.description:
As a Manager in the Artist Relations team, you will take ownership of events and industry moments, supporting our artists, making sure nothing is left to chance. This is a role for someone who finds real satisfaction in making complex things run without a hitch,  juggling multiple events, itineraries and moving parts, and getting every detail right under pressure.

You'll be the person holding it all together behind the scenes, from logistics and scheduling to hospitality and gifting, so that when it counts, everything just works. Success in this role looks like calm, meticulous delivery, week after week, that the wider team can always rely on.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the planning and delivery of events, showcases, playback sessions, industry gatherings and key music moments, ensuring every experience is executed to the highest standard.
  • Attend gigs, festivals and other corporate events where necessary, organizing passes, disc presentations and meet & greets.
  • Represent Sony Music at major industry events, festivals and awards ceremonies, supporting artist attendance
  • Manage artist visits from end to end, overseeing itineraries, hospitality, travel logistics and bespoke experiences to ensure a seamless and memorable experience
  • Attend weekly scheduling meetings to facilitate knowledge of potential no.1 artists
  • Oversee and deliver artist recognition including milestone (Christmas, Birthdays) and commemorative gifting and other special moments that celebrate their success.
  • Provide guidance and day-to-day support to coordinators and interns, helping develop capability across the wider Artist Relations team.
  • Represent Sony Music at major industry events, festivals and awards ceremonies, supporting with table plans, logistics and after party coordination

Who you are:

  • You have experience in Artist Relations, Events, Talent Management, Hospitality or a similar fast-paced industry environment.
  • You are exceptionally organised and thrive managing multiple projects, stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
  • You have strong knowledge of venues, hospitality, events and the live music landscape.
  • You build credibility quickly and are comfortable working with senior stakeholders, artists and management teams.
  • You remain calm under pressure, think ahead and consistently deliver high-quality work with meticulous attention to detail.

What we give you:

  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best

job.title: Group Vice President, Consumer Marketing
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Group Vice President, Consumer Marketing will be responsible for increasing SiriusXM’s relevance and creating demand by leveraging the power of our brand, content, talent and unique access to live events and fan experiences to develop compelling, integrated marketing opportunities across channels, partnerships and experiences. 

This leader will serve as SiriusXM’s senior consumer marketing expert, bringing deep expertise in building brand relevance, creative strategy, integrated marketing and media strategy. Working from the audience priorities and consumer understanding developed through Consumer Strategy, they will define how SiriusXM shows up in the market and identify new ways to use our extraordinary content, talent, live moments and experiences to make SiriusXM more relevant and compelling to current and future consumers. 

The role requires an exceptional combination of consumer marketing expertise, creative judgment, cultural fluency and digital orientation. The successful candidate will know how to turn consumer strategy into ideas that resonate, recognize exceptional creative work, connect marketing across channels and experiences, and see opportunities to make individual content, talent and cultural moments significantly bigger through integrated marketing. 

This leader will oversee Brand Strategy, Creative, Integrated Marketing & Brand Experiences, Media Strategy and Partnership Marketing, working closely with Consumer Strategy, Engagement Strategy, Product, Programming and other partners to create a more connected approach to marketing and customer outcomes.

What you’ll do:

  • Define and steward SiriusXM's brand positioning, differentiation, architecture and long-term brand direction, ensuring the brand remains distinctive and relevant.
  • Lead the development of creative strategy and expression across SiriusXM marketing, establishing a high bar for ideas, storytelling, design and execution.
  • Identify and develop integrated marketing opportunities that bring together creative, media, content, talent, partnerships, digital and live experiences to amplify our most important moments and create greater consumer relevance.
  • Turn SiriusXM’s unique content, talent, access and programming into compelling consumer propositions and marketing ideas that create relevance and demand.
  • Develop marketing strategies that broaden SiriusXM’s relevance with new and evolving consumer segments while strengthening the connection with our existing customer base.
  • Lead Media Strategy, defining the role of media within our integrated marketing approach, including channel strategy, investment priorities and measurement.
  • Partner with Marketing Activation & Operations to translate media strategy into effective activation and optimization across digital platforms.
  • Develop consumer-facing marketing opportunities with partners that extend the brand, create distinctive opportunities and connect SiriusXM with consumers in relevant ways.
  • Expand how SiriusXM uses experiential marketing, live moments, fandom and merchandise to create larger, more integrated brand experiences.
  • Partner closely with Consumer Strategy to translate audience priorities, consumer needs and identified opportunities into brand and marketing strategies.
  • Work with Engagement Strategy to connect brand and demand creation with acquisition and subscriber lifecycle strategies.
  • Build strong partnerships with Programming and Product to ensure our marketing effectively communicates and amplifies the content, talent, capabilities and experiences that differentiate SiriusXM.
  • Establish clear priorities across Brand, Creative, Media, Partnerships and Integrated Marketing and create stronger coordination across those capabilities.
  • Serve as a senior thought partner to leadership.
  • Lead multiple VPs and/or senior leaders across Brand Strategy, Creative, Integrated Marketing & Brand Experiences, Media Strategy and Partnership Marketing, creating alignment, accountability and leadership development across the broader function.
  • Own cross-functional budget and investment prioritization across the consumer and brand marketing portfolio, balancing resources across teams to maximize business impact and efficiency.
  • Exercise cross-functional decision-making authority across the portfolio, resolving competing priorities and aligning strategies across Brand, Creative, Media, Partnerships and Integrated Marketing.
  • Collaborate directly with ELT members and peer functional leaders on company-wide priorities, and represent Consumer & Brand Marketing in high-level enterprise discussions.
  • Drive transformation and innovation across the related marketing functions, improving how teams work together and scaling integrated approaches that increase consumer relevance and business performance.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically has 18 or more years of experience with 9-12 or more years of management experience.
  • Demonstrated success making an established consumer brand more relevant to new or evolving audiences without relying primarily on traditional mass-media advertising or wholesale brand reinvention.
  • Proven ability to turn content, talent, cultural moments, experiences or other differentiated assets into integrated marketing that creates consumer interest and demand.
  • Strong creative judgment and demonstrated ability to inspire, evaluate and elevate creative ideas and execution.
  • Deep digital fluency and experience using digital, social and emerging channels to amplify content, experiences and cultural moments.
  • Experience developing integrated strategies that connect creative, media, content, partnerships, digital and physical experiences rather than treating them as independent disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of modern media, with the strategic judgment to balance brand building and performance objectives and determine channel roles and investment priorities.
  • Strong cultural fluency and an instinct for fandom—understanding how talent, content, live moments and access can create relevance and deeper consumer connection.
  • Strong commercial orientation and a track record of connecting marketing decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling and influencing skills, with the ability to establish a clear marketing point of view across senior cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in media, entertainment, subscription, live experiences or another culturally relevant consumer business is strongly preferred.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $229,000 to $300,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination.
